tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po thub dbang ratna shrī'i phyi yi bka' 'bum nor bu'i bang mdzod bzhugs so/ /
༄༅/ /khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po thub dbang ratna shrī'i phyi yi bka' 'bum nor bu'i bang mdzod bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po thub dbang ratna shrī'i phyi yi bka' 'bum nor bu'i bang mdzod bzhugs so//

༄༅// bla ma rin po ches mdzad pa'i phyag chen gshis babs ngo sprod pa'i gdams pa// 465) bla ma dang ni rnal 'byor ma// mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo// lhan cig skyes pa zhes bya ba/ chos kyi sku la bya ste/ snang ba lhan cig skyes pa dang*/ sems nyid lhan cig skyes pa'o// sems nyid gnas pa rdo rje ye shes yin/ sna tshogs snang yang gnyug ma'i ngo bo nyid/ byed sgo tha dad pa yi tshul snang yang*/ de nyid don las gzhan pa yod ma yin/ snang grags kyi chos dang sems nyid kyi sku gnyis tha dad med de nyi ma dang 'od zer bzhin no// rnal 'byor pas don gang la gnas par bya zhe na/ tha dad du zhen pa'i rtog pa med par gnyug ma'i de kho na nyid la gnas par bya'o// ji ltar gnas par bya zhe na/ 'bras bu la re ba dang*/ 'khor ba la dogs pa dang*/ mnyam pa nyid la rtsol ba'i sems de dag thongs la ci yang ma yin pa'i sems rang dga' rnal ma 'di nyid rnal 'byor dam pa'o// de nas sems nyid ci yang ma yin pa la ci yang ma yin pa'i tshul du spyad cing goms par byas nas/ bla ma dag gis smras pa'i rnal ma'i shes pa de thugs kyis go ste/ snying po gnyug ma'i ngo bo la bsgoms pas mnyam pa nyid kyi don snying la zhugs par 'gyur te/ ji bzhin pa'i ngo bo de/ de bzhin par rtogs so// dper na skyu ru ra lag mthil du bzhag pa'am/ nor bu rin po che a smri sa ra me long g.ya' dag pa'i steng du bzhag na phyi nang med par gsal ba bzhin du/ gnyug ma'i don rtogs na chos thams cad sems nyid du rtogs shing bde ba chen po ro gcig pa/ bdag med pa mnyam pa'i don shugs kyis 'jog ste/ snang zhing grags pa thams cad de'i ngo bo yin pa'i phyir ro// de las gzhan pa'i mtha' zhig ni sangs rgyas dang rje btsun la sogs pa sus kyang shes par mi 'gyur ro// sems nyid gcig pu la 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das par snang ste/

rang la 'khrul pas gnyis su brtags shing snang ba de srid du 'khor ba yin la/ de nyid gnyis med kyi ngo bo rtogs shing rang nyid sangs rgyas su mthong ba goms pa rab kyis mthar phyin pa ni mya ngan las 'das pa'o// de bas grub thob kyi bla ma rnams skal ldan gyi slob ma la 'o dod rtag tu 'bod de/ lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes 'od gsal ba/ sangs rgyas rang las gzhan nas btsal mi dgos/ zhes snyan pa'i 'o dod 'bod do// sdug bsngal thams cad dang bral ba'i bde ba chen po de rang gi sems nyid yin zhes pa'i 'o dod dang*/ snang grags kyi chos 'jig mi dgos/ sems las tha dad na snang bzhin du snang yang logs na med/ sems kyi ngo bo chos sku yin zhes grags pa'i 'o dod do// des na snang ba logs su dor nas ye shes gzhan nas 'dod pa ma yin te/ dug la sngags kyis btab pa bzhin tha mal gyi shes pa nyams su myong ba ni 'khrul rtog nyid lam du gyur pa'i phyir ro// srog chags thams cad kun la yang*// de nyid yod de rtogs pa med// thams cad ro mnyam rang bzhin pas// til dang til mar ji bzhin no// bya byed rtog pa'i rnam par snang ba thams cad bya ba mi byed pa sems nyid gnyug ma'i ngo bo ste/ snang grags thams cad chos kyi sku phyag rgya chen po'i ngo bo yin la/ de dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa yin te/ rtogs ldan sprul pa'i bla mas bstan pa'o// lhan cig skyes pa bdud rtsi'i ro// gzhan nas rnyed pa ma yin te// rtogs dang ldan pa'i bla ma yi// zhal gyi bdud rtsi dag las dris// zhes so// sems dngos po med par rtogs pa dang med par rtogs pa gnyis ka yang chos kyi sku'i 'ching ba ste don rtogs par mi 'gyur ro// rmongs pa'i bsam gtan ni steng 'og gi rtsa dang rlung dang*/ thig le dang sku dang phyag rgya la sogs kyis dmigs pa nye bar bzung ba'i zhi gnas bsgoms te/

shes pa nan gyis khugs su bcug kyang lam du mi 'gyur/ sems kyi zug rngu sdug bsngal 'ba' zhig bskyed par zad do// de ci'i phyir zhe na/ thabs tha mal gyi shes pa dang*/ shes rab gsal ba dang*/ mi rtog pa dang*/ bde ba'i rang bzhin dang bral zhing med par gyur pas/ gnyis 'dzin gyi mnyam par bzhag pas bye ma btsir ba'i mar bzhin no/ gnyug ma'i don la bsgom du med de/ gnyis 'dzin gyi bsam gtan dang bral ba'o// rang bzhin gyis dag pa'i sems kyi ngang rtog pa'i dri mas ma gos pa la rtog ge'i bsam gtan dag gis bslad par mi bya ste/ rang bzhin rang dga'i tshul du bzhag par byas nas/ de nyid nyams su myong bar 'gyur te/ nyams su myong ba'i bde ba lus dang sems la gnas kyang de la ma zhen cig dam pa rnams kyi gdams pa'o// 'o na bsgom par bya ba ma yin nam zhe na/ gnyug ma'i ting nge 'dzin gyi zas za zhing bla ma dam pa'i gdams ngag skom du 'thung pa bde stong gnyis med du sbyor ba ni rang dga'i tshul te/ snang ba sems su ma thim gyi bar du dran pa rgyun chags kyis sems dang sems su sprod par byed cing rtag tu lan mang du bsgom par bya ste/ bla ma dam pa'i gdams ngag khyim mchog dam pa nas/ nyams myong khyim nas dgag sgrub med par rtogs// ma bcos rnal ma'i zas shig zos gyur na// grub mtha' ma lus kun kyang tshim par 'gyur// rmongs pas ma rtogs tha snyad tshig la brten// btsal kyang ma rnyed 'dug kyang de ma shes// chu ma rnyog na dwangs ba'i rnam pa dang*// mar me ma bcos gsal bzhin du// sems ni ma bcos de bzhin zhogs// nyams myong bde ba chen po'i ro// nyams su myong bas shin tu bde// bdag gis smra bar mi nus kyi// smra phyir tshad dang rgya tshad med// de nyid ngo bo shes mi nus// rtogs par 'gyur ba ma yin no// bla mas bstan par mi shes na// slob mas go ba yod min te// lhan cig skyes pa bdud rtsi'i ro// gang zhig ji ltar bstan par bya// rje btsun rnams kyis bu zhes bos te// khyed chos kyi sku blang bar 'dod pa rnams rang las blang bar gyis shig ce'o// ji ltar zhe na/

skyes pa tha mal gyi shes pa gnyug ma'i ngo bo de/ nam mkha' bzhin du skye ba dang 'gag pa dang gnas pa dang bral ba'i sku gsum ye shes lnga'i bdag nyid de dbu ma la sogs pa gzhan gyis rtogs pa ma yin te/ shes pa blo dang brjod pa sgra'i yul las 'das pa mngon sum dang rjes dpag gi rig pa'i tshig gi mtshon chas gzhan sun 'byin par byed kyang*/ de kho na nyid sus kyang mtshon par mi nus la/ bdag nyid kyis brtags dpyad kyang ngo bo rnyed pa ma yin no// gnyug ma'i ngo bo de ming du yod kyang ngos bzung med do// nam mkha' dang 'dra ba'i phyir thog ma dang mtha' ma med la dbus kyang yod pa ma yin te/ ci yang ma yin pa'i phyir ro// de la bsgom bya sgom byed gnyis su mi bya ste/ dngos gzhi 'khrul bas thar pa mi rnyed do// des na chu la chu bzhag pa bzhin/ sems la sems su bzhag ste bsgom par bya'o// des nyams su myong ba'i don la mtha' gnyis kyis chos med cing*/ mtshan ma bgrod par bya ba'i lam yang med la/ nyon mongs pa dang gnyen po'i go rim gyi tshul du bcos par bya ba ma yin no// spang bya spong byed kyi tshul gyis grol bar byed pa rnams kyang de nyid nyams su myong ba'i dus su mtshan ma la sems mi 'phro la/ mi g.yo ste thams cad ngo bo gcig pa'i phyir ro// rtogs pa brtan par gnas te sgom du med par tha mal gyi shes pa rnam par 'jog pa la phyi nang gi g.yeng bas gnod par mi 'gyur te/ thams cad rig par go zhing mnyam rjes med pa'o// blo rno ste dmigs pa gang gtad chos nyid du wal wal 'char ba'o// blo dag ste rtag chad gzung 'dzin grub mtha'i rtog pa dang bral ba'o// blo mi 'phrogs te tha snyad sgro btags yin pa'i phyir ro// gnyis 'dzin med de/ snang ba dang sems ro mnyam gyur pa'i phyir ro// re dogs med de 'khor 'das dbyer med pa'i phyir ro// blang dor spyod pa 'byung bar mi 'gyur te/

gza' gtad bral ba'i dngos po nyams su myong ba'i phyir ro// dmangs rigs dang bram ze med de/ tha snyad kyi rtog pa dang bral ba'i phyir ro// gnyis med ni tha mal gyi shes pa nyid do// myong ba ni gsal ba dang mi rtog pa dang bde dang myong du med pa'i myong ba ste/ bral na zhes bya ba ni gnyis su med pa'i don la ldang 'jug yod cing klong du ma gyur gyi bar du de bzhin nyid ma yin no// de mi btang ba ni bla ma la bsnyen bkur ba dang*/ bsod nams kyi tshogs dang snying rje la 'bad par bya ste/ snying rje dang bral ba'i stong pas kyang lam thag chod par mi 'gyur zhing*/ stong pa dang bral ba'i snying rjes kyang 'khor ba 'ba' zhig skyed par byed pa'i rgyu zhes bya'o// klong du gyur pa na theg pa dman pa'i spyod pa dang lta ba dang sgom pa dang rnam rig lta ba dang*/ dbu ma pa'i dgag sgrub dang bcas pa'i bsam gtan dang*/ mchod pa dang sngags kyi bye brag kyang mi smra ste/ snying po'i don 'di rtogs pa na logs nas sangs rgyas sgrub rgyu med pas/ dgos pa med pa'i phyir ro// ched du rnam par chad pa ma yin te/ de gnyis snyan dang rtog pa shugs kyis 'gag pa'i phyir ro// snying rjes gzhan don du 'bad pa yang ched du bsgrubs pa ma yin te shugs kyis 'byung ba'i phyir ro// 'khor ba'i rgyu ni ma rig pa ste/ de yang lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes rgyun chad med par bsgom par bya ste/ de yang bsgom bya sgom byed du byas na blos byas bcos ma'o// 'o na ji ltar zhe na/ rang gsal la rnam rtog bag chags ma byung*/ ma bcos par bzhag na rang mthong bar 'gyur ro// de'i tshe ma rig pa yang rang gi ngo bor grub cing rtogs pa dang mthong bas 'du byed las mi gsog ste rnam par rtog pa la sogs pa ngang gis gcad par 'gyur ro// rnam rtog byung yang 'jigs par mi bya ste/ dran pa'i dus nyid na gnyug ma'i ngo bor grub pa'i phyir ro// des na bde gsal mi rtog cing ji ltar nyams su myong bas na nam mkha'i ngang las 'das pa med do// don dang nyams dang ldan pa ste/

bde ba chen po rgyun chad med pa'i phyir ro// myong ba ni bzang ngan du snang ba bsgom pa'i nyams te don la med do// gnyug ma'i ngo bo la rnam rtog byung yang nam langs pa'i mun pa bzhin rang bzhin gyis dwangs par 'gyur ro// gzhan du song ba ni med de ma skyes ma 'jig sems kyi ngo bor grub pa'o// sems nyid 'od gsal ba las bag chags kyi snang ba logs na med pa'o// 'od gsal dang dbyer med du rtogs shing*/ nang nas nges pa yengs pa med pa chu bo'i rgyun bzhin gnas par lta ba ye shes bsgom/ spyod pa zung 'jug yin no// snang ba sems kyi ngo bor bzhag ste/ de rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba de rang dgar btang*/ glod la bzhag 'dod pa'i yon tan mi dgag yul la 'phros pa'i sems mi dgug gang snang skye med thug phrad du bya'o// 'di dag gis ci tsam nas sangs rgyas par nus zhe na/ rtogs pa'i skad cig de nyid las sangs rgyas par 'gyur ro// rgyu 'bras tshul du yod dam zhe na/ de rmi lam du yang mi srid na dngos su lta ci smos kyang ci dgos/ de nas sangs rgyas thob par nges zhes slob ma'i blo la mtshon kyang*/ rtogs pa'i ngo bo ngos bzung ba'o// des na spyod lam thams cad du yang snang srid gnyug ma'i ngo bor rtogs par bya ba de kho na nyid la ma yengs par mchod par gyis shig ce'o// bla ma rin po ches mdzad pa'i phyag rgya chen po rdzogs so// // 466) ༄// gzhi lam 'bras gsum gshis kyi 'gro tshul bkra shis seng ger gnang ba// oṃ swasti/ gting mtha' med pa'i 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las// sgrol byed rdzings ni bla ma dam pa ste// srid pa'i mtsho las sgrol ba'i gru skya 'dzin// mnyam med bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la 'dud// dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bor gyur pa/ 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po bla ma rin po che'i zhal snga nas/

'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i yon tan gang bsgrub kyang*/ bla ma mkhas pa shin tu gal che ste/ 'jig rten gyi sman dang bzo dang*/ rig byed thams cad la yang bla ma shin tu gal che bar 'dug na/ tshe 'di dang phyi ma dus dang rnam pa thams cad kyi so nams/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi chos lta smos kyang ci dgos te/ de ltar yang*/ bcom ldan 'das kyis/ sangs rgyas chos rnams dge ba'i bshes la bsten to zhes// yon tan kun gyi mchog mnga' rgyal bas de skad gsungs// zhes pa/ bla ma bsten pa shin tu gal che/ bla ma de yang bla mar khas 'che ba tsam gyis phan pa ma yin te/ brtag pa gal che bar/ bla ma lnga bcu pa nas kyang*/ slob dpon dang ni slob ma gnyis// mtshungs par dam tshig mnyam gyur pas// dpa' bos 'brel pa brtag par bya// zhes pa dang*/ sngags dang mtshan nyid thams cad nas bla ma'i mtshan nyid dpag tu med pa gsungs pas shes la/ de thams cad kyang mdor bsdus na/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyis nyon mongs pa thams cad rnam par spangs pa dang*/ de spangs pa'i yon tan thams cad mthar phyin pa la spangs pa phun sum tshogs pa dang*/ ye shes sam rtogs pa mthar phyin pa la/ spangs rtogs sam/ sangs rgyas zhes bya bar gsung rab rnams dang*/ mkhas pa thams cad kyi zhal mthun pa yin la/ 'dir bla ma yang*/ sangs rgyas su bsgom pa yang a cang ches slob ma'i gnyer ka yin te/ ma tha yang sangs rgyas 'grub pa'i rgyu tshang la ma nor ba shes nas lam nyams su len pa zhig dgos la/ slob ma yang de dang rjes su mthun pas 'brel par 'gyur ba zhig dgos te/ de yang bla ma dam pa de'i sku gsung thugs kyi rnam par thar pa gsum las/ dang po dang*/ bar pa dang*/ tha mar rig par bya ste/ dang po'i dbang du byas na/ lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyis mdor bsdus nas gsungs pa/ sdig pa ci yang mi bya ste// zhes pas/ lus kyi sgo nas srog gcod pa dang*/

ma byin par len pa dang*/ mi tshangs par spyod pa rnam pa gsum/ ston pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa des/ 'di ltar pham par gyur pa mi gsod pa dang*/ rku ba dang*/ 'khrig pa'i chos spyod pa man chad/ tha na srog chags grog sbuur gsod pa dang*/ til gyi 'bru gu tsam yang ma byin par mi blang ba dang*/ chags pa'i mig gis yul bud med la yang mi blta ba/ 'dod pa khyod rtsa ngas shes te// rtog pa las ni 'dod pa skye// khyod la rtog pa ma byas dang*// de nas 'dod pa mi skye 'o// zhes pa dang*/ lus kyi las mi dge ba rab 'bring rnam pa gsum mi bya bar gsungs pa dang*/ ngag gi las mi dge ba rdzun/ phra ma/ tshig rtsub/ ngag 'khyal rnam pa bzhi dang*/ sems kyi mi dge ba brnab sems/ gnod sems/ log par lta ba rnam pa gsum ste/ de re re la yang zhing dang bsam pa dang*/ dngos po rnam pa gsum gyi byed pas/ che 'bring chung gsum du 'gyur ba mtha' dag dgag par bya ba'i bslab par gsungs te/ de 'gog pa'i dgos pa/ las dang lam la sgrib pa dang*/ bya dang byed pa mang ba dang*/ ngan song gsum du ltung ba dang*/ gzhan dag ma dad par 'gyur ba spyi'i dgag dgos su gsungs la/ dge slong rnal 'byor spyod pa chos la chos kyi rjes su dran pa dang*/ dran pa dang*/ shes bzhin dang ldan pas/ mtshan nyid 'dzin pa'i chos gcig tu dkar ba dang*/ gnag pa dang*/ 'dren ma byas shing bsags pa/ sems kyis byas shing bsags pa/ lus ngag gnyis kyis bsam pa de rdzogs par byas pa ma lags sam/ de yin na las rnying pa las grub pa'i lus ni 'jog sems gsar pa'i rang gzugs/ sems las las/ las las las kyi 'bras bu rnam par smin pa 'byung gsung ba de/ mi dge ba phra mos ngan song phra mo shig dang*/ sro ma dang*/ yi dwags nus med phra mo dang*/ dmyal ba'i 'khor phra mo dag tu skye zhing*/ phra mo der skyes kyang bsam sbyor ngan pa che zhing*/

gdug pa'i las byas pas ngan song chen po rnams su skye bar nges pa 'di ni/ dge slong rnal 'byor spyod pa chos kyi rjes su blta ba rnams kyis mthong zhes gsungs pas/ lung dang rigs pa gang nyams su myong ba rnam pa gsum gyis khong du chud par byas nas spang bar bya ba ni/ bla ma'i sku gsung thugs kyi rnam par thar pa dang po la bslab par bya ba ste/ de yang 'di yod na 'di 'byung*/ 'di med na 'di mi 'byung ste/ 'di rnams spangs sam spong ba yod na/ bla ma dang mi 'bral ba yod la/ 'di ma spangs mi spong na bla ma dang 'bral bar 'gyur te/ dper na nged kyi ston pa thugs rje chen po 'di sngon byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pa na/ bgres mo skye ba lnga brgya'i bar du yum du gyur kyang*/ byang chub sems dpa' rab tu 'byung ba la brtse zhing phan par gyur pa'i blos rab tu 'byung bar ma gnang zhing*/ zhag gsum zan bcad pa'i las kyi rnam par smin pas de phyin chad sangs rgyas kyi yum du ma gyur zhing dbul zhing phongs pa sha stag tu gyur pa lta bu ste/ gnas dus kyis bskal pas shin tu yang nges pa yin no// des na skyes bu dam pa kun// dran dang shes bzhin bag yod pas// thub pas gsungs pa'i bcas pa dang*// skad cig tsam yang 'bral mi bya// shin tu phra mor bsam byas shing*// thub pa'i gsung dang 'gal byed pa// dmus long bsgyings pa'i gar stabs kyis// g.yang sa chen por lhung ba ltar// thub pa chen po 'od srung gi /dge slong sde snod gsum ldan pa// bsam gtan brtson pa'i yid can gyis// gcig pu dgon pa'i sa phyogs su// e la'i 'dab drung gnas bcas pas// mgo la shing gi yal gas thug /de la 'di skad tshig smras pa// thub pa chen po 'od srung gis// sems can ma yin srog med pa'i// shing la ci'i phyir bcas pa byas// snyam zhing brjod nas bcad pa yis// klu yi rgyal po e la'i 'dab// thub pa chen po'i drung du 'ongs// sangs rgyas chos ni shin tu zab// bdag gis rtogs par ma gyur pas// e la'i 'dab ma bcad pa yis// ngan 'gro'i gnas su lhung 'gyur zhes// ngu zhing 'o dod 'bod par gsungs// bu rang la snying brtse yod pa rnams// lus dang srog la mi blta bar// thub pa'i gsung dang 'gal mi bya// de ltar lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa dgag par bya ba spang ba/

dgag par bya ba'i bslab pa las dang nyon mongs pa spangs pas chog mod/ spyir mkhan po las thob pa'i chos gsum mi dgos/ bye brag tu ngur smrig la dgos pa med snyam na/ bcas pa de yang sgrub bcas gnyen po'i phyogs la bltas pas/ bla ma rin po che'i zhal snga nas/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i 'od zer gyis ma bskul na/ khyim na gnas pa la yid 'byung zhing rab tu 'byung ba la brod pa skye ba gtan mi srid gsungs pa dang*/ dkar po'i phyogs kyi bag chags kyi sa bon dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis sad par byed pa na/ rkyen dge ba'i bshes gnyen zhes grags pa dang*/ bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang*/ rgyal ba'i nyan thos pa dag ji snyed chos ston dang*// 'chad dang rigs pa ngag dang ldan par brjod pa dang*// mchog 'phags bde ba byed dang de yi 'bras thob pa// de dag kun kyang de bzhin gshegs pa'i skyes bu'i mthu// zhes pas/ spang bya bcom pa de yang gnyen po la ltos la/ gnyen po rgyud la skye ba yang spang bya spangs pa la ltos pa yin te lung las/ yul 'khor skyong rab tu byung ba dang*/ rgyal po ma skyes dgras zhus pa las kyang*/ nyon mongs pa gsum gyi rjes su 'brangs pa'i las mi dge ba rnam pa bcu rang gzhan thams cad yid gdung zhing skyo bar byed pa/ 'khor ba dang ngan song gi gzhir gyur pa 'di gcig tu sel gyis spong bar mi nus pas/ bdag skra dang kha spu bregs/ gos ngur smrig bgos nas/ dad pas khyim nas khyim med par rab tu byung bar bya'o snyam nas rab tu byung zhing*/ nyon mongs pa dang nyes pa thams cad kyi rang bzhin nam gzhir gyur pa'i khyim pa'i rtags yang dag par spangs shing*/ rab tu byung ba'i rtags ngur smrig gi rgyal mtshan yin pa la/ ngur smrig gi rgyal mtshan yang dag par blangs pa la/ 'di na skye bo mi mkhas pa kha cig rab tu byung ba'i rtags ma blangs kyang*/ nyon mongs pa'i rjes su 'brel ba'i las mi dge ba mtha' dag spong nus pa lta bu yod de/

slob dpon rgyal po ind+ra bho dhi lta bu yin snyam na/ de ni bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'chang chen po nyid kyi sprul pa rje btsun phyag na rdo rje yin par lung bstan cing*/ nyon mongs pa spong bar mi nus pa rnams la dkar po phyogs kyi bag chags kyi sa bon bzhag pa'i phyir dang*/ sa bon phyogs cig bcom pa'i phyir sprul pa yin te/ de yang ngur smrig gi rgyal mtshan dang*/ ngur smrig gi rgyal mtshan can rnams spyi gtsug gi nor bu 'chang ba yin no// de ltar yang*/ bcom ldan 'das kyis sa'i snying po 'khor lo bcu pa las/ tshal bu tsam zhig 'dzin pa la// ston pa'i 'du shes mi skyed cing*// sdang zhing mtshang rnams 'bru ba ni// zhes gsungs so// de yang dper na rlung dang mkhris pa dang bad kan gyi nad kyis btab pa la/ de'i gnyen po'i rdzas/ nad gsum gyi gnyen por gyur pa/ thub pa dus gsum du gshegs shing bzhugs pa rnams kyis byin gyis brlabs shing sngags kyis btab pa zos shing longs spyad na/ nad kyi sdug bsngal dang bral ba bzhin du/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i chos gos ngur smrig 'phags pa rnams kyi rgyal mtshan yin te/ de ltar yang*/ dpal gyi lha mo'i dam tshig gi mdo las kyang*/ chos gos ngur smrig 'di ni/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyis byin gyis brlabs shing 'phags pa rnams kyi rgyal mtshan yin no// zhes pa la sogs pa yon tan dpag tu med pa gsungs pa dang*/ bcom ldan 'das bstan pa'i bdag po 'di rab tu gshegs pa'i dus kyi tshe/ sngon gyi sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis na bza' ji lta bu mnabs pa yin snyam du dgongs pa las/ gnas gtsang ma'i ris kyi lha rnams kyis/ bcom ldan 'das sngon gyi sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis ni na bza' chos gos ngur smrig mnabs so// zhes zhus shing dgongs nas/ lha'i dbang po rngon pa'i gzugs can las chos gos ngur smrig gi rgyal mtshan blangs nas/

rab tu byung dang dka' thub mdzad// bdud kyi sde rnams 'joms pa dang*// byang chub mchog tu sangs rgyas shing*// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang*// slob ma'i tshogs rnams bsdu ba dang*// snying por gyur pa'i ston pa'i 'khor// thams cad rab tu byung nas kyang*// nyon mongs bdud kyi sde bcom zhing*// bud shing zad pa'i me bzhin du// mya ngan 'das pa thams cad kun// rgyu las 'bras bu nges pa'i phyir// med na mi 'byung nges sam snyam// bde gshegs lung gi grwa zur tsam// khyed kyis bskul nas bris pa yin// rigs pa 'di 'dra ba yang yod de/ gal te sangs rgyas kyis byin gyis rlabs pa dang*/ de'i bstan pa rin po che dang*/ tshul khrims rin po che las ngur smrig gi rgyal mtshan ma byung na bstan pa nub pa'i dus su yang ngur smrig gi rgyal mtshan yod par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro// nyams su myong ba yang yod de/ rab tu byung ba rnams kyi ngur smrig gi rgyal mtshan la nyes pa rab 'bring rnam pa gsum po gang byung ba rmi lam nyams su byung yang*/ rab tu byung ba'i srog de nyid yin pa'i phyir nyes pa rab 'bring rnam pa gsum 'byung bar snang ba'i phyir ro// chos kyi rgyal po sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi bka' rtags kyi phyag rgya 'di/ snying rje chen po padma dkar po las/ sems can gang gis tha na sor bzhi tsam gcig yan chad 'dzin yang*/ de la sngon gyi las kyi rnam par smin pa ma gtogs par mi ma yin pa'i gnod pa mi 'byung ba dang*/ theg pa gsum gyis mya ngan las ma 'das na zhes/ de bzhin gshegs pa nyid kyis dbu bsnyung bzhes pa'i phyir/ rgyu las dang nyon mongs pa bcom zhing*/ lam 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad rgyud la bskyed nas/ 'bras bu 'gog pa'i bden pa byang chub rnam pa gsum mngon du byed pa 'di yang*/ skyabs dkon mchog gsum yin pa'i phyir nges pa kho na'o// de ni spang bya gnyen pos bcom pa ngur smrig la ltos pa lta bu dang*/

gnyen po rgyud la skyes pas spang bya shugs kyis spong zhing yon tan ngur smrig gi rgyal mtshan thob pa/ ye shes khong du chud pa bsnyen pa rdzogs pa lta bu gang dang yang 'gal ba med pa spyir bstan nas/ da ni rim gyis skye ba brjod par bya ste/ bcom ldan 'das kyis/ sdig pa ci yang mi bya ste// dge ba phun sum tshogs par spyad// rang gi sems ni yongs su 'dul// 'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin// zhes gsungs pa las/ de yang dang po sdig pa mi byed pa las dge ba skye/ dge bas sems 'dul zhes pa ni 'di nyid kyi 'brel yin la/ sangs rgyas bstan pa zhes pa ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyis zhes gsungs so// 'o na spang bya spong ba gnyen po la ltos pa'i phyir/ lnga sde bzang po ye shes khong du chud pas zer ba dang mi 'gal lam snyam na/ de gnyen po dge ba'i stobs 'phel bas spang bya spang ba'i bral 'bras stobs che ba la bzhag pa yin gyi/ rgyu sdig pa mi dge ba ma spangs pa las 'bras bu dge ba mi 'byung ba'i phyir dang*/ ston pa'i bstan pa rin po che rnam pa gsum rim gyis bzhag pa dang 'gal bar 'gyur te/ de ltar yang*/ 'dod chags dang*/ zhe sdang dang*/ gti mug rnam pa gsum/ 'dod chags dang bral bas sems rnam par grol ba dang*/ shes rab rnam par grol ba'o zhes gsungs pas/ mdor na rim gyis pa kho na ste/ cig car ba ni mi srid gsungs so// 'di la nyams su len lugs rnam pa gnyis te/ nyan thos kyi theg pa khams gsum gyi 'khor bas ni skrag cing bred/ dge ba'i rtsa ba ci byed kyang dge ba des rang nyid zhi ba de ni sgrub/ 'khor bar skye ba'i rgyu sred pa 'ba' zhig tu ni go sred dang bral la yang srid med pa'i nges pa'i shes pa skyes nas/ khams gsum gyi 'dod chags dang bral ba'i dgra bcom pa chen po de gcig pus chog pa/ zhi ba yang srid med pa'i dbyings su 'jug pa ni/ nyan thos kyi gzhung lugs su gshis kyis gnas pa yin la/

dang po 'dod chags spang bar bstan pa dang*/ bla ma'i sku gsung thugs kyi rnam par thar pa gnyis la bslab par bya ba/ byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa ni/ zhe sdang 'dod chags dang bral ba las byams pa snying rje byang chub kyi sems zhe sdang dang bral ba'i 'bras bur skyes nas/ de yang sems can thams cad bde ba dang ldan par 'dod pa'i byams pa/ sdug bsngal dang bral bar 'dod pa'i rgyu gsum/ byang chub rnam pa gsum las/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par bya ba'am/ de la 'god pa'i byang chub kyi sems dang*/ bde ba dang ldan par byed pa'i dge ba phun sum tshogs par spyad pa dang*/ sdug bsngal dang bral bar byed pa/ sdig pa ci yang mi bya ba dang*/ sems 'dul ba byang chub thob par byed pa ste/ de ltar yang*/ bcom ldan 'das kyis/ byang chub nam mkha'i mtshan nyid de// rtogs pa thams cad spangs phyir ro// zhes pa la sogs pa dpag tu med pa gsungs pa'i phyir ro// de la 'di dag kyang gnas lugs rnam pa gsum du gnas shing*/ gnas lugs de la nyams len gyi gnad rnam pa gsum gyis nyams su blang bar bya ba ni/ theg pa chen po mtha' dag gi man ngag gi gnad shin tu zab pa yin no// gnas lugs gsum po gang zhe na/ zhe sdang 'dod chags dang gnas skabs su bral bas/ bral ba'i 'bras bu byams pa snying rje byang chub kyi sems skye la/ sems de bskyed pa'i cho ga ji ltar sngon gyi sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'/ chos skyong ba'i srung ma bla ma dam pa dang bcas pa dpang por bzhag nas/ tshe thog ma med pa nas/ mtha' ma da lta phan chad kyi dge ba'i rtsa bas/ sngon gyi sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' chen po rnams kyis ji ltar thugs bskyed cing dam bcas nas/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa spyad de sangs rgyas pa de bzhin du/ nga yang byed do zhes dam bcas/ khas blangs/ mna' bor ba yin no// snying rus chen pos dpa' bo g.yul du 'jug pa lta bu'i sems de skyes pa las/

se skor log gis bsam mno la zhugs pas gong ma rnams kyis ma bsgral ba sgrol/ ma grol ba dgrol/ dbugs ma phyung ba dbugs dbyung*/ mya ngan las ma 'das pa mya ngan las 'da' bar bya bar thugs skyes shing mdzad pa/ de ltar mdzad nas sangs rgyas par 'dug pas/ ngas kyang de ltar bya'o snyam du bsams nas/ yang dam bcas pa'i tshig de la dpyod par byed de/ ma bsgral ba zhes bya ba ni khams gsum gyi 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen po yin la/ de las sgrol ba ni rgyu las dang nyon mongs pa las brgal na/ 'bras bu sdug bsngal las bsgral bas/ las dang nyon mongs pa las bsgral bar bya'o snyam pa dang*/ nyon mongs pa'i 'ching ba las ma grol ba dgrol bar bya'o snyam pa dang*/ dbugs ma phyin pa ni 'dir sdug bsngal spyi dang*/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas 'khor ba'i 'jigs pas skrag pa las chos thams cad gdod ma nas nye bar zhi ba dang*/ lhun gyis grub pa'i 'gro ba'i don rtsol sgrub med par 'byung bas dbugs dbyung ba dang*/ mya ngan las ma 'das pa rnams yongs su mya ngan 'da' bar bya ba ni/ gtsang bdag bde dang rtag nyid dang*// yon tan pha rol phyin pa 'bras// zhes bcom ldan 'das rje btsun byams pas gsungs pa/ ston pa chen po nyid kyis nges pa'i don gyi chos kyi 'khor lo mya ngan las 'das pa chen por sangs rgyas pa'i tshul lugs gsungs pa 'di yin pas 'di la dgod par bya'o// zhes dam bcas pa yin pas/ 'di ni bdag gi rang bzhin nam byed pa'am chos yin no snyam pas/ dam bca' ba bzhi po la dam bcas pa'o// de yang rnam pa gsum du gnas te/ ma bsgral ba sgrol ba dang*/ ma grol ba dgrol ba gnyis ni lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa/ dbugs ma phyin pa dbugs 'byin par byed pa ni lhag pa sems kyi bslab pa/ mya ngan las ma 'da' ba mya ngan las 'das pa chen po la dgod pa ni lhag pa shes rab kyi bslab pa/ 'di gsum char byang chub kyi sems kyis dbang byas pa ni byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa'am tshul khrims/

dus de ring nas bzung nas rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ma thob kyi bar du/ rang gi lus sam srog gam/ dam pa'i chos kyang btang bar bya'o snyam pa'i dam bcas/ ma chags par gtong ba ni lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa yin pa las/ dam bcas pa yin yang phyi yul dang nang sems can la chags pa che 'bring chung gsum mtho dman rnam pa sna tshogs ci rigs par skye ba/ de'i gnyen po dam pa'i chos 'dul bar sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis/ 'dul ba'i thabs dpag tu med par gsungs pa dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod chen po rnams su yang mngon gyur byed pa dang bcas pa dang*/ sa bon bag chags dang bcas pa spong ba'i thabs rnam pa sna tshogs kyis spong bar bstan te/ sa bcu'i dbang phyug chen po rnams la yang*/ shes bya'i sgrib par ming btags pa'i nyon mongs pa yod de/ gnyen po rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin yin zhes pa dang*/ bla ma sangs rgyas thams cad kyis byin gyis rlobs dgos pa'i phyir dang*/ sgrib pa de spangs nas de gzod thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi ye shes thob ces gsungs pa'i phyir dang*/ sgrib pa de dang bral ba'i 'bras bu stobs bcu dang*/ mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang*/ ma 'dres pa'i chos bco brgyad/ bral ba'i yon tan sum cu rtsa gnyis zhes/ bcom ldan 'das rje btsun byams pas gsungs pa'i phyir dang*/ rdo rje gdan byang chub kyi shing drung du nyon mongs pa'i bdud de gzod bcom pa yin zhes gsungs pa'i lhag pa'i tshul khrims kyi bslab pa ni sangs ma rgyas kyi bar du bsrung dgos shing*/ sangs rgyas nas shin tu rnam par dag pa tshul khrims kyi phung por tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa rdzogs pas/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub yin par the tshom dang som nyi med do// de yang bcom ldan 'das kyis ltung ba byung ba'i nyes dmigs byang chub rnam pa gsum gyi lam la sgrib pa'am/ bar du gcod par 'gyur bar mkhas pa rnams kyis dgongs shing dpag tu med pa bshad pa yin no// nyon mongs pa de dang bral ba'i yon tan gzhan yang sa nas sar 'phar ba dang*/

gtong ba dang yongs su gtong ba chen po la sogs pa bral ba dang rnam par smin pa'i yon tan gyi skur 'grub tshad mtha' dag lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa'i 'bras bu lag rjes yin no// lhag pa sems kyi bslab pa ni/ sngar gong du smos pa'i bsam pa de lta bu smon pa byang chub kyi sems bskyed nas gzod 'jug pa'i sdom pa blang dgos te/ de yang skyes bu dam pa 'ga' zhig gis/ gong du smos pa'i smon pa nyid 'jug pa yin no gsungs pas de'i rjes su 'jug pa yod de/ dper na ngas dge 'dun la khyod la go ba med ces pa'i tshig gnad du/ sum brgya ba'i mchod brjod gsang ba 'dus pa'i 'dul ba yin smras pas der 'dzin pa lta bu yin no// smon pa 'jug pa yin na/ 'jug pa'i cho ga gzhan du 'byung bar mi rigs te/ smon pa gcig pus chog par thal ba'i phyir dang*/ gong ma rnams kyis gsungs pa thams cad dang 'gal bar 'gyur ba'i phyir ro// khyad par yang 'di lta bu yod de/ smon pa ni bsam pa byang chub kyi sems bskyed la/ sems de khyad par du byed pa'i bslab bya de bsrungs pas bsam pa de nyid 'grub la/ bsam pa de nyid sgrub pa/ 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po'i bu btsas ma thag pa ma la sogs pa rnams kyis de nyid chud ma zos pa 'grub pa lta bu/ 'jug pa byang chub kyi sems ni/ dge ba chos sdud/ sems can don byed/ sdom pa'i tshul khrims rnam pa gsum sems dang sems las byung ba'i tshul du mi len te/ sdom pa'i sems gcig tu bsgrub cing len pa yin te/ dge slong gi sdom pa blangs pas/ dge slong gi bslab pa thams cad blangs pa ro gcig pa dang 'dra bar/ sdom pa thams cad kyang de dang 'dra bas bsod nams rgyun chags kyang 'byung ba yin no// de ltar gyur na byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims kyi sdom pa gcig pu blangs pas spang bya thams cad spong ba dang*/ yon tan thams cad kyi rdzogs tshul 'di gcig pus chog pa las snga ma smos ci dgos snyam na/

lag rjes rnam pa gsum du gnas pa las gol nas/ la la na re mi dge ba byas pa byang chub kyi lam yin te/ ded dpon thabs la mkhas pa lta bu zer/ la la na re dge ba byas pa byang chub kyi lam yin te/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug gang la mos mos rdzogs pa'i lung 'dren/ rnam pa sna tshogs su snang zhing grub pa'i mtha' rnam pa sna tshogs su gnas pa/ dad pa ni yod/ thos pa ni chung*/ rang gi rjes su 'jug 'dod pa la gdams pa yin te/ bral ba dang rnam par smin pa'i yon tan de dang*/ da gzod smra bar 'gyur ba'i nye bar zhi ba bden pa'i don mthar thug chos kyi sku de'i phrin las/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bde ba dang ldan/ sdug bsngal dang bral/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub rin po che thob par byed pa'i phrin las lhun gyis grub la rgyun mi 'chad par 'byung ba ni/ 'jug pa byang chub kyi sems sam/ byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims kyi sdom pa ro gcig cing*/ gnyis su med par gyur pa'i lag rjes yin te/ 'bras bus rgyu dpag pa dang*/ rgyus 'bras bu dpag pa gnyis char la the tshom med par shes par bya ste/ de ni lhag pa sems kyi bslab pa'i lag rjes so// ༈ //lhag pa shes rab kyi bslab pa 'di la yang*/ shes rab bden don gtan la 'bebs/ zhes te shes rab stong pa nyid kyi mig yod na/ yon tan rgyu 'bras kyi rten 'brel go bar 'jig rten mgon po phag mo gru pa dang*/ rgyal ba'i gsung rab thams cad du gsungs kyang*/ 'dir bdag rgyu dang 'bras bu dang*// gzung ba dang ni 'dzin pa dang*// 'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa'i chos// stong par bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs// slob dpon 'phags pa la sogs pa// mkhas pa rnams kyis gtan la phab// 'di la yid ches byar rung ste// rdzogs sangs rgyas kyis lung bstan pa// 'phags pa klu sgrub yab sras yin// phyi ma snod bcud 'khor 'das kun// mig ser ldan pa'i skra shad bzhin// bden med bslu ba'i chos yin pas// dge sdig med par cog ger zhog

/sha bzan gro bo gsod na yang*// bsad sems med par ske ba chod// ces pa'i gdams ngag ston pa kun// slob dpon 'phags pa'i dbu ma dang*// rdzogs chen byar med phyag rgya che// rgyud la skyes pa yin re shig /gal te rgyud la skyes zhe na// nyon mongs spangs pa'i lag rjes su// rim pas skye bar gsungs pa brdzun// de yi lag len 'di ltar bya// de la spyir bslab pa rin po che rnam pa gsum skye ba'i gnyen po yin pas/ byang chub rnam pa gsum thob par byed pa'i lam du ji ltar byas kyang rung ste/ rang rgyud gcig gis bsdus pa dug gsum 'dul ba'i gnyen po yin pas/ nyon mongs pa gang che che spong bar byed pa'i thabs su bstan pas/ tshul de ltar nyams su blang bar bya ste/ de la rnam pa gnyis/ spyi'i rnam par bzhag pa gtsor bya ste/ lam tshang la ma nor rdzogs pa/ jo bo rje lha cig yab sras kyi rjes su 'brang ba/ lta ba rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag cing spros pa thams cad kyi mtha' dang bral ba dam pa'i chos dbu ma/ klu sgrub slob ma zla grags yin// de las brgyud pa'i gdams ngag gis// chos nyid bden pa rtogs par 'gyur// zhes pa lta ba'i gdeng de la byed/ tshul khrims rin po che mig gi 'bras bu bzhin du ni bsrung*/ ci dang ci byed pa thams cad la sbyor ba byang chub kyi sems/ dngos gzhi pha rol tu phyin pa rnam pa drug /rjes 'khor gsum yongs su dag pa mi dmigs pa'i bsngo ba/ byas pa thams cad chud mi zos pa/ skabs skabs su gsang sngags kyi man ngag bskyed rdzogs rnam pa gnyis kyang dam dum bsgom zhing bag chags 'jog pa/ lam tshang la ma nor rdzogs pa/ chos gru bzhi logs brgyad rtse mo dbal dang dgu/ nyams len gnad dang bcas pa/ ngo mtshar la rmad du byung ba/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i rgyu nges pa zhig 'di na gda'o// de yang spyir ston pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das des/

rgyu dang po byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed/ bar du bskal pa grangs med pa gsum du bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs bsags/ tha mar rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i 'bras bu/ bstan pa'i sgor zhugs tshad 'di rnams thams cad yin pas/ mos gus dang gdung shugs chen po yang yod/ stong gsum mi mjed 'di na gnas pa'i sems can rnams/ bcom ldan 'das stong gi gdul bya yin pas/ stong gsum 'di la 'khor ba dong sprugs// ༈ //e ma ho/ zhing 'di'i sems can thams cad la yang mos gus byed/ sems can thams cad la yang sangs rgyas kyi snying po yod gsungs pa 'di la yang dga' ba chen po skye bar 'dug sgos bye brag tu byang phyogs kha ba can gyi ljongs 'di dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsung rab rgyas pa'i gnas su ni gsungs/ yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i che shos ni lung bstan pa dpag tu med pas ni lung bstan pa 'di'i gdod mtha' bar gsum du bstan pa dar zhing rgyas par byed pa po gang yin/ soms dang*/ nged rnams kyi mgo dang*/ rkang pa dang*/ lag pa thams cad dum bu dum bur byas nas bskal pa'am bskal pa bas lhag par mchod kyang bka' drin gyi lan 'khor ba ni mi srid par nges so// sgos bye brag gi dbang du byas na jo bo chen po rje lha cig nged tshu rol mthong ba'i rten gyi gang zag rnams dang blo bstun nas rigs dang rus dang mkhas pa dang btsun pa dang*/ sgrub pa'i yon tan thams cad kyi pha rol tu phyin pa de la rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol mas khyod byang phyogs kha ba can du song dang*/ dge bsnyen ston pa gcig la bsten nas 'gro ba dpag tu med pa la phan thogs par 'gyur zhes gsungs pa des/ rje btsun ma 'phags ma tshad mar gyur pa dang*/ jo bo tshad mar gyur pa dang*/ u pa si ka tshad mar gyur pa dang*/ de'i rjes su 'jug pa thams cad tshad mar gyur pa yin pas/ nor bu rin po che ltar spyi gtsug gi rgyan du thogs shing rjes su 'brang bar bya'o// bye brag nyams myong dang mngon par rtogs pa skye ba'i dbang du byas na ni/

dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bor gyur pa/ 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po dpal ldan rin po che de'i thugs kyi dgongs pas ni/ sngar ji ltar snyan du gsol ba bzhin du so sor thar pa'i sdom pa byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa'i rten du bzhed pa yin te/ de yang kho bo jo bo chen po'i rjes su 'brang gsung*/ jo bo chen po rten can du bzhed par ni grags/ de la jo bo'i dgongs pa skong lugs rjes su 'jug pa rnams la tha dad pa mang po 'dug ste/ nyon mongs pa rnam pa gsum/ de'i rjes su 'brang ba'i las/ las dang nyon mongs pa gang gis spangs pa de thar bar 'gyur gyi/ ma spangs pa ni thar bar mi 'gyur ba'i phyir so sor thar pa zhes bya la/ de yang 'phags pa 'dul ba gtan la phab pa nye bar 'khor gyis zhus pa'i mdo las/ nyan thos kyi so so thar pa dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i so so thar pa zhes gsungs pas/ dang po gnas skabs kyi nyon mongs pa gsum ma spangs pa las/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par 'dod pa'i bsam pa de thob par byed pa la nyon mongs pa che 'bring chung gsum spong ba'i dam bca' dang*/ bdag med rnam pa gnyis rtogs par byed pa'i dam bca' mi skye ba lags sam/ de skyes na skye ba'i rten ma lags sam/ de lags na gnas pa'i rten du gyur pa ma lags sam/ shes bya'i sgrib pa shin tu cha phra ba byang chub kyi shing drung du rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gyis bcom nas thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes thob pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu'i ngo bor gnas par gsungs te/ de ltar yang*/ byang chub snying por bzhugs pa na// 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug dang*// dri ma sna tshogs gzhan dag kyang*// khyod kyi ye shes me yis bsregs// zhes pa dang*/ tshul khrims kyis ni zhi ba 'dod rnams 'phags par 'gyur// stobs bcu'i spyod yul gnas shing tshul khrims nyams pa med// ces gsungs pas/

nyon mongs pa rnam pa gsum gyis stong pa'i stong nyid de/ nyon mongs pa spangs pas mngon du gyur pa'i phyir/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyang so so thar pa'i sdom pa la brten cing bzhugs pas/ sangs rgyas kyang rten can du 'dod na/ gzhan lta smos kyang ci dgos te/ lam rim gyis bgrod pa'i phyir ro// 'di yang bla ma rin po che'i zhal snga nas/ sngags dang pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa thams cad las/ skyon shin tu chung ba phra mos kyang yon tan gyi tshogs rgya chen po 'gegs par byed de/ slob dpon 'phags pas rdza'i bum pa chung ngu gcig la chags pas/ gnod sbyin mo grub pa'i bar chad du gyur pa dang*/ mnga' bdag mai tri bas/ bla ma la yin min gyi the tshom skyes pas/ tshe 'dir mchog gi dngos grub thob pa'i bar chad du gyur pa dang*/ slob dpon chen po tog tse ba tshe rabs gong ma la mchil lham gon nas dri gtsang khang du phyin pas khyi rgod du gyur pa dang*/ slob dpon chen po nag po spyod pa bas bla mas za ma tog kha ma 'byed gsungs pa phye bas mkha' 'gro mas bkrongs pa dang*/ dge slong gcig dgra bcom pa thob par 'gyur ba'i nyin par zan spags zos pas/ sangs rgyas stong gi bstan pa la yang dgra bcom pa ma thob pa dang*/ ka lan ta ka'i bu bzang sbyin gyis 'jig rten skyon med pa'i dus su skyon phyung bas thub pa'i bstan pa skyon phyung ba la sogs pa nyes pa shin tu phra bas/ lam gong ma yon tan rlabs po che thams cad kyi bar du gcod par 'gyur te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis 'jam dpal rtsa ba'i rgyud nas/ tshul khrims 'chal la sngags 'grub par// rgyal ba rnams kyis ma gsungs te// mya ngan 'das grong 'gro ba ni// yul dang phyogs kyang ma yin no// zhes gsungs pas/ mdor bsdus pa'i gsung byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed nas/ bskyed rdzogs rnam pa gnyis sam/ sems nyid dri ma med pa la nyon mongs pa'i bag chags kyi ma gos par byas la/

dben pa'i gnas su snying stobs chen pos sgrub pa yun bsrings na/ skyon dag yon tan thams cad rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas su 'gyur gsung ngo*// chos 'di rnam pa thams cad kyang gzhi mal mal/ dog cam cam/ sangs rgyas sgam pos ma mdzad/ sems can sgrin pos ma bslad/ gshis sam babs kyis de ltar du gnas pa de/ thams cad mkhyen pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis mkhyen nas/ rjes su 'jug pa'i slob ma rnams la gsungs pa las/ chos kyi 'khor lo zhes rnam par grags pa yin pas/ khyed kyis bla ma dam pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi rnam par thar pa gnyis pa 'di la bslab par bya ste/ 'di yod na ni 'di 'byung la/ 'di med na 'di mi 'byung ba gnas dus kyis bskal pa dang ma bskal ba ni gong ma ltar shes par bya'o// rnam par thar pa gsum pa ni/ sems 'dul sangs rgyas bstan pa gzung*// nyes pa gsum dang bral ba'i yid// gzod nas zhi zhing ma skyes pa// lhun gyis grub cing rgyun mi 'chad// dus gsum khams gsum thams cad dang*// dbyer med gcig pa'i rang bzhin sku// nyon mongs gsum dang bral gyur cing*// yon tan gsum gyi lag rjes kyis// khams gsum 'khor ba'i sems can rnams// sde snod rin chen gsum po dang*// bslab pa gsum gyi 'khor lo 'di// skuu gsung thugs nyid mi zad pa// rgyan gyi 'khor los 'gro ba rnams// smin cing 'khor lor 'khor ba ni// bla ma sangs rgyas gong ma yi// rnam par thar pa gsum pa ste// khyed kyis 'di la bslab par bya// tshe thung nad mang rkyen ngan gyis// da ltar sems can thams cad slongs// ring po sdod pa'i long med pas// rnam gzhag kha ta rkyang pa yi// rjes su 'brang bar mi bya zhing*// sems nyid rnam dag dri ma med// nyes pa gsum dang bral ba de// byang chub sems kyis goms par bya// 'gro 'chag nyal 'dug thams cad du// skad cig tsam yang ma bral dang*// bla ma sangs rgyas gong ma dang*// skad cig tsam yang mi 'bral ba// gnas dang dus kyis ma bskal bas// bu 'bral ba med do thugs la zhog

/'jig rten mgon po rin chen gyis// sdig pa ci yang mi bya ste// dge ba phun sum tshogs par spyad// rang gi sems ni yongs su gdul// 'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin// zhes su gsungs pa'i gsung sgros 'di// zhabs tog can gyi slob ma yis// bskul nas kun gyi don du zhus// ji ltar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor ni// dpag tshad bzhi khri'i nam mkha' la// rgyu zhing 'khor bar gyur na yang*// 'dzam bu gling pa'i mi rnams kyi// so so'i ri yi rtse nas 'char// de bzhin thub pa chen po'i gsung*// zab cing rgya che mtha' med pa// rang rang blo dang mthun par snang*// 'jig rten mgon po rin chen gyi// thugs kyi dgongs pa mtha' med pa// bdag gis rtogs par ga la nus// 'on kyang bdag gi yi ge 'di// sems can ma lus khams rnams kyi// rgyu dang lam dang 'bras bu'i bar// gshis kyis 'gro ba'i tshul bstan pa// nor cing 'khrul pa ma mchis par// rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis// gnyid kyis log pa'i rmi lam du// dgyes shing shin tu dga' bar bstan// 'di ltar nyams su blangs gyur na// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro thams cad kyis// byin gyis rlob cing dgyes par nges// kun gyis thugs la bzhag par zhu// dge ba 'di yis 'gro ba kun// phyin ci log gi lam spangs shing*// rnam grol mchog la reg par shog /tshig gsum gnad kyi man ngag ces bya ba/ dka' ba dang du blangs/ theg pa phrag la khur/ lus srog gdon ltor btang*/ mnyes pa rnam pa gsum gyis bla ma dam pa mnyes par byas pa'i dpal bkra shis seng ges zhus pa rdzogs so// //

467) ༄// gzhi lam 'bras gsum gyi bstan bcos kun phan rin po che rgyal mtshan bya ba// oṃ swasti/ gang zhig sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa rdo rje 'chang gi sku// stobs dang mi 'jigs ma 'dres yon tan kun gyi pha rol phyin// bdud bzhi nyes pa'i tshogs 'joms dpa' bo 'gro ba'i gnyen gcig pu// dpal ldan phag mo gru pa bla ma rin po che la 'dud// bla ma dam pa'i gsung sgros rnams// dpag tu med pa gsan gyur kyang*// mos gus gdung bas ma ngoms pas// da rung bzhed pa'i don du bri// dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs ye shes ngo bor gyur pa/ 'gro ba'i mgon po dpal ldan rin po che'i zhal snga nas/ 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa'i chos thams cad rang gi sems/ sems gdod nas skye ba med pa nam mkha'i dkyil lta bu gsung ba de la/ cung zad cig rgyas par byas na/ spyir 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pas bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rang gi sems ma gtogs pa mi srid de/ de ltar yang*/ 'phags pa dpa' bar 'gro ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyi mdo las kyang*/ sems las ni las/ las las ni las kyi 'bras bu rnam par smin pa zhes gsungs pas/ sems nges par gyur pa'i rnam par shes pa/ des byas pa'i lus dang ngag dang yid kyi las/ de grub pa'am smin pa/ rnam par smin pa 'di 'ba' zhig tu 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pas bsdus pa'i chos thams cad ma 'dus pa med pa/ gzhi dang lam dang 'bras bu thams cad ma 'dus pa med pa/ gzung ba dang 'dzin pa dang gnyis kar gyur pa thams cad ma 'dus pa med par/ bde bar gshegs pa'i lung dang*/ mkhas pa rnams kyi rigs pa dang*/ rnal 'byor pa rnams kyi nyams su myong bas dpag tu med pa gsungs shing gtan la phab pa/ mkhas pa rnams kyis rtogs shing khong du chud pa yin la/ sems de nyid gdod nas skye ba med pa yin te/ gdod nas zhes pa'i sgra don la/ dang po nas zhes bya ba yin te/

sangs rgyas 'jig rten du byon rung ma byon rung*/ sems can khams gsum gyi 'khor bar 'khyams rung ma 'khyams rung*/ dang po nas gshis nyid ma skyes pa rtag pa nyid de/ sus kyang ma byas shing grub pa med pa/ nam mkha'i dpe bstan nas/ dkyil zhes bya ba ni/ bcom ldan 'das kyis/ phyi rol nam mkha' ma yin zhing*// sems kyi nam mkha'i dbus gnas pa// zhes gsungs pas/ phyi rol gyi nam mkha' ni mtha'/ sems kyi ngo bo ni dbus yin pas/ rgyud kyi rgyal po dpal gsang ba 'dus pa la sogs pa rnams su/ bcom ldan 'das kyi nam mkha'i dbyings kyi dbus gnas pa/ zhes pa la sogs pa gsungs pa'i don yang 'di yin te/ gzhi chos thams cad ma skyes pa/ skye ba med nye bar zhi ba/ smra bsam shes brjod las 'das pa/ zhes bya ba la sogs pa dpag tu med pa zhig bshad pa thams cad/ shes bya'i yul la kha phyir bltas pa/ tshig dang tha snyad kyi rjes su 'brangs pa/ mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i bla ma'i brgyud pa med pa/ nyams myong dang mngon par rtogs pa rgyud la ma skyes pa'i skyon yin la/ sems nyid gcig pu kun gyi sa bon/ 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad rang gi sems nyid/ sus kyang byas pa med par gdod nas lhun gyis grub pa ni/ gzhi'i gnas lugs so// gnas lugs de lta bu zhig yin pa/ ma rig pas ma rig pa/ mi shes pas gti mug can/ ma go bas go ba med pa/ ma rtogs pas rtogs pa med pa/ skye zhing 'jig pa la brten pas/ 'jig rten pa zhes bya la/ de ltar yang*/ bla ma rin po che'i zhal nas kyang*/ lar gyi 'dug tshul zhig ma shes na// ci byas 'khor ba'i gzhung lam yin// zhes gsungs pas/ sems rtogs pa shin tu gal che/ rtogs pa de la yang bla ma rtogs ldan zhig dgos te/ bla ma rin po che'i zhal snga nas/ bla ma la rtogs pa med na slob ma'i rgyud la rtogs pa skye mi nus/ brkos phor la ri mo med na tsha tsha la ri mo mi 'ong*/

bla ma bzang po gal che gsung*/ bcom ldan 'das dgyes pa rdo rje las kyang*/ gzhan gyis brjod min lhan cig skyes// gang du yang ni mi rnyed de// bla ma'i dus mtha' bsten pa dang*// rang gi bsod nams las shes bya// zhes gsungs pa dang*/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa las kyang*/ yon tan thams cad rab rdzogs kyang*// bla ma med na srid mthar min// skya ba 'dzin pa med pa yi// gru yis pha rol 'gro mi nus// zhes pa dang*/ dpal sdom pa 'byung ba'i rgyud nas kyang*/ mchod pa thams cad yongs spangs te// bla ma mchod pa brtsam par bya// de mnyes pa las dngos grub ni// kun mkhyen nyid ni thob par 'gyur// zhes gsungs pas/ bla ma med pa'i rdol bon kha nag la rtogs pa mi skye bar gsungs so// 'o na de tsam du gnad che ba'i bla ma de ji ltar bsten snyam na/ bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab tu bla ma bsten par bya ba'i thabs bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig gsungs pa dang*/ slob dpon bhi bhi lha'i bla ma lnga bcu par ji ltar bstan pa bzhin du nyams su blang zhing*/ 'phags pa sa bcu pa'i mdo las kyang*/ sa gsum la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems can la snying rje skye ste/ 'di rnams 'khor bar 'khyams shing sdug bsngal ba cis lan snyam du bsams pas/ sangs rgyas kyi ye shes ma rtogs pas lan par go /de su la rag las na/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen la rag las par go bas/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten pa'i phyir mgo dang rkang lag lus dang longs spyod thams cad gtong zhing*/ bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par byed cing bla ma mnyes par byed par gsungs pa dang*/ bla ma rin po che'i zhal snga nas kyang*/ yon tan rgyas par byed cing skyon dag shes// de 'dra'i bla ma srog gis gzung bar bya// zhes gsungs pas/ 'di yang tshad dang ldan pa'i bla ma dam pa de las/ tshig dang yi ge'i gdams ngag dang rjes su bstan pa yi ge'i ris su bris shing*/

be'u bum du bstar ba/ sbas shing gsang pa/ zab mo zab par grags pa ci la/ 'di gser zho gcig gis thob bam/ srang gcig dang srang brgyas thob bam/ mos gus kyi rnam gzhag phyag phyi dang*/ zhung zhung dang*/ ljab ljib kyi rnam par blo la len cing tshig tu klog pa dang*/ ngom po byed cing gzhan la bshad pas kyang*/ bla ma'i chos zab mo snying nas thugs la gnas pa/ smra ba dang*/ bsam pa dang*/ shes pa dang*/ brjod pa thams cad kyi yul las 'das pa/ thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes de len pa'i mos gus/ rang dang bla ma de gcig tu song ba gcig ma gtogs pa gzhan gang gis kyang mi rtogs par go /rang dang bla ma gcig tu song ba de go'am/ de ma go na snying gcig tu song ba la mi zer/ sku dang gsung dang thugs gcig tu gyur pa/ rgya dang rgya'i 'bur lta bur gyur na/ mos gus yin cing*/ zab mo de lon pa ma lags sam/ zab mo de lon na bcom ldan 'das kyis/ de bzhin nyid gcig shes na chos thams cad kyi mdo dang rgyas pa shes par 'gyur ro// zhes gsungs pa dang*/ 'jig rten khams ni stong dag tu// ngas ni mdo sde gang bshad pa// tshig 'bru tha dad don gcig yin// tshig gcig rnam par bsgom na ni// thams cad bsgom par 'gyur ba yin// zhes pa dang*/ bcom ldan 'das byang chub tu sangs rgyas nas/ brtse ba chen po rje btsun tshangs pa'i rgyal pos/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul ma btab pa las/ bcom ldan 'das kyis/ zab zhi spros bral 'od gsal 'dus ma byas// bdud rtsi lta bu'i chos shig khong du chud// ces gsungs pas/ chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong ji snyed cig gsungs pa thams cad brjod bya 'di kho na/ rtogs pa'i thabs 'ba' zhig tu nges pas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis lung bstan pa/ slob dpon dpa' bo'i zhal snga nas kyang*/ chos nyid rgyu mthun gsung rab bcu gnyis dang*// chos la skye 'gag med cing spros pa dben// de la dmigs te yon tan kun grub pa// legs bsgyur dam pa'i chos la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes gsungs pas/

brjod par bya ba'i don gyi bdag nyid/ rjod par byed pa tshig gi brda sprod pa'am/ rgyu mthun pa tsam du byas pas/ 'di ni mos gus tshad du bskyal ba 'ba' zhig gi spyod yul du gsungs pa nges so// de ltar bla ma tshad dang ldan pa la/ slob ma mos gus dang ldan pas/ sku gsung thugs gcig tu gyur pa'i mos gus kyis/ bla ma'i thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes dang gcig tu gyur pas/ rang gi sems rtogs pa'i mngon par rtogs pa rgyud la skye ste/ rtogs pa de yang rje btsun byams pa'i zhal snga nas/ dri bcas de bzhin nyid dang dri ma med// dri med sangs rgyas yon tan rgyal ba'i mdzod// ces gsungs pas/ bla ma'i byin rlabs zhugs kyang*/ slob ma lam gyis bsdus pa'i de bzhin nyid dri ma dang bcas pa yin te/ dri ma de yang gang zhe na/ mthong bas spang ba'am/ sgom pas spang ba rnam pa gnyis su 'dus la/ de gang yin yang sems can thams cad kyi gshis gnyid log par phyin ci log tu 'khrul ba/ 'dod chags dang zhe sdang gti mug phra ba dang rags par gnas pas mngon par mtho ba dang*/ nges par legs pa dang*/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes la sgrib pa yin pas/ 'phags pa dkon mchog sprin las/ byang chub snying por bzhugs pa na// 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug dang*// dri ma gzhan yang rnam mang po// khyod kyi ye shes me yis bsregs// zhes gsungs pas/ dri ma dang bcas pa'i de bzhin nyid kyi dri ma/ 'dod chags dang zhe sdang dang gti mug rnam pa gsum gyi gnyen po/ ma chags pa/ zhe sdang med pa/ gti mug med pa rnam pa gsum/ gong nas gong du 'phel zhing yangs pa dang rgya chen por gyur pas/ mthar thug rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sangs rgyas par bzhed de/ de yang bcom ldan 'das kyis/ sems can tha ma 'bring dang mchog gyur ji snyed pa// de kun ma rig las byung bde bar gshegs pas gsungs// zhes pa 'khor ba lugs 'byung du gsungs pa dang*/

ma rig pa de nyid kyi gnyen po smra bsam shes brjod kyi yul las 'das pa'i don/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las/ ye shes tshul sgo thabs dang rtsa ba ji snyed pa// de kun shes rab pha rol phyin pa mchog las byung*// zhes pas/ 'khor ba lugs ldog rgyu mtshan dang*/ gnad ka rtsa ba gti mug gi gnyen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i don rtogs pa dgos la/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i mig med na/ lam gyi ye shes dang 'bras bu'i ye shes rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid/ stobs bcu dang*/ mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang*/ ma 'dres pa'i chos mngon du mi 'gyur zhing*/ dus gsum la chags pa dang thogs pa med pa'i ye shes ma thob pas/ dkon mchog gsum rgyun chad cing sku gsung thugs mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor los sems can gyi don byed pa yang mi 'byung bas/ rtogs pa'i don smra bsam shes brjod las 'das pa'i ji lta ba'i don rtogs kyang*/ dri ma dgag par bya ba'i bslab pa dang*/ dri ma dang bral ba bsgrub par bya ba'i bslab pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i mkhyen pa'i ye shes/ stobs bcu'i rang bzhin/ 'gro ba thams cad kyi bde skyid/ 'phags pa rnams nges par 'byung ba/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob par 'gyur ba/ rgyu dang 'bras bu'i rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba phra ba yin la/ des shin tu phra ba'i nyes pa byung yang*/ ye shes dang*/ ye shes chen po dang*/ rang gzhan thams cad kyi don 'grub pa'i bar du gcod par 'gyur ba/ 'phags pa dgra bcom pa nag po la bya rog zhar ma 'dra zhes lkog 'bug byas pas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis skye ba lnga brgyar bya rog zhar mar skye bar dbu bsnyung bzhes shing lung bstan pa dang*/ dge 'dun gyi zhal ta ba zhig gis/ dgra bcom pa zhig la bran mo'i bu zhes brjod pas/ skye ba lnga brgya'i bar du bran mo'i bur gyur cing*/ dgra bcom pa thob pa'i srid pa tha ma'i bar du yang*/

bran mo'i bur gyur pa la sogs pa sgrib pa myur ba'i chos spang bar bstan pas/ 'di 'dra ba'i chos la sa bcu'i dbang phyug chen po rnams kyang rdugs te/ sangs rgyas nyag gcig gi spyod yul yin pas/ 'dul ba la bslab pa'i gzhi 'cha' bar mdzad pa dang*/ 'dul ba'i sde snod las thams cad mkhyen pa la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes gtan la phab pa lags pas/ dge slong dang dge tshul lam byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa la sogs pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes thob par 'dod pas tshul khrims la bslab par bya ba gal shin tu che ste/ de ltar yang*/ bcom ldan 'das kyis/ tshul khrims kyis ni zhi ba 'dod rnams 'phags par 'gyur// stobs bcu'i spyod yul gnas shing tshul khrims nyams pa med// ces gsungs pas/ ltung ba sde lnga rtsa bar gyur pa'i ltung ba byung na/ mgo chad pa la shi gson gyi ming med pa dang 'dra bar dkar po'i chos thams cad mi skye ba'i chos can yin zhing*/ ltung ba gzhan gang yang rung ba zhig byung yang dge 'dun gyi las brgya rtsa gcig gam/ dge 'dun gyi bya ba dang byed pa'i las dkar po'i chos gong nas gong du khyad par gyur pa'i thams cad byar mi btub cing sgrib pa dang*/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi lam la sgrib cing byang chub thob pa'i bar chad du gyur pa dang*/ bla na med pa'i 'bras bu rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi lam dang*/ 'bras bu'i bar du gcod pa chen por 'gyur bas las dang lam la sgrib pa dang*/ sems can dmyal ba dang*/ yi dwags dang*/ dud 'gro'i skye gnas su lhung bas ngan song gsum du skye ba dang*/ dkar po'i chos thar pa dang*/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes thob pa/ klog pa dang*/ bsam gtan gyi 'khor lo mi khom zhing*/ phyin ci log gi bya ba dang byed pas g.yengs par gyur/ bya dang byed pa mang ba dang*/ bla ma dang mkhan po dang*/ slob dpon dang*/ chos dang mthun pa'i dam pa rnams dang*/ lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten thams cad ma dad cing zhabs 'dren par gyur pas/

gzhan ma dad par 'gyur ba'i nyes dmigs dgag pa'am/ spang bar bya ba'i bslab par bcas pa 'di yang*/ bcom ldan 'das kyis sngon 'das pa'i dus dang*/ ma 'ongs pa'i dus dang*/ da ltar gyi dus nye ba'am ring ba thams cad du/ 'gro ba rigs drug gis bsdus pa'i sems can/ ngan par song zhing nyes pa'i tshogs can/ 'di dang 'di ni lus dang ngag dang yid kyi las 'di dang 'di 'dra ba byas pa las gyur pa des na/ dge slong dag khyed kyis spang bar bya'o zhes dgag par bya ba'i bslab par bcas pa dang*/ yang dge slong dag nga sngon byang chub sems dpar gyur ba na/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug la tshul 'di ltar spyad cing nyams su blangs pas/ ngas lam gyi yon tan thams cad mngon du byas shing rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob bo zhes skyes pa'i rabs lnga brgya gsungs shing de 'dul bar bstan pa dang*/ mi 'khrugs pa dang 'od dpag med// gzhan yang sangs rgyas mang po dang*// sangs rgyas 'di dag smos pa kun// byang chub sems dpar gyur pa dang*// rang sangs rgyas dang nyan thos tshogs// legs par spyad pa thams cad la// bdag nyid chen po 'di dag gis// lus dang ngag dang yid kyi las// dge bar gyur pa 'di spyad pas// 'bras bu 'di ltar gyur pas na// dge slong de la khyed kyis kyang*// nan tan chen pos bslab bo zhes// sgrub pa'i bslab par bcas pa yin// dgag dang sgrub pa'i bslab pa 'di// rgyal ba rnams kyis bcas pa la// bcas pa dang ni rang bzhin gyi// dbye ba mkhan rnams ji ltar mdzad// legs par dgongs dang dam pa kun// tshe gcig skyes pa'i lus po 'di// sha rus dum bur gyur kyang bla// skyob pa bcom ldan 'das kyi gsung*// de dang 'gal bar su zhig byed// stobs bcu mchog ldan 'gro ba'i mgon// shākya'i rgyal po bcom ldan gyis// legs par gsung ba dam pa'i chos// 'khor ba lugs 'byung lugs ldog gi /gzhi yi gnas lugs bstan pa yis// lam dang 'bras bu'i gnas lugs kyang*// rgyu yis 'bras bu dpag pa dang*// 'bras bu yis kyang rgyu dpag pa// gsal bar gyur pa bcom ldan gyis// mya ngan 'das pa chen por gsungs// spyi yi rnam par gzhag pa'o// sgos bye brag tu rten gyi gang zag rnal 'byor pa zhig gis nyams su blang ba'i rim pa/

lam bslab pa rin po che rnam gsum ltar nyams su blang bar bya ste/ de yang med na mi 'byung ba'i rgyu 'bras/ tshul khrims med na ting nge 'dzin mi 'byung*/ ting nge 'dzin med na yang dag pa'i shes rab rgyud la mi skye ste/ de ma skyes na tshul khrims kyi phung po dang*/ ting nge 'dzin gyi phung po dang*/ shes rab kyi phung po dang*/ rnam par grol ba'i phung po dang*/ rnam par grol ba'i ye shes gzigs pa'i mthar thug pa mi thob pas/ gsum po 'di la ji bzhin du bslab par bya'o// de ltar yang*/ lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa ni gtsor nyon mongs pa 'dod chags kyi gnyen po/ lhag pa ting nge 'dzin gyi bslab pa ni gtsor nyon mongs pa zhe sdang gi gnyen po/ lhag pa shes rab kyi bslab pa ni gtsor nyon mongs pa gti mug gi gnyen po yin la/ de yang rten gyi gang zag so so'i rig pa tha dad pa dang*/ sngon gyi sbyangs pa tha dad pa dang*/ byang chub gsum gyi 'bras bu tha dad pa'i bye brag gis nyams len tha dad par song ste/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa rnams kyis ni/ 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen por ni mthong*/ sdug bsngal de grub par byed pa'i rgyu 'dod chags yin pas khams gsum gyi 'dod chags dang bral nas dgra bcom par 'gyur ba grub ste/ de ltar yang*/ sred dang bral la yang srid med// 'dod pa med pas mya ngan 'das// zhes pas/ lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa gtso bor gyur pa yin la/ byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa ni byams pa snying rje byang chub kyi sems gtso bo dang*/ gzhir gyur pa mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa la 'bras bur sgrub pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis/ snying brtser ldan zhing byams phyir dang*// sems dge ba la nyes med pas// snying rje gtso bor gyur pa dang*/ theg pa chen po gsang sngags kyi rnal 'byor pa cig car du 'jug pa sems mngon par rtogs pa'i shes rab skye ba dang*/

lnga sde bzang po ye shes khong du chud pas bsnyen pa rdzogs pa la sogs pa/ de gsum char yang bcom ldan 'das kyi gsung rab tu gsungs shing*/ de ltar rtsod pa'i gzhir gyur yang 'gal ba med de/ tshul khrims bsrungs pas ting nge 'dzin skye/ ting nge 'dzin de la yang dag pa'i shes rab skyes pa/ 'phags pa dga' bo lta bu dang*/ khams gsum gyi sems can la tshad med pa'i snying rje chen po skyes shing*/ de rdzogs pa'i byang chub la 'god pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed pas/ rang gzhan smin cing grol bar gyur na/ tshul khrims kyis smin cing grol bar 'gyur bar go bas/ de 'ba' zhig nyams su len pas/ gnyis la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' mi 'khrugs pa dang*/ da ltar gyi byang chub sems dpa' rab tu byung ba rnams lta bu dang*/ dang por yang dag pa'i shes rab yang dag pa'i ye shes khong du chud pas bsnyen par rdzogs shing*/ ting nge 'dzin la dbang bsgyur ba lnga sde bzang po lta bu dang*/ slob dpon chen po tog tse ba lta bu ste/ 'di rnams kyang kha cig ni ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyu tshul khrims/ 'bras bu shes rab/ kha cig ni gzhi shes rab/ 'bras bu tshul khrims dang ting nge 'dzin/ kha cig ni gzhi tshul khrims/ 'bras bu ting nge 'dzin dang shes rab yin par bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab tu bsam gyis mi khyab cing dpag tu med pa zhig gsungs kyang*/ rgyus pa'i sna phag zes mtshon pa dang 'dra bar sbyangs pa dang las 'phro'i stobs kyis dang po kho na gang yang rung bas mtshon nas bslab pa gsum char nyams su len par dgos par nges te/ sangs rgyas zag pa med pa'i phung po lnga'i rang bzhin yin pa'i phyir dang*/ bslab pa gsum mthar phyin cing de'i lag rjes sangs rgyas yin pa'i phyir dang*/ bla ma rin po che'i bzhed pas stong pa nyid rtogs pa'i rgyud tshod mtho yang rung*/ dma' yang rung ste ji lta ba mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi cha stong nyid rtogs pa'i shes rab yin la/

ji snyed pa mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi cha/ rgyu 'bras kyi rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba/ mi dge ba las sdug bsngal 'byung ba dang*/ dge ba las bde ba 'byung ba nyams su myong zhing go ba cung zad byung ba des dpags nas/ dpag tu med pa zhig mngon du gyur pas rang gi srog dang yang bsdos nas bslab pa gsum char nyams su blang ba la 'bad par bya'o// 'di yang don bsdu na/ bcom ldan 'das kyis/ 'dod chags 'dod chags dang bral bas sems rnam par grol ba dang*/ shes rab rnam par grol bar 'gyur ba dang*/ zhe sdang 'dod chags dang bral bas sems rnam par grol ba dang*/ shes rab rnam par grol bar 'gyur ba dang*/ gti mug 'dod chags dang bral bas sems rnam par grol ba dang*/ shes rab rnam par grol bar 'gyur ro// zhes gsungs pas/ sde snod gsum dang bslab pa gsum/ gsum gsum gyi dbye bas phye na dgu'am/ chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong du 'gyur te/ rnal 'byor pa lag len du byed na phyi yul lam/ nang sems can nam/ chags pa'i yul gang la chags shing zhen pa skye ba'i gnas/ grogs sam/ dus sam/ yo byad la sogs pa 'di la chags pa skye na nyan thos kyi rnal 'byor pa yin nam/ byang chub sems dpa'i rnal 'byor pa yin nam/ gsang sngags kyi rnal 'byor pa yin nam/ 'jig rten mgon po phag mo gru pa'i jo sras rnal 'byor pa zhig yin/ yang zhe sdang 'dod cing zhe sdang la chags pas/ zhe sdang skye ba'i yul/ gnas sam dus sam/ grogs sam/ yo byad la sogs pa 'di la zhe sdang skye na/ rnal 'byor pa de bzhi gang yin nam/ yang gti mug skye ba'i gnas thos bsam sgom gsum gyi shes rab can mi gnas pa/ 'jig rten 'di la mngon par zhen cing 'dod yon chu bzhin du 'thung ba/ bslab pa nyams pa/ ltung ba pham par gyur pa'i khyus 'tsho ba/ skyes bu dam pa la gshe skur 'debs shing log par lta ba'i gnas sam/ ston pas sngags pa ma yin pa'i nyes pa'am/

ltung ba'am/ shes rab nyams par byed pa'i grogs sam/ gnas skabs 'ga' zhig tu legs par spyod kyang*/ dus skabs 'ga' zhig tu nyes par 'gyur ba'i dus sam/ ston pas ma gnang zhing nyon mongs pa dang rnam par rtog pa 'ba' zhig bskyed par byed pa'i rdzas yo byad kyi dngos po/ thos bsam sgom gsum gyi shes rab nyams shing na smad par byed pa de lta bu rnams la/ nyan thos kyi rnal 'byor pa yin nam/ byang chub sems dpa'i rnal 'byor pa yin nam/ gsang sngags kyi rnal 'byor pa yin nam/ 'jig rten mgon po phag mo gru pa'i jo sras rnal 'byor pa yin nam/ gang yin yang phyar phyor ram/ za zi byas pas mi phan/ sdang ba'i dgra dang thug pa yin/ gtan gyi bde skyid 'chor ba yin/ so nam zhib tig du byed dgos pa yin/ bzhi po gang yang rung ba gcig gis 'dod chags gsum po dang bral bar byas nas/ de gsum gyis ma bcings pa'i sems 'dod chags kyi zhags pas ma bcings pa/ zhe sdang gi zhags pas ma bcings pa/ gti mug gi zhags pas ma bcings pa/ ma bcings pas rnam par grol bar gyur pa/ nyon mongs pa dang nye ba'i nyon mongs pa bral ba/ las su rung ba/ ci byar btub pa zhig 'ong ste/ sems de ni lhag pa'i sems/ ting nge 'dzin bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i gzhi'am sgor gyur pa/ gzungs dang bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rnam par thar pa thams cad kyi gzhir gyur pa yin te/ de ltar yang*/ bcom ldan 'das kyis/ bsam gtan gyis ni 'dod pa'i yon tan smad par 'dor// rig dang mngon par shes dang ting 'dzin mngon par sgrub// zhes gsungs pas/ sems rnam par grol ba 'di yon tan thams cad kyi gzhi'am sgo'am/ 'byung gnas su gyur pa yin te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang rdo rje'i gdan byang chub kyi shing drung du/ thugs 'di la gnas nas/ thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi ye shes brnyes pa dang*/ bya rgod kyi phung po'i ri la nyid kyis gdan seṅge'i khri bshams nas/

ting nge 'dzin 'di la mnyam par bzhag nas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gsungs pa dang*/ rtswa mchog gi grong khyer shing sā la drung gi tshal du ting nge 'dzin 'di la mnyam par bzhag nas mya ngan las 'das pa yin zhes/ bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab tu gsungs shing*/ mkhas pa rnams kyis nges par mdzad na/ kye ci ka sems nyid don dam pa'i bden pa rtogs shing mngon du gyur pa'i rnal 'byor pa nyon mongs pa gsum gyi zhags pas bcings pa'i 'ching ba las grol zhing*/ gcod par byed pa'i mthu med na/ sems rnam par grol ba'i yon tan gyi tshogs dpag tu med pa ji ltar sgrub na ang ge 'o na sems nyid don dam pa'i bden pa ni mthong*/ skye ba ni mi len/ shi bas 'khrul pa'i bag chags ni 'dzad snyam na/ sa bcu'i byang chub sems dpas kyang de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu ni ma thob/ ma thob pas thams cad mkhyen par ma gyur/ thams cad mkhyen pas 'dul ba'i bslab pa'i gzhi 'cha' ba'i nus pa med pa dang*/ rgyu mtshan de nyid kyis tshul khrims legs par bsrung dgos pa dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshul khrims kyi phung po rdzogs dgos pa dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i yon tan thams cad thob par bya dgos na/ nged kyi mngon par rtogs pa 'di tshod tsam gyis phyin ci log tu rlom pa bskyed nas/ lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa dang*/ ting nge 'dzin gyi bslab pa dang*/ shes rab kyi bslab pa la nan tan mi byed pa ni bdud kyis byin gyis brlabs par zad do// don 'di bla ma rin chen gyis// rtog pa phra ba'i phra ba la// chen po'i chen por gyur pa'i bdud// 'jug par 'gyur bar gsungs pa dang*// ro gcig ngang la 'byams gyur na// rgyu 'bras mngon du 'gyur ro gsung*// 'gro ba'i mgon po klu sgrub kyis// mi rtog ye shes bskyang ba'i phyir// gnod sbyin bu mo bsgrubs pa las// rdza bum chung ngu'i nyes skyon gyis// grub par ma gyur bka' bstsal gsung*// skyob pa shākya'i rgyal po yis// byang chub mchog gi shing drung du// nyon mongs la sogs bdud bzhi bcom// de yi phyir na bcom zhes bya// bcom pas ldan dang 'das pa yis// sgra don khyed kyi thugs la gsal// de ltar lhag pa tshul khrims dngos// chags pa gsum dang bral gyur pas// ma bcings dri ma med pa'i sems// ting 'dzin yon tan kun gyi sgo// dpal chen rgyud la skyes gyur nas// smra bsam shes brjod yul las 'das// ma skyes mi skye skye ba med// shes rab pha rol phyin pa'i mtha'// shes rab kyis ni de nyid thob// dang po las can yan chad dang*// sa bcu'i dbang phyug man chad kun// sngon sbyangs goms pa'i bye brag dang*// las 'phro so so dag gis ni// dang po 'jug pa'i bye brag la// bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab tu// tha dad mang po gsungs na yang*// 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum// byang chub mchog gi shing drung du// ye shes me yis bsregs zhes pas// sbyang gzhi yod na sbyong byed yod// bslab pa gsum dang bral thabs med// mi 'bral gnad kyi don go rnams// phan tshun 'brel pas go bar zad// de ltar nyams su blangs pa la// gti mug med pa gang yin pa// mthar phyin sangs rgyas chos kyi sku// skye 'gag med pa'i spros las dben// chos sku shes rab pha rol phyin// sdong po bkod par gsungs pa ni// smra bsam brjod las 'das pa 'o// thub pa rnams kyi longs sku ni// stobs dang mi 'jigs ma 'dres chos// bral ba'i yon tan sum cu gnyis// rgyu dang 'bras bur bstan pa ni// dgag sgrub gnyis kyi bslab pa ste// bu mo rin chen mdo las gsungs// rnam par smin pa'i 'bras bu ni// mtshan mchog sum cu rtsa gnyis te// rgyu dang 'bras bu rtags pa'i tshul// rgyal ba'i yum du gsungs pa ste// yon tan drug cu rtsa bzhi 'di// chos kyi sku yi yon tan yin// sku gsum so sor dbye ba las// longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku zhes grags// 'jig rten ngam gyur padmas kyang*// rnam par snang mdzad ye shes ni// bde bar gshegs pa'i thugs la gnas// theg chen gsung rab dpag med du// dpag med gzhan yang gsungs pas nges// chags pa med pa mthar phyin pas// zhi ba 'dod chags bral ba'i lus// bcom ldan longs spyod rdzogs sku 'o// zhe sdang med pa'i ngo bo nyid// 'gro ba'i don phyir byang chub sems// sems can kun gyi don ched du// bskyed cing sdom pa blangs pa las// sdom pa gsum gyi tshul bzhin du// ji srid 'khor ba ma stong bar// sangs rgyas rnams kyi sku gsung thugs// mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo la// sprul pa'i sku zhes yongs su grags// khyad par sku gsum 'bras bu gsum// skyes chen khyed kyi thugs dam mdzod// phyi nang gsang ba'i rten 'brel rnams// so so gang gis gang sgrub pa// gsang gtam shub nas bzlas pa yang*// spang bya gnyen po gnyis kyi sems// so so'i sems su gang skyes pa// 'di ni nang gi rten 'brel te// bsam pa de yis byin rlabs pa// sems kyi lus su gyur pa de// gsang ba rten cing 'brel pa yin// lus sems gnyis pos phyi rol gyi// snang ba byin gyis rlabs pa'i tshe// phyi rol rang gzugs shar ba de// phyi yi rten cing 'brel pa ste// 'jig rten mgon po rin chen gyis// rgyu dang 'bras bu yin no zhes// sangs rgyas mkhyen pa'i ye shes 'di// gces se rnams la ngo sprod mdzad// rtogs ldan rnams la bka' stsal gsung*// mos gus can la go ba skyes// snying gtam tshig gcig gsung ba 'di// ngas kyang khyed la bstan pa yin// dus tshod gnyen po re re la// bshes gnyen bzang po re re byung*// grwa tshogs mang po re re 'dus// re re'i gsung sgros re re bris// dam chos mang po mang por song*// tshu rol mthong ba'i dad can rnams// gang mthong bden nam bden nam snyam// pha tsha mang po bkang na yang*// nyams dang rtogs pa ma 'byor na// ma skyes mi 'gag blo las 'das// lta ba nam mkha' lta bu yang*// bcu gsum gung gi ya blar bros// bde dang gsal dang mi rtog pa// lho sprin 'thibs pa lta bu yang*// sad nag byung ba'i nam bzhin dwangs// ma tshor bsags pa'i mi dge ba// 'chi ba'i dus su mngon du gyur// a ma a dzi nga re 'jigs// sems can kun la skyabs med pa// byang chub sems dpas ma gzigs sam// 'dod yon ro la chags pa spang*// ro snyoms pa la dgos rgyu chung*// man ngag ser sna byed pa yang*// bcom ldan 'das kyi gsung dang 'gal// las dang skal par ldan pa la// nyams rtogs gnyis med 'khrid par zhu// rin po che yi gsung sgros 'di// ji ltar gsol ba btab pa bzhin// bris pa'i dge ba gang yin des// 'gro ba byang chub mchog thob shog
/bstan bcos kun la phan pa rin po che'i rgyal mtshan zhes bya ba rdzogs so// //

468) ༄// 'phan yul dpon chen ye shes tshul khrims kyi spyan sngar springs pa// oṃ swasti/ bla ma rin po ches/ dpon chen po'i spyan sngar springs pa/ khyed nga'i bu'i dam pa slob ma'i yang rab/ skye ba dpag tu med pa las kyi 'brel ba zab mor gyur pa/ dad pa dang gus pa mi phyed pa'i shugs thob pa/ zab pa dang rgya che ba rin po che'i chos la gser gyi snod lta bur gyur pa/ bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa/ ri'i rgyal po ri rab lta bu'i rgyab yod pa/ mos gus skyes bu stobs dang ldan pa'i lag pa g.yas pa lta bu/ bla ma dam pa'i byin rlabs kyi bcud/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes skad kyis blangs nas/ rang gzhan thams cad smin pa dang grol bar byed pa'i nus pa yod pa yin pa la/ tshig dang tha snyad kyi yi ge byis pa dman pa'i mgo skor/ mi mkhas pa thams cad kyi slu brid/ blun po rnams kyi yang zong*/ mang po zhig khyed dga' re nas/ skur zhing ngas mgo bskor ba ga la phod/ de yang bla ma rin po che'i zhal snga nas/ nyams myong la zhen pa ma mchis na// dpe cha la chags pa ga la mchis// zhes pa dang*/ gdams ngag ji ltar zab kyang zhi gnas kyi nyams yang yud cig skyed par yang dka'/ nyams myong mthug po zhig skyes kyang*/ nyams sprin la mtshan ma btsugs gyur kyang*// 'dus byas yin pas bslu nas 'chi// zhes gsungs pa dang*/ bcom ldan 'das kyis/ gzhan gyis brjod min lhan cig skyes// gang du yang ni mi rnyed de// bla ma'i dus mtha' bsten pa dang*// rang gi bsod nams las shes bya// zhes gsungs pa yin pas/ bla ma'i mos gus dang sems bsgom pa la nan tan cher mdzad par zhu/ de yang pha mes rigs rgyud can gyi bu tsha ni skyes/ mi rkang grangs ni nyung*/ sa bar khrom tshigs ni 'dzin/ rgyab rten dang skyabs mgon chos ma yin pa ni med/ so nams gdams ngag dang yig sna 'ba' zhig la byed pas mi rigs lags/ gdams ngag mang po yang yod/

mang po zhig nyams len byas pas kyang ma bslus par ma byung*/ mi bslu nges pa bla ma'i mos gus su byung ba yin pas/ snying tshig gi gdams ngag thugs la bzhag par zhu/ 'jam dbyangs kun tu bzang po 'gro ba'i gnyen gcig pu// nor bzang mos gus rgya mtsho'i khrid mdzad ji bzhin du// 'gro ba kun gyi khrid la rab tu mkhas pa po// mtshungs med bla ma rnams dang rtag tu mi 'bral shog /chos kun gdod nas rnam par dag pa shes rab pha rol phyin// shin tu rnam par zhing khams bsam gyis mi khyab tshad las 'das// gzhi dang snying po me tog brgyan pa'i 'jig rten longs sku'i zhing*// shākya'i rgyal po'i zhing khams stong gsum mi mjed 'jig rten gyi// gling bzhi bar pa gzhan las khyad par 'phags pa 'dzam bu'i gling*// thub pa'i mchod rten nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i gnas kyi mchog gyur pa// byang phyogs kha ba can zhes rnam par grags par gyur pa yi// dri za'i rgyal po chen po zur phud lnga pa'i gnas kyi drung*// 'phan yul rgyal zhes yongs su grags pa'i gtsug lag khang chen du// bsod nams tshogs las legs par 'khrungs pa shākya'i rgyal po'i sras// gzhon nu rab byung tshul khrims rgyal gyis mdzes pa'i ye tshul gyis// rgyal ba'i yum gyur stong phrag brgya pa gser gyis bzhengs pa 'di// zhing dang lhag pa'i bsam pa dngos po kun gyis khyad par 'phags// rab 'byams phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten khams rnams ma lus thams cad du// lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten kun gyi gtsug gi rgyan gyur cing*// rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa rnams kyi yul du gyur pa 'di// gang gi lag tu thob par gyur pa de dag thams cad kun// ring por mi thogs 'dren pa rnams kyis byang chub thob ces gsungs// de phyir 'chang dang klog dang mchod dang nyan dang ston dang sgom pa yi// bsod nams dri med mchog tu gyur pa rmad du byung ba des// nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i 'gro ba ma lus thams cad kyis// mthar thug chos sku shes rab pha rol phyin pa mchog thob shog/

༈ //e ma ho/ 'das dang ma byon da ltar dang*// phyogs bcu dus gsum bzhugs pa yi// rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa dang*// 'gro ba'i bde skyid 'byung ba'i gnas// spros med shes rab pha rol phyin// sems nyid 'od gsal stong nyid don// smra bsam shes brjod yul las 'das// dus gsum rgyal ba'i dgongs pa mchog /sangs rgyas rnams kyi byin rlabs kyis// ston pa shākya seṅge yi// rgyal sras ye shes tshul khrims kyis// thugs dam stong phrag brgya pa ni// mthing shog bai ḍūr glegs bam la// rin chen gser gyis legs bris nas// mchod dang 'chang dang klog pa dang*// nyan dang gzhan la ston pa dang*// tshul bzhin yid la byed pa yi// dpag med bsod nams phung po yis// bdag dang sems can thams cad kyis// shes rab pha rol phyin pa'i don// skye med 'od gsal rtogs par shog/ // 469) ༄// jo sras la skyes phrin dang phag gru'i gdan 'dzin la bstod pa// oṃ swasti/ stong dang snying rje lhun gyis grub pa'i sku// mi g.yo rdo rje'i ri ltar rab brtan cing*// dbang gi rgyal po nam mkha' mdzod 'dzin pa// brtse chen bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal 'dud// ji ltar ma ni bu la byams pa yis// bye ba phrag khrig char yang mi phod pa// chos las skyes pa'i bu sdug dam pa la// bla ma rnams ni rgyun chad med par brtse// chags pa'i yid can pha ma bu gcig la// byams kyang gti mug zhe sdang dbang gis nyams// chos kyi rgyal po'i sras kyis dus gsum gyi// rgyal ba rnams kyi gdung rgyud 'dzin phyir dang*// lhar bcas 'jig rten kun gyi skyabs yin pas// bsam rgyu gzhan med chos kyi bu la sems// 'jam dbyangs dpa' bos 'jig rten khams rnams su// dpag med sems can smin par mdzad pa ltar// khyed kyis 'gro la phan pa rgya che yang*// gdung bas snying la yang yang 'dod par 'byung*// bzang po dpal gyi mchod pa'i bkod pa ltar// bsam yas dpag tu med pa'i tshogs rnams kyis// nam mkha'i khams bkang phul bar gyur na yang*// brtse zhing gdung ba'i sems kyis phrad par smon// mnyes pa gsum gyis dus gsum bla ma rnams// srog la mi lta rtag tu mnyes byed pa// mchog gi rigs 'khrungs jo sras bdag gi bus// khyed dang bdag gi bsam pa rdzogs par byas// bdag kyang 'chi bdag khar chud na ba las// dge 'dun rnams dang khyed kyi 'bul ba dang*// dpon jo la sogs brtse ba'i nye gnas kyis// 'bad pa byas pas deng sang bde bar mchis// rgyud kyi rgyal po mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho ni// myur du bris te nyid kyi zhal snga nas// nga yi 'drul 'grul pa gcig byung bar ma gyur tshe// ma bskur gsung bas phyis na bzod par gsol//

༈ //skyes chen gang zhig bsags pa mthar phyin pas// bdag gi bla mas shin tu smin mdzad pas// lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes rang byung shar// skal ldan rang byung khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// rdo rje 'chang chen tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor du// 'gran zla med par phyogs rnams kun tu grags// mi yi seṅge rnal 'byor dbang phyug gtso// snyan pa'i 'brug sgra can la phyag 'tshal lo// 'jig rten mgon pos legs par bsngags pa yi// lhag pa'i tshul khrims rgyan gyis legs par brgyan// skye bo nyes tshogs rgya mtsho las sgrol ba// 'gro ba'i ded dpon khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// tshe gcig mchog gis byang chub sangs rgya ba// bla med gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa yi// sangs rgyas dngos kyi brgyud pa ma chad pa'i// gdung rgyud 'dzin pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi thugs kyi gter// zab zhi spros bral 'od gsal mi g.yo bas// 'khor 'das kun gyi bde skyid 'byung ba'i gnas// mi zad mdzod 'dzin khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku// 'jig rten mgon po bla ma rin chen gyi// sras kyi thu bo 'gran gyi zla med pa// mchog gi dbang bskur thob la phyag 'tshal lo// skyes chen khyod kyis 'jig rten mgon po yi// bstan pa'i snying po gdan sa rin chen 'dzin// zhabs pad len sogs 'gro ba thams cad bskyangs// bstan pa'i bdag po khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// thub pa chen po bzhugs sam grongs kyang rung*// khyod kyi mos gus 'dus byas ma yin pas// lhun gyis grub cing rgyun chad mi mnga' ba// mos gus mthar thug khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// sangs rgyas nyid kyis sangs rgyas mdzad pa byed// rgyal po'i btsun mo rgyal po nyid kyi yin// yab kyi gdan sa dpal gyi phag mo gru// sras kyi thu bo dam pa khyod nyid kyis// thugs dgongs rdzogs phyir mdzad pa mtha' yas mdzad// khyod kyi mdzad pa mtha' yas rgya mtsho la// bdag cag rjes su sgrub po'i bu slob rnams// khyed kyi dgongs pa yongs su rdzogs bya'i phyir// ci gsung bka' bzhin bgyid do thugs la btags// gong ma'i zhal mthong gsung thos ma gyur kyang*// sku gsung thugs kyi sras mchog yid 'ong ba// seng ge glang chen yid bzhin nor 'dra ba'i// bu dang tsha bo rnams kyang ci gsung bgyid// dpal gyi ming can ri khrod ldom bu pas// rgya nag rgyal po phyag gi mdzod nas phyung*// mgon po 'jam dbyangs 'phrul bas rnam 'phrul bas// khri gtsug ral pa can gyi na bza' 'di// thugs brtser dgongs nas sku la gsol bar zhu//

// 470) ༄// dge bshes ber ston klag ston sogs rngod pa'i sgom chen rnams la springs pa// oṃ swasti/ lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyi// gtsug gi nor bu rin po che// 'gran gyis do zla med pa yi// bla ma rin chen zhabs la 'dud// dam pa de yi zhabs rdul la// cung zad reg par gyur pa yi// thub mgon shākya seng ge yi// rgyal sras ri khrod ldom bu pas// rang gi rigs las byung ba yi// dge bshes 'ber ston klag ston dang*// seṅge glang chen 'dra ba yi// bu slob rnams la zhu ba'i don// bkra shis sgo mang rag rdo 'di// de sngon khyod kyis thugs la btags// rag rdo snga mas ma 'dang zhing*// da rung mang po dgos par 'dug /gdan khri rin chen lto bo che// khams gsum srid gsum zas nor dang*// zangs dang rag rdo ji snyed cig /gsol yang 'grangs par ma gyur pas// bzang la mang ba thugs la thogs// zhabs tog byas pa'i gtang rag tu// dpal ldan bla ma dam pa yi// sku gsung thugs dang khyed nyid kyi// lus ngag yid gsum 'dres gyur pa// e ma ngo mtshar mi che 'am// rngod pa'i sgom chen pa rnams la/ rag rdo'i zhe 'dod zhus pa rdzogs so// // 471) ༄// nyon mongs rnam gsum gyi dbang du mi gtong ba bla med theg pa'i nyams len gyi skor// oṃ swasti/ skyes chen gang zhig bskal pa grangs med mtha' yas par// thabs dang shes rab tshogs gnyis bsags pa mthar phyin pas// sku gnyis mngon du gyur nas rang gzhan don grub pa// bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa'i zhabs la rab btud nas// dge ba'i bshes kyi gsung mi gcag phyir bri bar bya// 'dir pha spad drung por gyur pas/ ku re dang kyal ka ni med/ zhe thag pa snying khong rus pa'i gting nas/ rang nyid kyi 'dug lugs zur tsam snyan du gsol na/ 'jig rten 'dir ni yun ring po sdod pa'i dbang med/ myur du 'chi dgos par 'dug 'o na shi bas chog mod snyam na shi bas lta mi chog ste/
