rang gi bsam pa dge ba dang mi dge ba 'di/ rgya dang rgya'i 'bur bzhin du skye zhing 'byung bas/ bsam pa ngan pa spang zhing bzang po bsgrub pa la 'bad par bya ste/ de la bzang po ni gang*/ ngan pa ni gang zhe na/ slob dpon 'phags pa'i zhal snga nas/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug bcas// de skyed las ni mi dge ba// ma chags ma sdang gti mug med// des skyed las ni dge ba yin// zhes gsungs pas/ nyon mongs pa rnam gsum gyi dbang du mi btang zhing*/ de'i gnyen po ma chags pa zhe sdang med pa/ gti mug med pa gsum nyams su blang bar bya'o// 'di'i nyams su len lugs shin tu mang yang*/ theg pa chen po bla na med pa'i theg pa'i sgor zhugs pa rnams kyis/ nyams su blang ba'i rim pa ni/ byams pa dang*/ snying rje dang*/ byang chub kyi sems rin po che'i rjes su 'brangs nas bya ba thams cad bsgrub par bya ste/ de ltar yang*/ bla ma rin po che'i zhal snga nas/ byams pa'i chu bo mi bcad cing*// snying rje'i rtsa ba rab brlan te// byang sems ljon shing rab rgyas nas// don gnyis 'bras bu smin mdzad gsol// zhes gsungs pas/ dang por sems can thams cad a ma drin can du bsgoms pa las skyes pa'i byams pa bsgom/ ma de 'gro ba rigs drug du sdug bsngal ba bsams pa las skyes pa'i snying rje bsgom/ ma sdug bsngal can 'di rnams bde ba dang ldan/ sdug bsngal dang bral/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par bya bar dam bcas pa'i bsam pa de'i rjes su 'brangs nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan pa bslab pa rin po che gsum nyams su blang bar bya ste/ de yang lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa/ dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gzhung lam dang gshegs shul/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi byang chub/ stobs bcu thob par byed pa'i rgyu nges pa/ so so thar pa ris bdun gyi sdom pa/ rang gi srog dang bsdo ba/ 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu 'gro ba'i rkyal pa la rangs pa dang*/

phyed dang sum cha dang*/ lag mthil tsam mam snyung bu'i shul tsam blangs pa las/ de gang med kyang rgya mtsho brgal bar mi nus pa'i dpe bstan pa ltar/ nyes byas shin tu phra ba yan chad rang nyid kyis bsrung ba ni/ tshul khrims las byung ba'i bsod nams bya ba'i dngos po/ bgyis pa dang*/ rang gi nye du dang gnyen 'brel/ phyogs dang ris sems can gyis bsdus pa gang ci yang rung ste/ re rag 'jigs gsum gang yod tshad thams cad/ tha na sna gcig bsrung ba'i dge bsnyen nam/ nyin gcig gam mtshan gcig bsrung ba'am/ bsnyen gnas kyi sdom pa yan chad la 'god pa ni bgyid du bstsal ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba/ dper na rang nyid khyim par gyur nas/ dge slong tshul khrims rnam par dag pa dang ldan pa mthong na/ de la rjes su yi rang zhing dga' ba dang*/ mgu ba dang*/ yon tan dang legs par brjod cing*/ thal mo tsam zhig sbyar ba byas pas kyang tshul khrims kyi bsod nams mnyam por thob pa'am/ de las lhag par 'gyur ba bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs te/ nor bu 'ching bu'i phung po chen por gyur pa yang*// rin chen bai ḍūrya gcig de kun zil gyis gnon// de bzhin 'gro kun sbyin pa'i phung po rgya chen kun// rjes su yi rang byang chub sems dpas zil gyis gnon// zhes pa dang*/ de las ldog pa ni/ 'phags pa rtogs pa chen po las/ gang zhig dge ba spyod mthong la// 'phya zhing bskur te ma mos na// dkon mchog gsum gyi rigs kyang gcod// ces gsungs pas/ rjes su yi rang ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba gal che bar gsungs pas/ tshul khrims las byung ba'i bsod nams bya ba'i dngos po/ bgyis pa dang*/ bgyid du bstsal ba dang*/ bgyis pa la rjes su yi rang ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba zur tsam smos pa des mtshon nas/ lhag pa ting nge 'dzin gyi bslab pa rang nyid bsgoms pa dang*/ sgom du bstsal ba dang*/ bsgoms pa la rjes su yi rang ba dang*/ lhag pa shes rab kyi bslab pa/

thos bsam sgom gsum gyi shes rab rang gi rgyud la skyes pa dang*/ skyed pa dang*/ bskyed du bstsal ba dang*/ thos bsam sgom gsum gyi shes rab gang yang rung*/ skyes shing bskyed pa la rjes su yi rang ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di/ bsam gyis mi khyab cing dpag tu med par 'jug pa/ dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bstan pa/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' 'phags pa thams cad kyi gzhung lam dang gshegs shul/ lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten thams cad kyi bde ba dang skyid pa'i 'byung gnas/ thabs khyad par du 'phags shing bla na med pa/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po nyid la lhun gyis grub cing rtsol sgrub mi 'tshal bar gyur pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan pa rin po che'i bdag por gyur pa lags pa la/ bdag cag bla mar gyur pa rnams dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan pa'i sgor zhugs pa thams cad la yang bka' drin che zhing rjes su yi rang bar gyur pa lags pas/ de yang bslab pa rin po che rnam pa gsum gyis rang gzhan thams cad smin pa dang*/ grol ba'i brtul zhugs dang khur chen po snoms par zhu 'tshal lags te/ 'di ni thabs mkhas pa bla na med pa'o// de la shes rab ni/ slob dpon 'phags pa'i zhal snga nas/ shes rab bden don gtan la 'bebs// zhes pas/ 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pas bsdus pa'i chos thams cad ni rang gi sems/ sems ni gdod nas ma skyes pa/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyis ma gzigs pa/ mi gzigs/ gzigs par mi 'gyur ba/ grub pa'i mtha' thams cad dang*/ blos byas pa'i lta ba thams cad dang bral ba yin pas/ 'di ltar rang nyid la nga zhes bya ba'am/ bdag ces bya ba phyin ci log tu 'khrul ba'i blo'i khyad par gyis/ bdag yod pa dang*/ med pa dang*/ stong pa dang*/ mi stong pa dang*/ dben pa dang*/ mi dben pa dang*/ zhi ba dang ma zhi ba zhes bya ba bdag gi khyad par gyi chos log par lta ba mkhas pa thams cad kyis rgyang ring du bsrings pa yin pas/

khyed kyis bla ma dam pa'i byin rlabs kyis rtogs par bya'o// de ji ltar nyams su blang zhe na/ bcom ldan 'das dgyes mdzad las/ gzhan gyis brjod min lhan cig skyes// gang du yang ni mi rnyed de// bla ma'i dus mtha' bsten pa dang*// rang gi bsod nams las shes bya// zhes gsungs pas/ bla ma la yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas chos kyi sku'i 'du shes bskyed cing gsol ba gdab/ bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pas/ bla ma dam pa'i thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes dang*/ rang gi shes pa gcig tu 'dres nas/ nor bu rin po che chu dang rnyog gseb du bcug pa ltar nyon mongs pa dang rnam par rtog pa thams cad chu dwangs snyigs phyed pa bzhin du/ sems nyid rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa dang*/ dwangs snyigs phyed nas mngon du 'gyur te/ de ltar yang*/ bla ma rin po che'i zhal snga nas/ nyams myong dang rtogs pa gcig tu mchi// rgyun chad med par rtag na yin// zhes gsungs pas/ lhun gyis grub pa'i de kho na nyid/ de nyid la rgyun tu goms par bya ste/ 'di ni dus thams cad kyi nyams len no// bye brag sgom pa'i rim pa ni/ 'das dang ma byon da ltar phyogs bcu dus gsum du gshegs shing bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i 'phags pa nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas bdag nyid chen po thams cad kyis/ skyon thams cad ni spangs/ yon tan gyi tshogs rgya mtsho lta bu ni rdzogs pa'i 'khrul 'khor rdo rje'i gdan byang chub kyi shing drung du/ bdud sde dang bcas pa thams cad ni pham par mdzad cing*/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob pa'i bzhugs lugs/ thub pa chen po nyid kyis dam bca' mdzad pa/ ji srid zag med ma thob pa// de srid skyil dkrung bshig mi bya// zhes gsungs pa'i don/ dben pa'i gnas su 'bol ba'i stan bting*/ lus skyil mo krung legs par bca'/ bsam gtan gyi yan lag lngas gnas par byas nas/

dang por byang chub kyi sems bsgom/ lus yi dam gyi lhar bsgom/ bla ma dam pa thugs kar bsam/ sems ma bcos pa rang sor bzhag yod dang med dang stong dang mi stong dang*// bdag dang bdag med zhi dang ma zhi dang*// mnyam par bzhag dang langs pa'i 'du shes las// rnam par dben pa'i don de khyod kyis goms par mdzod// 'khor ba nyon mongs rnam rtog yin gyur na// de nyid rang sar grol ba'i rnal 'byor pa// 'khor ba chos skur gyur pa ma yin nam// 'jig rten gsum mgon bla ma rin chen gyis// 'khrul pa ye shes yin zhes bka' bstsal gsung*// tho yor skyes bus 'jigs shing skrag pa'i mi// skyes bu med par shes na 'jigs shing skrag pa bral// bdag dang bdag tu 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog kyang*// de dang 'dra bar 'jig rten mgon pos gsungs// rnam par rtog pa ma rig chen po ste// rtog pa'i gshis nyid lhun grub mi rtog par// spang blang med par go ba'i rnal 'byor pas// chos kun khong du ma chud ci zhig yod// 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho ji lta bu zhig spang*// mya ngan 'das pa su yis ji ltar thob// mnyam nyid bde chen 'di dang mi 'bral mdzod// nad dang gnod pa nyes tshogs rgya mtsho kun// nyon mongs rnam rtog nyid las nges 'byung na// de yi gnyen po 'di las gzhan pa'i chos// dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyis mi rnyed pas// dge ba'i bshes kyis nyams su blang bar zhu// rdzogs so// //

472) ༄// skyes bu dam pa'i thugs dam me tog phreng ba zhes bya ba gces pa'i snying po// oṃ swasti/ ji ltar padmo chu yis ma gos ltar// nyes tshogs skyon gyis ma gos bla ma dang*// rgyal ba sras bcas dam pa'i chos rnams la// gus pas rab btud zhus lan yi ger bri// mi mjed 'jig rten thub pas 'dul ba'i zhing*// nyon mongs stobs 'phel snyigs ma lnga yi dus// gdug pa'i mi rnams nyon mongs dug 'phel ba// khyed spun 'gro ba'i gnyen bshes skyes mchog gis// gdug pa'i me rlabs thams cad zhi bya zhes// phyogs rnams kun tu rgya cher rab grags pa// brtse bar gnas pa bdag cag rjes yi rang*// gnya' shing bu gar rus sbal mgrin chud ltar// mi lus thob pa shin tu dka' ba dang*// dal 'byor thob pa de bas shin tu dkon// thub pa'i bstan pa'i bdag por mnga' gsol ba// dge ba'i bshes gnyen khyed la 'di nyid rigs// rtag tu ngu dang nor bzang ji bzhin du// skyon med dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams btsal zhing*// sde snod rin po che la mkhyen pa sbyangs// bslab gsum mdzes pa'i rgyan can sku mched kyis// bya bar 'os pa'i byed pa shin tu mdzad// sangs rgyas nyid nas da lta phan chad du// don rgyun ma chad tshig tshogs spros pa yi// tshong dus 'o ma spangs pa'i dam pa'i chos// mos gus lces blangs thugs kyi dkyil 'khor rgyas// dul ba'i rang bzhin cang shes glang chen gyis// bya bar 'os pa mdzad pa ngo mtshar che// rdo rje 'chang chen dpal ldan chos kyi rjes// dbang bskur byin rlabs mdzad nas shar phyogs kyi// 'gro ba dpag med phan bde la 'god cing*// thub pa'i bstan pa 'dzin par gnyer gtad pa'i// bstan pa'i khur bsnams bla ma mnyes mdzad pa// dam pa khyed la bla ma rin chen dgyes// skyes chen de yi bu slob cang shes la// cang shes tshogs kyis bskor ba'i glang po dang*// seng ge gcan gzan tshogs kyis bskor ba ltar// mkhas dang btsun dang rtogs dang grol ba dang*// dul bar gnas pa rgya mtsho lta bu rnams// dga' ba drag pos rangs shing dgyes par mdzad// lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten thams cad kun// byang chub sems kyi dbang gyur khyed nyid la// mig rtsa hrig hrig blta zhing re ba che// 'di yis bdag cag thams cad 'khor ba dang*// ngan song sdug bsngal gnas las skyob mdzad ces// re bar gyur pa'i 'gro ba thams cad kun// sgrol bar dam bcas skyes bu chen po yis// mdzad pa rlabs chen ci yi phyir mi mdzad// smig rgyu'i rgya mtshos khyer ba'i 'gro ba rnams// gzings dang gru zam mnyan pa'i thabs rnams kyis// 'bad pa bye ba khrag khrig mang byas shing*// ji snyed bsgral ces bdag nyid mgu ba dang*// ma brgal sgrol ba'i thabs la 'bad pa dang*// sgrol bzhin pa la skyo ba med pa rnams// smig rgyu chu yis stong par shes tsam gyis// bsgral bya sgrol byed sgrol ba'i rtsol ba la// rnal 'byor dbang phyug su ko dga' ba skye// blo yi bya ba thongs dang rtogs ldan kun// yod ma myong ba bdag tu 'dzin pa'i yid// phung po 'di la bdag tu bzung ba yis// chags dang ldan pa dug gi stobs 'phel bas// rgyal zhing myos par gyur pa'i skye bo la// sman pa'i rgyal po bdud rtsi mchog 'dzin la// rang nyid dug 'thungs nad par gyur nas kyang*// nad kyis gdungs pas gso bar mi byed pa'i// sman pa'i rgyal po rigs pa ma yin zhes// skye dgu kun gyis khong du chud par 'gyur// glang chen dbang pos khur mchog khyer ba ltar// bstan pa'i bdag pos bstan pa'i khur khyer ba// lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten thams cad kun// re ba rang gnas 'di la khyed kyis 'bad// mang du 'di la smos kyang ci 'tshal te// sems can rnyed pa med la smod pa dang*// rnyed pa can la mi snyan smra ba dang*// mos pa tha dad sems can sna tshogs kyi// bsam pa rgyal bas mgu bar mi nus zhes// khyed rang nyid kyis dpag med gsung ba de// thugs la bzhag cing yang yang bsam par rigs// 'di bris dge ba'i rtsa ba des// bdag dang 'gro ba ma lus kun// nyes tshogs sgrib pa rab spangs te// rdzogs pa'i byang chub mchog thob shog

/skyes bu dam pa'i thugs dam me tog phreng ba zhes bya ba gces pa'i snying po rdzogs so// // 473) ༄// bla ma mnyes par byed pa'i rin chen zhes pa ston pa rgyal ba 'bum gyi zhu chos// 'gro ba'i mgon po dpal ldan chos kyi rje// kun mkhyen brtse ba'i bdag nyid rin chen gyi// zhabs kyi rdul la reg pa'i bsod snyoms pas// gzhan gyis ci byas tshad mar ma byas shing*// ci gsung bka' la gus pas spyi bos blangs// 'bri la g.yag tu gsung yang nges pa bskyed// bdag 'dzin goms pa'i stobs rgyas 'gyur med pa// mtha' 'khob yul du skyes pa'i rgyal mtshan gyis// shes pa tha rgod mi tshad rdo rjer gyur// dkar po lo tog skye ba'i gnas med kyang*// bla ma bden no ba yi khe grags kyis// gsung bzhin byed lo tsam gyis phyir phyir zhing*// phan zhing bde ba'i nges shes je cher song*// bla ma snying nas mad par deng sang go /ci gsung bka' bzhin byed pa'i mos gus can// srog la mi ltos bla ma mnyes byed pa// rang gi bu la mgon po'i gsung 'di gdams// de dang der gsungs rgyu mtshan 'bras// lha dang sku 'bag yi ge gsum// dug dang ltem rkyang brjod bya gsum// 'khor dang longs spyod gegs sel gsum// bogs 'don gnad dang byang chub che// brid bsdigs tshogs dang dpag gi dam chos dang*// 'brel gtam thugs phebs bka' bstsal gsung gi gnad// bu gcig sems la zhog dang chos kyi bu// sngon yang gsung bzhin byas la de bzhin du// da yang bla ma dam pa'i gsung bzhin du// nan tan chen pos bsgrub cing dang du blang*// ma 'gyod mi 'gyod 'gyod pa med par 'gyur// mos gus je che nges shes bla med cing*// phul du byung zhing rang la dga' mgu ba'i// rin chen gsung de khyed la ngo sprod bya// bka' bkyon gsung la log lta ma skyes shing*// ci gsung tshad mar byed pa'i mos gus can// kun gyi yid 'ong skyes bu dam pa yi// ston pa shes rab 'bum gyis dam chos 'di// dge 'dun rnams dang 'gro la phan pa'i phyir// dad cing gus pas zhus pa'i yi ge 'di// bla ma rnams dang rgyal ba sras bcas kun// mnyes par byed pa'i rin chen zhes pa'o// rdzogs so//

// 474) ༄// rang sems rang byung 'dus ma byas zhes pa byang chub nam mkha'i mtshan nyid// byang chub nam mkha'i mtshan nyid de// rtog pa thams cad spangs pa'i phyir// 'gro 'ong med pa'i rin po che// rtag tu byang chub gling na bzhugs// dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi thugs// stong dang snying rje dbyer med pa// phan dang bde ba'i rang bzhin de// sems can kun gyi khams la bzhugs// sngon gyi thugs rje smon lam gyis// rtag tu phan bde bskyed pa yi// bla ma dam pa'i sku gsung thugs// mos gus can la rtag tu bzhugs// nga 'bu sprang po ri khrod pa// nges pa med pa'i rnal 'byor 'di// spyir ni gangs khrod ri khrod 'grim// nam yang dbu ru'i phyogs su mchi// da res tshur byon mi chen rnams// shi gzir ro gzir ma mdzad par// 'di yi babs la dgongs nas kyang*// da res cung zhig glod par zhu// zhi ba chags bral lha dang mis mchod pa// chos la phyag 'tshal deng 'dir bde legs shog /skyabs gnas mthar thug rin po che// rang sems chos sku 'dus ma byas// 'khor 'das kun gyi skyabs gcig pu// rang sems sangs rgyas skyabs su mchi// phyag 'tshal 'dud cing phyag 'tshal 'dud// phyag 'tshal phyag 'tshal phyag 'tshal 'dud// ji ltar chu la chu bzhag dang*// ji ltar mar la mar bzhag ltar// rang gis rang gi ye shes ni// legs mthong gang yin 'dir phyag yin// sems spros bral rtogs na chos kyi sku// rang sems rdo rje phyag 'tshal zhes// skyob mdzad 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon// slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub gsungs// soms dang rnal 'byor dbang phyug rnams// rang sems bzang po ma gtogs pa// 'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa la// skyabs dang dpung gnyen gzhan med pa// glen pa da rung ma go 'am// kwa a ma a dzi nga re 'jigs// snying dang 'dra ba'i shag po la// skyabs dang re gnas ma mchis te// rang la yod pa'i dus tshod du// phye gtor byed cing shan shun 'byed// gus pas bsnyen bkur byas na yang*// phye 'gam de la de phed ces// mi mthun phyogs kyi dgra bo la// dgra la thob pa'i snying gtam bshad// kha sbyang mchu sbyang sna tshogs kyis// khong pa'i nang cha 'bru bar byed// zur smras tshig gcig shor ba na// ngan smras brgya tsam btags nas kyang*// kho yi rna bar skyel bar byed// nyin phyed mun ni rub pa bzhin// thams cad dus gcig dgra bor 'gyur// nyon mongs dug gi stobs 'phel nas// rtsa ba brgyud pa'i bla ma dang*// dus gsum sangs rgyas man chad nas// khams gsum sems can yan chad kyi// skyon bsams ngag tu thon pa yis// sangs rgyas rnams dang sems can la// skyon rnams thams cad blangs pa las// sangs rgyas sems can dag las byung*// dkar po'i sa bon tshig pa na// ji srid 'khor ba ma stong tshe// sangs rgyas sems can gang la yang*// yon tan skye ba'i skal med pa// 'jigs shing ya nga 'di 'dra bar// bzhi bkyigs legs par byas nas kyang*// tsham tshom med par bskyur bar byed// rtog gnyis cig car mi 'jug cing*// sems gnyis 'grogs shing mi 'phrad pas// thos bsam sgom gsum gang gis kyang*// yon tan rgyud la mi skye ba// kyi hud sdig pa'i grogs pos bslus// kyi hud kyi hud ji ltar bya// srin po gshed ma mdza' bo'i gzugs// 'di phyi ma lus thams cad du// phung byed sdig pa'i grogs po la// skyabs gnas ma re rang sems bsgom// rang sems rang byung 'dus ma byas// gtan gyi skyabs gnas min re shi// thar pa'i bar du gcod pa'i bdud// mkhan po slob dpon mched grogs dang*// yon bdag pho mo la sogs pa// ston pa thams cad mkhyen pa yis// sdig pa'i grogs por bstan pa yi// spyi yi rnam gzhag zur tsam mo// shag po skyabs gnas ma yin pa'i tshoms so//

༈ //kye ma rnal 'byor dbang phyug rnams// gnas 'di 'dra nges par btsal nas kyang*// dus ring por sdod pa'i bsam pa yis// gnas gcig la skyabs gnas mi btsal bar// sems gnyis med ye shes rdo rje gdan// dus gsum sangs rgyas bzhugs sa 'dir// rgyun chad med par bzhugs lags na// dung phyur sum cu so drug gi /srod la bdud kyi tshogs bcom nas// tho rangs mkhyen pa'i ye shes rgyas// gnyis med ye shes gnas kyi mchog /gnyug ma'i rang so ma zin na// gnas gang du bsdad kyang sa yi thog /a ma a dzi nga re 'jigs// lo phyed dang gsum du sems khral byas// gnas phun sum tshogs pa'i yul dbus su// mkhar zur mang mthon po'i nang shed du// rnal 'byor dbang phyug gnas bcas nas// rang gzhan smin par bzhed na yang*// ngo mtshar can gyi dgon pa la// ha cang thugs rje che drags pas// mos gus can gyi bu slob rnams// lus sems dra sha chad par byed// bsags pa can gyi yon bdag gis// rdzas dang yo byad gang yin rnams// g.yo sgyu thabs kyi bye brag gis// nan tshir byas nas mkhar len byed// dad pa can gyi dad rdzas rnams// dkon mchog gsum po mi mchod cing*// chos ldan drung na yod pa'i yang*// ci yod shan shun phye nas kyang*// dgon par bsdod pa'i so tshis kyis// gtso bo mi chen srid du gcod// nam yang 'khrug pa'i so tshis byed// slob dpon thugs kyi dgongs pa de// bu slob drung na 'dug pas lon// nyin phyed mun ni rub pa bzhin// gtam ngan lung pa khengs pa dang*// gcig kyang 'khor mi med pa dang*// dgon par sdod dbang med pa dang*// gong gi bsam ngan rgyu 'bras kyis// gnas de rtsod pa'i gzhir gyur nas// 'di dang phyi ma thams cad du// rang dang rang la brtse ba rnams// e ma ngan sar bskyur ba 'di// rang la rang snying mi rje 'am// kye ma kyi hud ji ltar bya// gnas dang gzhi dang khang pa dang*// zhen cing chags pa'i dgon pa yi// nyes skyon chen po mthong nas kyang*// skyob pa rgyal ba thams cad kyis// 'du 'dzi chags pas dben pa yi// dgon pa'i bsngags pa gsungs pa dang*// bla ma rin chen zhal snga nas// gnas gang du sdod kyang gzhal yas khang*// chags pa med pa'i 'bol stan 'ding*// gnas gang dang gang du bsdod na yang*// yun ring por sdod pa'i bsam pa spang*// gsung gi rjes su 'brangs nas kyang*// gnas la skyabs gnas 'tshol ba yi// bsam pa gtad la rang sems bsgom// gnas skyabs gnas ma yin pa'i tshoms so//

༈ //deng sang snyigs ma'i dus la bab// rtsod pa bdo ba'i dus tshod 'dir// rdzas dang yo byad phal cher rnams// bsod nams tshogs su 'gro ba nyung*// dus bzang bskal pa bzang dus na// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas byung ba rnams// stobs kyis 'khor los bsgyur ba yi// rgyal srid ma lus spangs nas kyang*// thub pa bsod nams spyod pa dang*// 'phags pa gnas brtan 'od srung dang*// skyes chen bye ba nyi shu pa// shākya'i rgyal po bzang ldan sogs// thub pa drang srong chen po rnams// rdzas dang yo byad spangs nas kyang*// bdag nyid chen po bsod snyoms spyod// skyes chen gong ma'i rnam thar la// ci phyir bdag cag slob mi byed// a ma a dzi nga re 'jigs// phung byed rdzas dang yo byad 'di// ji snyed dgra dang chom rkun dang*// gdug pa mtshon dang dug sogs kyis// 'jigs pa thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas// gsog 'jog med la 'jigs pa ci// sdig dang sdug bsngal sna tshogs kyis// bsags pa'i rdzas dang yo byad rnams// sbrang mas 'bad de rtsi bsags kyang*// sbrang rtsi gzhan gyis spyod par byed// nor yang sdig pa'i rgyur song zhing*// lus kyang sdig pa'i rgyur song nas// 'jigs su rung ba'i dmyal ba yi// bud shing byed pa a re 'jigs// phyin ci log tu 'khrul pa'i blo// dngos dang brgyud pa thams cad du// phung bar byed pa'i zas nor la// skyabs dang rten sa byed pa 'di// shes pa 'khrul lam gdon gyis brlams// sor bcu brang la bkrams nas kyang*// legs par soms dang bsam gzhig can// nor dang rdzas dang yo byad rnams// skyabs dang rten sa ma yin zhing*// phal cher dngos dang brgyud par yang*// phung bar 'gyur zhes ston pas gsungs// rang la snying brtse yod pa rnams// sems kyi nor bu rin chen ni// dgos 'dod ma lus 'byung ba ste// rje btsun bram ze chen po yis// nor gyi nor mchog chog shes nor// 'khor dang mya ngan 'das 'phro ba// 'dod dgu ma lus 'byung ba yi// rin chen sems la phyag 'tshal zhes// sems nyid rdo rje bstod pa dang*// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyang*// byang chub sems 'di gcig pu las// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun dang*// 'khor dang yon tan kun 'byung ba// gsung rab rnams su rgya cher bshad// des na rang sems rin chen la/

/gtan gyi nor bu mdzad par zhu// nor rten sa dang skyabs ma yin pas byang chub kyi sems nor chen por bstan pa'i tshoms so// ༈ //e ma rnal 'byor dbang phyug gtso// legs par soms dang rje btsun pa// bdag tu 'dzin pa'i yus po che// goms pa'i stobs can snying rus can// rigs dang rus dang cho 'brang rnams// khyod kyi nga bdag de yin nam// ha ha ngu bro gad mo thob// phyin ci log gi rten 'brel las// nyes pa mang po'i phung po 'di// dang por skye ba'i sdug bsngal bsgrub// kun tu rlung dang mkhris pa dang*// bad kan 'dus pa nad kyi gzhi// bar du rgas shing 'khogs pa bskyed// mtha' mar 'chi ba'i sdug bsngal dang*// dgra dang gdon dang sdug bsngal tshogs// dmyal ba yi dwags dud 'gro dang*// 'khor ba mtha' med sdug bsngal tshogs// nyes pa kun gyi gzhir gyur pa// spyi bo gtsug nas rkang mthil bar// mi gtsang rdzas kyis gang ba 'di// phyi sgyur byas na 'jigs kyang 'jigs// e ma a dzi a la la// phung po sdug pa'i dgra chen la// skyabs gnas ma 'tshol mkhas pa rnams// bdag tu ma 'dzin rnal 'byor pa// snying rje ma che thugs rje can// khyu mchog shākya'i rgyal po dang*// sngon gyi drang srong chen po rnams// rnam shes phung po la sogs pa// phung po dgra las rgyal ba'i phyir// 'phags pa dgra bcom ma lags sam// phung po dgra chen 'joms byed pa// mtha' dang bral ba gnyug ma'i sems// gnyis med ye shes rdo rje la// rgyun chad med par skyabs su song*// bdag phung po'i yin/ phung po bdag gi yin zhes pa rul pa la skyabs mi btsal ba'i tshoms so// ༈ //da ni mi rgod rnam rgyal rnams// su dang mi 'dra dbang po che// rgyal po tshogs dpon dge ba'i bshes// khas blangs snying la bsams pa rnams// phyag len mdzad pa'i brtul zhugs can// dgra gnyen 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog rnams// chu yi chu bur ji bzhin du// rkyen las skye zhing 'byung ba rnams// skye zhing 'gag pa ma go ba// dgra gnyen 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog can// rmongs pa'i byis pa snying rje'i gnas// glen pa yus kyis brnangs pa rnams// shes rab mig dang nam yang bral// bsam pa'i snying yang bud pa yi// ngas byas can gyi dbang po che// rnam rtog mi rtag ma go 'am// don 'di shes rab sna tshogs nas// ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan gyis// skar ma rab rib mar me dang*// sgyu ma zil pa chu bur dang*// rmi lam glog dang sprin lta bu// 'dus byas chos rnams de ltar blta// gzhan yang 'du byas mi rtag pa// ston pas dpag med gsungs pa rnams// 'khor ba 'dus byas mi rtag pa'i// rgyu mtshan de yis nges pa yin// mi rtag pa nyid sdug bsngal bas// sdug bsngal 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho 'di// rnam par rtog pa kho na yin// rtog pa thog mtha' med pas na// 'khor ba thog mtha' med pa yin// rnam rtog mu mtha' med pas na// 'khor ba mu mtha' med pa yin// ji ltar sgyu ma mkhan po yis// sngags dang rdzas kyi rten 'brel rnams// tshogs pa yod na sgyu ma 'byung*// de la thog ma mtha' ma dang*// mu mtha' yod par mi 'gyur ba// de bzhin 'khor ba'i thog mtha' dang*// mu mtha' yod par mi 'gyur ro// 'khor ba'i dbus dang thog mtha' rnams// gdod nas zhi zhing ma skyes pa// gang gis ma shes ma rig pa// de la 'du byed nas bzung ste// rga shi'i bar du 'khor gyur na// ci phyir gdod nas ma skyes pa// gnyis med rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis// 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho skems mi byed// des na rnal 'byor dbang phyug rnams// ma rig las byung 'du byed la// gtan gyi skyabs mchog ma mdzad par// sems nyid rang byung 'dus ma byas// smra bsam shes brjod yul las 'das// shes rab pha rol phyin pa la// rgyal ba sras bcas skyabs su song*// skyabs su song bas don chen grub// rang don chos kyi sku nyid dang*// gzhan don gzugs sku rnam pa gnyis// lhun grub rgyun chad mi mnga' ba// skyabs rang sems bsgom las byung bas na// skyabs med rnam par rtog pa la// skyabs dang re gnas mi btsal bar// sngon gyi sangs rgyas ji bzhin du// skyabs kyang dam pa rang sems bsgom// bdag dang bdag gir 'dzin pa yi// rnam par rtog pa skyabs gnas ma yin pa'i tshoms so//

༈ //ji ltar mig gi dbang po yis// sna tshogs gzugs rnams mthong na yang*// rang gis rang nyid mi mthong ltar// gzhan gyis bdag ni bkur ba las// chen por rlom pa'i bsam pa yis// gzhan skyon ngan mtshang 'bru ba min// rang la bltas pas rang nyid kyi// re sa skyabs gnas 'di rnams la// re ltos shin tu che bar 'dug /re ltos gcod pa'i yi ge 'di// phag sna gtun bu byas pa yin// mkhas pa'i skye bo ma mnyes na// bzod pa dam pa bzhes par zhu// //

475) ༄// rang thed la btang nas gzhan don byed ces pa ston pa blo gros seng ger gsungs pa// rje bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// sgos bka' drin can la skyabs su mchi// dpal phag mo gru pa'i bka' drin gyis// chos zab mo zhig la nges shes skyes// thabs mkhas pa zhig la nyams len byas// ston pa'i bstan la rab tu byung*// shākya'i rgyal po'i rjes su bslab// sbyangs pa'i yon tan dang du blangs// sa phyogs gar sdod gar gnas kyang*// bdag 'dzin nyal sa bla gang med// ji snyed rdzas la longs spyod kyang*// gsog 'jog phul gang byas pa med// 'dod dgu zong du bkram na yang*// khe skyed gang che blta ma myong*// che dgu 'khor du lhags na yang*// rang 'dod zhe 'dod byed ma myong*// zab dgu tshogs su bshad na yang*// nyams su ma myong smras pa med// nga rgyal po lta bu'i rnal 'byor pa// ston pa shākya seṅge yi// tshad med snying rje chen po yis// rang thed la btang nas gzhan don byas// phyogs ris med par gnyen du gyur// kun gyis bkur bas nga re brod// nga nam mkha' lta bu'i rnal 'byor pa// byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed nas// che chung bsod nams gang bsags kyang*// 'khor gsum yongs su dag pas na// mkha' la ri mo bris na yang*// mthong chos 'bras bu myur du 'byung*// nga la phul dang bsags pa can// nga skyi bser lta bu'i rnal 'byor pa// gzung du med cing bcing du med// gnas la nges pa med pas na// cag cag tig tig med na yang*// gang du bsdad pa'i sa phyogs su// bsod nams ye shes tshogs gnyis rdzogs// gnas nga la phul dang mnga' thang can// nga seṅge lta bu'i rnal 'byor pa// rtsa ba sems nyid don rtogs pas// tshig tha snyad gtso bor 'dzin pa la// nyam nga bag tsha mi skye zhing*// chos dang mi mthun wa tshogs rnams// ngo srung med pa'i rang sgra yis// skrag nas 'byer bar 'gyur ba yin// nyams rtogs 'dod na nga la 'thud// nga glang po lta bu'i rnal 'byor pa// nyon mongs dgra yi g.yul ngo ru// gnyis med thug phrad nyams len shes// nad dang gnod pa sdug bsngal tshogs// dngos grub chen por 'gyur ba yin// nga dang 'grogs zhig skyon can rnams// nga smyon pa lta bu'i rnal 'byor pa// cir snang chos skur shar ba des// gnyis med gcig tu 'dres pa yis// zhen 'dzin 'ching ba med na yang*// byin gyis rlob cing nyams rtogs bskyed// nga la 'thud cig slob ris rnams// nga nyi zla lta bu'i rnal 'byor pa// sna tshogs lta ba'i mun khrod du// rtogs pa'i ye shes 'od zer gyis// 'dzin pa'i mun pa dwangs par byed// nga la bsten dang gti mug can// med kyang ku re bgyis pa lags// gsang sngags theg pa'i sgor zhugs nas// cir snang 'di dag thams cad kun// sangs rgyas sku ru ma rtogs pas// rang dge slong gcig tu nges shes skyes// sbyangs pa'i yon tan bsngags pa brjod// zhen chags med pa'i yus po che// ngan sar ltung ba ma tshor ram// bde chen bla ma'i zhabs btud nas// phyag rgya chen po'i byin rlabs kyis// cir snang gcig tu ma gyur bas// rang bzang por go ba'i rtogs pa can// nga yin kha tsho 'brug ltar sgrogs// khyod bzang po yin no ngas kyang byas// snying nas bzang po dka' mor gda'// bsags pa'i rdzas dang yo byad rnams// dad pas bla ma'i phyogs su btang*// ri khrod dgon par snyung 'dug byed// blo phugs sprang po gcig la gtad// spyang khu ltogs pa lta bu yi// ston pa blo gros seṅge la// ku re kyal ka bgyis pa lags//

// 476) ༄// rang blor shar ba'i gdams ngag zhal gdams gegs sel chen mo// pha chos kyi rgyal po rin po che// bka' drin can la skyabs su mchi// pha rje btsun de yi byin brlabs kyi// rang blo la gdams ngag 'di tsho byung*// bu dmigs med kyi snying rje ma brtan tshe// smon lam gyi brtson 'grus ma gtogs pa// gzhan don gyi zhe 'dod ma che zhig /rgyu med kyi 'bras bur 'gro nyen gda'// rang rdo rje 'chang du ma song tshe// brgyud pa gong ma ma gtogs pa// rang 'khor la bsgom du ma 'jug cig /'khrul pa la nying 'khrul bsnan nyen gda'// tshad med kyi thugs rje ma skyes tshe// tshe 'di log pa'i blo gros kyis// rtsa rlung gi gdams ngag ma bsgom shig /rang gshed rang gis bskor nyen gda'// gnyis 'dzin gyi rtog pa ma nub tshe// nga med kyi kha lta ma che zhig /mi chos bla ma'i brdzun po yis// mnar med kyi bud shing byas nyen gda'// tshe 'di'i bsam pa ma thengs tshe// khe grags kyi ri khrod ma bsten cig /nyon mongs dug gi stobs 'phel nas// rang nyid ngan sar lhung nyen gda'// snang sems gcig tu ma 'dres tshe// rtsa ba bsgom pa ma gtogs pa// mtho dman gyi las la ma 'jug cig /rang gzhan gnyis ka phung nyen gda'// 'di gzhan la bzlas pa ma lags te// rang gi shes pa bskul ba bas// dus gsum nyon mongs kyi g.yo med na// sgrib pa spangs pa'i kha tshon du// smon lam myur du 'grub pa mtshar// gegs sel chen mo rdzogs so// // 477) ༄// bcu chos kyi gegs sel zab mo ston pa dar ma blo gros kyi zhu chos// mgon po khyod ni chos kyi sku// 'khor 'das kun la khyab pa po// stobs bcu la sogs yon tan rdzogs// lhun grub rgyun chad mi mnga' ba'i// sku gsung thugs kyi phrin las kyis// 'gro kun nyes tshogs dag mdzad cing*// sangs rgyas sa la 'god mdzad pa// mgon po spyan ras gzigs la 'dud// bdag la mos gus drag po yis// bcu tshan sum cu tham pa yi// dge 'dun rnams kyis gsol btab cing*// gsang sngags tshul dang mthun par ni// phra dang rags pa'i bye brag gis// lus sems gnyis kyi gnas lugs zhus// lus sems gnyis kyi gnas lugs la// steng kha ma zhes yongs su grags// grags pa can gyi dam chos la// bshad rgyu nyung ste nyams len mang*// 'khor 'das bde sdug thams cad kyi// dang por skye ba'i rgyu dang ni// bar du gnas pa'i gzhi dang yang*// mtha' mar 'jig pa'i rkyen yang shes// thub pa'i gsung rab thams cad kyi// phyi nang gsang ba'i rten 'brel rnams// chags thogs med par mngon du 'gyur// skad cig ma dang mi rtag pa// sdug bsngal stong pa bdag med kyi// bka' rtags phyag rgya bzhi dang yang*// skad cig tsam yang mi 'bral ba// zab cing rgya che'i dam chos 'di// gsangs nas bshad pa ma go bas// da res tshogs su klog la thongs// tshogs su bklags kyang ma go na// gcig pu ri khrod dgon par song*// 'jig rten bsam pa rgyab tu skyur// lhag pa tshul khrims bslab pa bsrung*// tshig tsam gyi btsun pos mgu mi bya// sems la nyon mongs mi rgyu ba'i// spong sems brtul zhugs brtan par bya// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// brtul zhugs 'di la dka' thub mdzad// nyon mongs skyon gyis ma gos pa// skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad la// btsun po zhes kyang bstod pa yin// btsun po 'di dang bral ba la// 'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa yi// yon tan mtha' dag mi skye zhes// sde snod gsum du rgyal ba yis// nan tan chen por gsungs pas na// 'di la nan tan chen por bskyed// spong sems brtan po gzhir bzhag nas// byang chub sems kyi go bgos te// gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa yi// dbang gis smin par byas nas kyang*// tha mal lus ngag yid gsum du// skad cig tsam yang ma song ba'i// rig pa 'dzin pa'i sdom pa gzung*// rang nyid sangs rgyas sku gsum gyi// bskyed rdzogs bar chad med par bsgom// rgya la gal te rnal 'byor pa// sa steng grags pas khyab pa dang*// kun gyi snying du sdug pa dang*// bkur sti sna tshogs 'byung ba dang*// 'khor gyi 'du long byung ba rnams// 'byung ba'i rgyu dang gnas pa'i gzhi// 'jig pa'i rkyen rnams shes pa yis// rje btsun nyid la rin chen gyi// rnam par thar pas de dag bzlog

/yang rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po des// gong ma'i rten 'brel shes nas kyang*// bskyed rdzogs goms par gyur pa las// mi ma yin gyi bkur sti 'byung*// lha klu gnod sbyin dri za dang*// 'byung po'i tshogs rnams bgrang mi lang*// phun sum tshogs pa lnga yis bsdus// skye ba'i rgyu dang gnas pa'i gzhi// 'jig pa'i rkyen rnams shes pa yis// phyi nang bar chad bral bar bya// yang ma yengs gcig shos goms par bya// gong ma'i bar chad med pa dang*// bsam pa rnam par dag pa dang*// brtan zhing goms par gyur pa yis// sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs// mngon du byon zhing lung bstan dang*// grub chen brgyad po la sogs pa// so so gang 'dod dngos grub ster// rgya la gal te ku sā li// mgo chung klad skam g.yam brlag rnams// rang sems yin par ma go zhing*// sangs rgyas skye 'gag 'gro 'ong can// sgyu ma mi rtag bslu ba la// dad dang gus pa'i bsam pa yis// gzung 'dzin rtog pa'i dngos grub len// dngos grub thob nas ngan sar lhung*// dus 'dir rnal 'byor dbang phyug gtso// brgyud pa gong ma byin rlabs can// tshad ldan bla ma dam pa yi// thugs zin mos gus bsam pa yis// yon tan tshogs la 'dod pa med// mtho dman ci snang thams cad kun// rang sems snang bar go ma nges// rang gzhan 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog la// dngos grub len pa'i zhe 'dod bral// gong ma goms par byas pa la// rang nyid sangs rgyas kun gyi sku// rdo rje 'dzin pa'i ngo bo nyid// dkon mchog gsum gyi rtsa ba ste// bla ma mchog tu gyur nas kyang*// 'khor 'das kun gyi dbang phyug gtso// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro thams cad kyi// dbang phyug bdag por gyur nas kyang*// byang chub mchog tu sangs rgyas pa// bsgrubs pa'i 'bras bu thob pa yin// spyir gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa la// tshad ldan bla ma dam pa yi// byin rlabs sems la ma zhugs shing*// nyams rtogs tshad du ma skyol ba// tha snyad tshig gi be'u bum dang*// tshig tshogs spros pa'i yi ge la// zab pa'i gdams ngag re ba rnams// tug gis thug na bslu bar nges// des na rnal 'byor dbang phyug rnams// rang la skyes pa'i nyams rtogs dang*// skad cig tsam yang mi 'bral zhu// gsang sngags gegs sel zab mo 'di// ston pa dar ma blo gros kyis// dad cing gus pa'i bsam pa yis// kun la phan pa'i don du zhus// dge bas byang chub thob par shog

/rdzogs so// // 478) ༄// dpal nā ro'i brgyud pa 'di tshig brgyud min par nyams rtogs kyi brgyuud pa yin pa// oṃ swasti/ bkra shis pa dang bde legs phun sum tshogs pas phyogs dus thams cad du khyab par gyur cig 'di ltar 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pas bsdus pa'i chos thams cad/ gdod nas zhi zhing ma skyes pa rdo rje'i thugs gcig tu gyur pas/ yul dang yul can/ bya ba dang byed pa'i rtsol sgrub thams cad nye bar zhi bas/ mi shigs pa rdo rje'i sku'i dbang phyug chen por gyur pas rang gi don phun sum tshogs pa/ chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor lta bu las/ gnyis su med pa'i yon tan gyi tshogs thos pa dang*/ bsam pa dang*/ sgom pa'i shes rab kyi snang ba phyogs med du rgyas pas/ khams gsum gyi 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor byings pa la smin pa dang grol bar mdzad pa'i mthu chen po mnga' bas/ gzhan gyi don phun sum tshogs par gyur pa/ 'jig rten gyi phun sum tshogs pa stobs kyi 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal srid lta bu la ma chags pas/ padma'i rgyal po lta bur gyur pas 'gro ba dpag tu med pa'i mig rten du gyur pa/ thub pa ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi bral ba'i yon tan/ stobs dang mi 'jigs pa dang*/ ma 'dres pa'i chos 'dul ba'i sde snod rin po che la gnas brtan 'dul ba 'dzin pa chen por gyur pas/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bstan pa'i mnga' bdag tu gyur pa/ nye ring mi mthun pa'i spros pa thams cad kyis dben pa thag ring po'i khrod du/ bsod snyoms dang*/ phyag dar khrod dang*/ dur khrod la sogs pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis legs par bsngags pa'i dka' thub dang*/ dka' spyad dpag tu med pa spyad pas brtul zhugs spyod par gyur pa/ theg pa chen po gsang sngags rdo rje'i theg pa spyi dang*/ rang gi mtshan nyid thams cad la chags pa dang thogs pa med par thugs su chud cing*/

grub pa thob pa'i rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug rnams kyi gdams ngag dang rjes su bstan pa la nyams myong dang mngon par rtogs pa skyes pas/ gong ma rnams kyi brgyud pa 'dzin pa/ bsod nams kyi bsags pa phul du gyur pas/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i phun sum tshogs pa'i mnga' bdag tu gyur kyang*/ thub pa'i bstan pa la snang ba brnyes kyang*/ lbu ba rdol ba lta bu snying po med par gzigs shing btang bas bral ba dang rnam par smin pa'i yon tan thams cad kyi dbang phyug chen por gyur cing*/ bla ma dam pa rnams kyi rgyal srid la mnga' brnyes pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen rgyal ba'i spyan sngar/ shākya'i dge slong bsod snyoms pa/ ri khrod pa brtul zhugs spyod pa'i rnal 'byor pas zhu ba/ spyir 'di rnams thams cad kyi 'dug lugs khyed rang nyid kyis mkhyen cing thugs su ma chud pa med mod kyi/ 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho ni gting mtha' ring*/ snyigs ma lnga bdo ba'i dus la bab/ thub pa'i bstan pa rin po che ni nub tu nye/ phan pa dang bde ba la dga' ba rnams kyi gros dang mdun ma la nyan pa yang mi 'dug zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos rang gzhan la myur du phan pa nyams su longs byas nas/ lto gos chos gsum sbyar yang*/ 'dis nga mgo bskor/ gnod pa skyel snyam nas/ mi dga' zhing*/ gnod pa skyel nges pa'i phye gtor tshig re la dga' bar yang snang*/ rang gzhan thams cad kyi don bsgrub pa gcig pu yin par go bas/ nga 'bu yang tshogs pa spangs nas gcig pur bsdad/ slob dpon yang yum rgan yar la 'bod zer ba des/ mi chos dang phyogs ris kyi 'brel chod/ sgrub pa 'phel por 'dug snyam pas nga 'bu yang shin tu dga' bar byung*/ thugs la yang shin tu btags/ da rung yang rang gzhan gyi don phun sum tshogs pa mdzad par zhu// ༈ //rgyal khams phyogs med kyi yang dgon/ gangs kha ba can gyi ri khrod/ sgam po dpal gyi rtse mo nas/

shākya'i dge slong ldom bu pa// brtul zhugs spyod pa'i ri khrod pa// dben par gnas pa'i rnal 'byor pas// bu gcig rnal 'byor dbang phyug la// dga' bas rjes su yi rang 'bul// yang gcig dge ba'i bshes gnyen pa// zur po cung zhig zhu lags na// khyed kyi sku mched ri khrod pa// phyogs med kun na bzhugs pa rnams// shākya'i rgyal po'i sras bzhin du// bslab gsum rin chen rgyan gyis mdzes// ting 'dzin zas la longs spyod cing*// lhan skyes bdud rtsi'i btung ba 'thung*// gnyug ma ye shes rang drod gon// bdag med gzhi yi 'bol stan bting*// srog la mi blta go bgos shing*// dka' spyad drag po'i brtul zhugs kyis// gong ma'i rnam thar rjes bsnyags zhes// he he thams cad de skad zer// ku re min na dga' ba la// snying nas bden na ngo mtshar che// sgro skur med pa kho na 'dra// ngo dga' yin te rgya la che// 'di la ngo mtshar che rgyu med// nga rang ngan te bla ma bzang*// dpal ldan phag mo gru pa yin// sangs rgyas brgyud pa bar ma chad// mya ngan mi 'da' rtag tu bzhugs// mkhyen dang brtse dang nus par ldan// sku gsung thugs nyid mi zad pa// rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i bdag nyid kyis// brgyud 'dzin rjes 'jug bu slob rnams// byin gyis rlob par mi mdzad na// sngon gyi thugs dam bsnyel lam ci// rdo rje 'chang gi spyan snga ru// ji ltar khas blangs dam bcas pa'i// dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma yi tshogs// bu gces se bsrung bar mi byed na// su zhig dam tshig nyams par 'gyur// ji ltar byas kyang ri khrod pa// rnal 'byor dbang phyug dam tshig can// cis kyang mi zad dbang med lags// cha la je bzang je bzang mchi// nā ro chen po'i gdung rgyud 'di// tshig gi brgyud par ma song zhing*// nyams rtogs brgyud pa ma chad pas// nub kyis dogs pa nga la med// ku re yin na rang la sdig
/de bas sgrub la nan tan mdzod// nan tan byas pa'i rnal 'byor pa// phun sum tshogs pa'i yon tan gyi// 'bras bu ston thog bzhin du mchi// cis kyang 'ong ba rgyu 'bras yin/ dge bshes rgyal ba la'o// //

479) ༄// chos tshul bzhin nyams su len dgos pa'i gdams ngag gros mdun chen mo// skyon med yon tan rab rdzogs pa// chos sku bde chen 'gro ba'i mgon// mnyam med bla ma rin chen gyi// zhabs kyi ze'u 'brur gtsug gis 'dud// khong 'jig rten mgon po'i bka' drin gyis// rang la nyams myong bag tsam skyes// gcig pur ri khrod kyi dgon par bsdad// myong ba'i 'gro ldog bag tsam go /de klad pa sla bas gsang ma thub// gzhan la bzlas pas tshogs pa 'phel// deng sang tshogs dpon chen por song*// mi nga la tshogs pa mang po yod// snying nas byang chub sgrub pa nyung*// mang po'i rkang grangs rtsi sa med// nga yi grwa pa gang yin pa// srog dang bsdos la byang chub bsgrub// yang nga la nye gnas mang po yod// ri khrod 'grim pa shin tu nyung*// chos nyams su len na nye gnas yin// nga yi nye gnas gang yin pa// shi yang ri khrod dgon pa 'grims// nga la mi chen mang po yod// che thabs dam chos spyod pa nyung*// ngan byed la mi chen mi zer bas// chen po ring po ag tshoms can// chos dang bstun na chen por mchi// yang nga la btsun po mang po yod// bslab pa mchog la gus na yang*// spang bya gnyen po bsten pa las// nyon mongs rang sar grol ba nyung*// sems skye med goms na btsun por mchi// nga la mkhas pa mang po yod// rtog ge rig byed ma gtogs pa// gzung 'dzin gnyis med go ba nyung*// don ma go mkhas pa mi srid de// sems gnyis med go na mkhas pa yin// nga la bu slob mang po yod// brgyud pa 'dzin pa shin tu nyung*// nga yi bu slob gang yin rnams// stong nyid snying rje'i brgyud pa zung*// rje gong ma 'di las byung ba yin// nga la tshogs dpon mang po yod// ma bsgrubs tshogs dpon mi 'ong ste// sa bon med pa'i 'bras bu bzhin// rang mgo ma bskor nags su song*// nga la rnyed tshol mang po yod// sems la dgos dgu rnyed pa nyung*// mngon shes grong chog rten 'brel mkhan// mi mgo ma bskor dmyal bar 'gro// rang la rang snying mi rje 'am// yang nga la sgom chen mang po yod// nyams dang mthong snang rloms pa las// gnyis med ye shes rtogs pa nyung*// byas pa mi rtag ma go 'am// tshe la long med log shes spongs// yang nga la bzang po mang po yod// rang rgyud bzang ngan mi blta bar// gzhan skyon tshol zhing nga yin sgrogs// 'di ni ngan rtags chen po yin// bzang po 'dod na rang rgyud sbyongs// kwa rang dang 'dra ba'i bu slob rnams// so so nga rgyal gang yod pa// dam chos 'di dang zhu gtug mdzod// rtag tu kha ta byas na yang*// khyed kyang sun la nga yang skyo// yang yang 'thab cing gcud pa yi// dgra zun lhan cig 'tshogs pa min// tshogs kyi bshad bshud mi lang ste// rtag tu pag shi byed mi khom// btub na 'di dang zhu gtug mdzod// mi btub ji ltar dgyes dgyes mdzod// kho bo sprang po ri khrod pa// sems sku gsum zhal ngo ma bltas nas// 'khor bzang ngan mang po'i ngo 'dzum la// sgeg mo'i me long ji bzhin du// dga' 'am mi dga' bltas bltas nas// chags sdang mang po skye bar gda'// rnal 'byor shes pa gang dgar gtong*// ku re yin na rang la sdig

/snying gtam tshig gcig 'chad pa de// bu snying dang 'dra bas thugs la zhog /tshe rabs dpag tu med pa nas// 'brel pa zab mo yod par nges// nga yon tan med pa'i sprang po la// snying nas sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes skyes// mos gus gdung shugs drag po yis// lus srog la ma bltas drung du phyin// rgyu tshad med snying rje chen po yis// byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed nas// tshad ldan bla ma dam pa yi// ci gsung bka' dang mi 'gal bar// lus ngag yid gsum rdul du brlags// tshe 'di dang phyi ma thams cad kyi// so nam bla ma'i phyogs su byas// grub thob brgyud pa'i gdams ngag la// sbyor ba dngos gzhi rjes gsum dang*// zhing dang bsam pa dngos po yi// nyes pa'i skyon dang bral bar byas// ji ltar gsungs pa'i dam chos la// lkog tu ma lus nyams su myong*// mnyam med dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang*// bla ma rin chen la sogs pa// brgyud pa gong ma rnams dang yang*// dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma tshogs kyis// cis kyang byin gyis rlobs par nges// bu gcig ri khrod dgon pa bsten// tshul bzhin nyams su blangs gyur na// rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa na// yon tan mi skye dbang med yin// sgyid lug snyoms las mi mdzad par// sgrub pa tshul bzhin mdzad par zhu// bu khyed kyi zhabs 'bring zhabs tog dang*// mos gus gdung shugs drag po de// mi kho bo'i shes pa'i khur du thal// khur yang bar mi gda' je ljir song*// da lta nga yi spyod 'gros dang*// brtson 'grus 'bad rtsol 'di tsam gyis// bu khyed kyi bsam pa mi 'grub pas// ngas kyang 'jig rten spros pa bcad// zang zing spros pa ma bcad na// 'jig rten zang zing sna tshogs la// dga' dga' spro spro byas pa 'dis// nga yang ngan sar ltuung nyen gda'// khyed kyang rnyed tshol mang por song*// rnyed pa btsal ba'i zas nor gyis// rje gong ma rnams kyi zhabs 'dren byas// skyob pa shākya seng ge yis// mgon po zla 'od gzhon nu yi// ma dag 'khor du lung bstan pa// nged rang pang la 'ong 'ong 'dra// dpal ldan phag mo gru pa yi// zhabs 'dren chen por ma song bar// gcig pu ri khrod mi 'grim re// zang zing spros pa mi gcod re// 'du 'dzi g.yeng ba mi skyungs re// nyams rtogs gnyis med mi bsgom re// rje gong ma'i brgyud pa mi 'dzin re// ting 'dzin zas su mi za re// e ma rnal 'byor dbang phyug rnams// sdug bsngal byas pa'i 'bras bu de// ri khrod dgon par smin pa yin// mchog thun mong gnyis kyi gter kha ni// bla ma dam pas 'byed pa yin// rnal 'byor bde skyid longs spyod rnams// dben pa'i gnas su myong ba yin// phyi dang nang gi bar chad rnams// dpa' bo mkha' 'gros bzlog pa yin// snang srid 'khor 'das thams cad kun// sems kun bzang yangs pa'i dkyil 'khor du// spangs thob bzang ngan ma mchis pa'i// rnal 'byor dbang phyug chen po rnams// lus sems gnyis kyi gnas lugs la// lam ji ltar nyams su blang ba'i tshul// thabs lam bye brag mtha' yas pa// rgyu 'bras rten 'brel zab mo rnams// ri khrod dgon par sgom pas mthong*// ston pa shākya seng ges kyang*// don 'di ljon pas zhus pa las// bsam gtan rnams dang mngon shes rnams// dgon pa rnams su 'byung zhes gsungs// slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis// ri bo gser du bsgyur nas kyang*// 'gro la phan par byed pa yi// thugs kyi dgongs pa byung nas kyang*// gser 'gyur rtsi yi sbyor ba yis// lho phyogs dril bu'i ri zhes pa// gser du 'gyur la khad pa dang*// thugs dam rje btsun sgrol ma yis// sdig pa 'di 'dra byed dam zhes// bka' bkyon gsung nas bzhag pa la// nged kyi zang zing bag tsam gyis// phan du re ba gcol chung yin// gcig pu ri khrod dgon pa bsten// 'jig rten mgon po rin chen kyang*// ri khrod dgon par sdod cig dang*// skyon dag yon tan rab rdzogs pa// kho bos yon len bka' bstsal gsung*// des na rnal 'byor dbang phyug rnams// bu so so ri khrod dgon pa bsten// rang gzhan kun la phan pa yi// mthar thug mdun gros zab mo 'di// rang dang 'dra ba'i bu slob rnams// cis kyang thugs la bzhag par zhu// dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yum du gyur pa/

rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma'i byin rlabs las byung ba/ phyin ci log gi rtog pa 'jig rten chos brgyad kyi spros pa gcod pa'i gdams ngag yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che dbang gi rgyal po lta bu gros mdun chen mo zhes bya ba rdzogs so// // 480) ༄// bag chags dag pa'i 'bras bu dri med chos sku yin pa'i rten 'brel zab mo// bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// sgrub pa'i snying stobs chung ba dang*// nyon mongs yul la zhen pa dang*// nyams myong yod pa rgud pa dang*// 'khrul pa'i bag chags brtas pa'i 'khor// 'byung bar 'gyur ba'i rten 'brel ci// sna tshogs gdug pa'i sa phyogs su// zab mo chos la bar gcod pa// mi mthun phyogs kyis gang ba'i sar// rang dbang med par sdod dgos pa'i// mi mthun rkyen gyi rten 'brel ci// 'grogs shing ngo srung dka' ba yi// gdug pa'i lha 'dre gtum po'i tshogs// nyon mongs drag las byung ba dang*// gtan du 'grogs pa'i rten 'brel ci// nam zhig 'gro ba'i dus kyi tshe// char sgang lhags sgang la sogs pa'i// shin tu sdug pa'i dus tshod du// rang dbang med par 'gro dgos pa'i// 'di yi rgyu mtshan ji ltar lags// 'gro mgon dpal ldan chos kyi rje// mnyam med bla ma dam pa yi// brgyud pa gong mas gnang ba'i rdzas// bya rog 'gums par 'gyur ba dang*// de na skyes pa'i padma la// 'bras bu med pa'i rten 'brel ci// bdag nyid chen pos gsung bar zhu// rgyu 'bras kyi rten 'brel zab mo 'di// rgyu las 'bras bu 'byung nges pas// rgyal bas bsngags pa'i smon lam la// sngon gyi dam bcas ma brjed par// khyod kyis nan tan chen po gyis// skyon dag yon tan rdzogs nas mchi// rtsa ni gang yin rlung gang yin// yi ge gang yin dang po yi// rlung sems tshogs pa'i nyams myong gang*// de rnams gang gis sbyong bar nges// 'khor ba mya ngan 'das pa yi// sbyong byed ma pham mgon pos gsungs// bag chags dag pa'i 'bras bu 'di// gnyis ldan dri med chos sku yin// chags sogs dri mas 'phags pa mchod pa gang*// gong ma rnams la ha la'i dug blud bzhin// khong khro gdug pa zhe sdang mi bzad 'di// gnas skabs dus rnams kun gyi bde ba rnams// 'byung ba'i rgyu rkyen kun tu mi 'gyur zhes//

// 481) ༄// 'phags pa char kas spong mgu spyod pa las gsungs pa'i so thar me long*// na mo ratna tra ya yā/ na ma ārya ba lo ke te shwa ra ya/ bo dhi sa two ya/ ma hā sa twa ya/ ma hā ka ru ni ka yā/ tadya tha/ a te na te a ba ri had te/ ma hā bi dang gam swāhā/ nyon mongs pas gzir ba'i shākya'i bu mo rnams la skem mo// go'u tam gyi skyo ba bskyed nas bden pa bzhis grol ba dang*/ thub pa dga' bo dmyal ba dang*// zas gtsang rgyal po ma skyes dgra// tsher mas spro ba bskyed pa dang*// mig dmar tshar ni bcad pa dang*// char ka dma' ni babs pa dang*// nye rgyal mdzes la dad pa yi// dus su bden bzhi zab mo yis// smin par byed pa'i dge ba'i bshes// dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// yangs pa can gyi dge slong rnams// phan tshun rtsod par gyur pa las// skyob pa shākya seṅge yis// rtsod pa zhi bar ma nus pas// de tshe rgyal ba mkha' la gshegs// bcu gnyis lo yi grangs snyed du// rtsod par gyur kyang btang snyoms mdzad// bdag nyid chen pos yul phyogs der// nam yang ma gshegs thabs mdzad pas// rtsod pa ngam ngam shugs kyis zhi// su zhig de la snying rje che// las mthun par snang ba'i skyid sdug rnams// rgyu gang las byung bar shes lags sam// rgyu gang las 'byung bar ma shes na// phyi nang rten 'brel zab mo'i gnad// gtso bo 'khor rnams byin gyis rlobs// 'khor gyis gtso bo byin gyis rlob// ga bur gla rtsi gar log spos// tshad dang ldan pa'i dri bzhin du// buddha dharmā tsa tsa ni// shin tu zab pa'i rten 'brel nyid// des na mi g.yo rdo rje dang*// skad cig tsam yang 'bral mi bya// bag chags sa bon sbyong bar nges// mthar thug 'bras bu thob par nges// gtan gyi so nam tshar bar nges// 'di ltar thub pa chen po'i chos// nyon mongs gsum la chags pa dang*// sdang bar byed pa gang yin pas// lha mi la sogs gong ma yi// 'bras bu thob par 'gyur ba la// nyon mongs gdug pas dkrugs pa'i yid// 'di yis thar pa mi thob ces// so so thar pa'i me long la// bltas na nyes pa spang bar bya// 'di ni 'phags pa char ka las// spong mgu spyod pa nyid las gsungs//

// 482) ༄// rten 'brel ma 'dzoms pas dus yun bskal pa'i bar chad du 'gyur ba shes dgos pa// chos rnams gdod nas ma skyes pa smra bsam brjod med kyi ngo bor gnas pa la smra ba dang bsam pa dang brjod pa rnam pa gsum gyis ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i don rtogs par mi 'gyur ba dang*/ rtogs pa rnams kyis kyang rtogs pa de'i don goms par bya zhing*/ smra ba dang*/ bsam pa dang*/ brjod pa med pa'i spyod pas/ slob dpon shan ta de ba ltar/ dus 'da' bar byas nas/ bla ma rin po che'i dgongs pa lta ba'i mthar thug blta bya lta byed thams cad dang bral ba/ spyod pa'i mthar thug spang blang dang dgag sgrub thams cad dang bral ba/ chags sdang med pa'i lus ngag dang*/ tshul khrims rnam par dag pa zhes pa lta sgom spyod pa gcig tu gyur pa la tshegs med pas/ lta spyod sgom gsum ya ma bral bar dus rtag tu gnas par bya'o// 'di yang 'di 'ba' zhig tu ma zad de/ 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa'i chos thams cad lta ba dang sgom pa spyod pa rnam pa gsum mam/ bsam pa dang sbyor ba dang mthar thug rnam pa gsum mam/ zhing dang bsam pa dngos po rnam pa gsum la sogs pa sgrub par byed pa'i tshul lugs dpag tu med pa zhig bshad pa dang*/ rten 'brel ma 'dzoms pas myur du mi 'grub pa dang*/ yun ring du 'gor ba dang*/ gtan du mi 'grub pa'i bar chad du 'gyur bar shes par bya'o// // 483) ༄// nyams rtogs kyi gnad gsang sgro 'dogs gcod pa gzhon nu shes rab kyi zhu tshig/ rtogs pa mkha' 'dra'i ngang nyid las// thugs rje nyi zla'i 'od lta bus// gdul bya'i re 'dod skong mdzad pa// rje rin po che la phyag 'tshal lo// sems nyid gdod nas dag pa la// 'khor bar 'khyams pa ji ltar lags// tshe 'di'i 'khri ba chod gyur nas// chos lam du nges par 'gro ba la// thabs mchog gang gis 'grub pa lags// tshad med snying rje ma mchis na// rtogs pa mthon por rloms na yang*// theg pa chen por btub lags sam// mtshan nyid ldan pa'i bla ma yi// ci gsung bka' las ma 'das na// de nyid gcig pus lam bgrod dam// rang sems chos skur rtogs gyur pas// sku gnyis shugs las 'byung lags sam// 'on te thub pas gsungs pa yi// so so'i rgyu la 'bad 'tshal lam// sangs rgyas rnams kyi chos gcig ste// grub thob rnams kyi thugs dgongs ni// gcig la klu sgrub byams pa gnyis// grub mtha' mi mthun ji ltar lags// sangs rgyas rnams la rang rgyud kyis// bsdus pa'i ye shes mnga' mi mnga'// sgro 'dogs bcad phyir zhus pa'i lan// brtse bas bdag la gsung bar zhu// thugs dang 'gal ba byung srid na// bla ma mchog la bzod par gsol// 'di zhus dge ba gang thob des// 'gro rnams myur du sangs rgyas shog/

// 484) ༄// nyams rtogs kyi gnad gsang sgro 'dogs gcod pa gzhon nu shes rab kyi zhus lan// bla ma rin chen zhabs la 'dud// rang sems skye 'gag med pa la// 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i rgyu mtshan ni// bdag tu 'dzin pa'i rtog pas lan// bdag med rtogs na rang sar grol// chos lam du 'gro bar byed bzhed na// 'jig rten 'di yi zhen pa bcad// stong nyid snying rje bsgoms gyur na// thams cad gru bzhi lam par mchi// rang la zhe 'dod med pa yi// snying rje chen po ma mchis na// theg pa chen por mi mchi bas// bla ma sangs rgyas rnams kyis gsungs// mtshan nyid ldan pa'i bla ma ni// ston pa sangs rgyas gcig pur bas// sangs rgyas 'dra ba'i bla ma yi// ci gsung bka' bzhin bsgrubs lags na// ci 'dod 'bras bu 'byung ba la// the tshom som nyi ga la 'tshal// rang sems chos skur rtogs lags kyang*// thabs dang bral ba'i shes rab kyis// mthar thug sangs rgyas mi thob par// rnal 'byor dbang phyug rtsod pa med// sa ra ha la sogs pa rnams// nan tan chen pos gsungs pa yin// sangs rgyas nyid dang 'dra ba yi// klu sgrub ma pham la sogs pa// grub pa'i mtha' dang bral ba la// grub mtha' sna tshogs ma mthun pa// gdul bya'i bsam pas gsungs pa bas// mthar thug sangs rgyas ye shes ni// yod med spros pa'i yul las 'das// nyams rtogs ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pas// ngam ngam shugs kyis go ba las// thos dang bsam pa'i shes rab kyis// yod dang med par brtags pa yis// sangs rgyas ye shes go re skan// dad dang gus pa'i bsam pa yis// dge slong gzhon nu shes rab kyis// dris pa'i lan du smras pa 'di// gang gi thugs dang 'gal na yang*// 'gal ba de la bzod par zhu// //

485) ༄// sgam po zangs zlum yang dgon du mos gus can gyi nye gnas kyi zhu lan// oṃ swasti/ drang srong chen po brtul zhugs mthar phyin pa// chos dbyings mkha' la ye shes nyi ma shar// 'gro kun blo yi mun pa sel mdzad pa// mnyam med bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// sngon thub pa chen po bzhugs dus su// 'bras bu myur du thob pa dang*// 'bras bu dus su bstan pa de// cis kyang de ltar lags sam ci// gsang sngags rdo rje'i theg pa dang*// zab cing rgya che'i dam chos rnams// lnga brgya tha mar 'byung 'gyur ba// nges par gsungs pa ji ltar lags// ston pa gzhan la med pa'i chos// gsang sngags rdo rje'i theg pa 'di// bstan pa 'di la 'byung 'gyur pa// a de yi rgyu mtshan ji ltar lags// deng sang dus kyi chos pa rnams// 'jig rten zang zing nor rdzas gsog /khyim pa rnams kyi las la zhugs// dam chos mi spyod ji ltar lags// sangs rgyas zhi khro yab yum tshogs// mtha' yas rnam pa sna tshogs la// sngon dang da lta'i dus dag la// sgrub thag nye ring mchis lags sam// sgrub pa byed pa'i gang zag rnams// sgrub pa yun ring byas na yang*// 'bras bu gang yang mi gda' ba// de yi rgyu mtshan ji ltar lags// srog dang bsdos pa'i bla ma yi// drung du sdod snying mi 'dod pa// gzhan du 'gro bar 'dod pa yi// de yi rgyu mtshan ji ltar lags// mtho dman cal col zhus tshig bdun// blo las byung nas zhus pa 'di// sems kyi sgro 'dogs gcod slad du// thugs kyis dgongs nas gsung bar zhu// ༈ //thub pa chen po rtag tu bzhugs// snying nas sgrub pa byed nus na// sngon dang da lta'i dus dag la// 'bras bu thob la khyad par med// rigs can snying stobs ldan pa rnams// lnga brgya'i dus su nyon mongs bdo// gnyen po spang bya la ltos pas// zab cing rgya che 'byung ba lags// ston pa thugs rje chen po 'dis// nyon mongs bdo ba'i zhing bzung bas// nyon mongs lam du byed pa 'di// gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa lags// deng sang dus kyi chos pa rnams// chos min rtags tsam 'dzin pa ni// chos kyi yon tan skyes pa yi// bla ma med pas lan pa yin// sangs rgyas zhi khro yab yum tshogs// blo yi 'jug sgo sna tshogs la// sems 'dzin zhi gnas bstan pa yin// lhag mthong skye ba'i thabs su gcig

/sgrub pa yun ring byed pa kun// nyon mongs ma spangs tshogs ma bsags// bral dang rnam smin 'bras bu ni// rgyu med 'bras bu ga la srid// bla ma'i drung du mi dga' ba// rgyu mtshan mang po yod pa rnams// rnam gsum rnam bzhi'i chos dbye bye// phal cher bla ma'i skyon du mchi// sgam po zangs zlum yang dgon du// brtul zhugs spyod pa'i rnal 'byor pa// mos gus can gyi nye gnas kyis// mnyes par byas nas zhus pa lags// // 486) ༄// zhe 'dod kyi bsam pa tha dad la cir yang snang du btub pa zhes pa// sna tshogs snang ba dkar dmar 'di// kha cig phyi rol don du 'dod// kha cig rang gi sems su 'dod// kha cig snang ba med par 'dod// thams cad rang gi sems yin pas// zhe 'dod bsam pa tha dad la// cir yang snang du btub pas na// rtag dang chad pa la sogs kyang*// bsags pa chung zhing dman pa yi// log lta can la nges pas na// lta ba'i bye brag khas len pa// lung dang rigs pa nyams myong gis// dgag par gsungs pa yin mod kyi// lung 'di 'dam rlon phur pa 'dra// gsung rab rnams na kun kyang snang*// rigs pa rang gi zhe 'dod smra// nyams myong nyams su myong ba la// nyams su myong bya myong byed med// des na dpal ldan rin po che// lta ba blta bya lta byed bral// sgom pa nyams su myong dang bral// spyod pa dgag dang sgrub pa bral// 'bras bu re dogs gnyis dang bral// bral ba rnam pa bzhi po 'di// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// zhi ba 'dod chags bral gyur pa// dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi yum// 'phags pa kun gyis mchod pa'i gnas// bla ma rin chen dam pa'i chos// skyabs chen dam pa yin par nges// // 487) ༄// sgrub pa nyams len gyi skor zhal gdams le tshan dum bu drug/ na mo ratna gu ru/ stong dang snying rje dbyer med pa// 'di de skye ba'i sa bon yin// tshogs dang gus 'dud drag pos ni// bogs 'don gong du khrid pa yin// rang gzhan tha mal lus dang ngag

/yid gsum spong ba mthun rkyen yin// gsal dang sgrim dang ma yengs pa// dam chos 'di yi man ngag yin// rnam pa gsal zhing nga rgyal brtan// rnam dag dran pa lag len yin// bdag 'dzin dug chen gsum po 'di// rgyu dang bcas pa bcom pa yin// lus dang srog la mi ltos shing*// lceb pa'i sbyor bas 'grub pa yin// lus tha mal gyi kha tshis ma che bar// lto gos kyi sems khral ma mang bar// 'khrul pa'i chos brgyad ma bsam par// bu cis kyang mi stongs 'chi ba dang*// 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal zhe la zhog /bu dbang bzhi rten 'brel zab mo yis// lus ngag yid gsum ci brje ltos// ༈ //mnyam med bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud// tshad med bsod nams stobs las 'khrungs// ston pa'i bstan la rab tu byung*// thos dang bsam pas rgyud sbyangs shing*// bslab gsum ma gi'i sbyor ba yis// 'khor ba'i dug sbrul zhi bar byas// gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa la// rdo rje 'chang dang 'dra ba yi// zhabs kyi padmor spyi gtugs shing*// bsam gyis mi khyab dpag med pa'i// mnyes pa gsum gyis mnyes mdzad nas// lhan skyes gnyug ma'i bdud rtsi mchog /mos gus lce yis blangs nas kyang*// sku gsung thugs nyid rgyas mdzad cing*// zab mo rdo rje theg pa yis// don kun sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor pa// mnyam nyid gnam mtsho phyug mo la// rtsa ba brgyud pa'i bla ma dang*// dus gsum 'phags pa mnyes mdzad pa'i// rnal 'byor dbang phyug chen po la// bdag kyang dga' bas rjes yi rang*// ji srid 'khor ba ma stong par// skyid sdug gcig tu gyur pa yi// smon lam dpag med btab pa de// nam yang bslu ba med pas na// sgrub la nan tan gces mdzad pa// nged rang spad dang 'gro drug gis// so nam yin par thugs la zhog /bu khyod kyi pa pha rin chen de// sems kun bzang nam mkha'i klong dkyil nas// thugs rje nyi zla'i 'od phyung nas// 'gro drug mi shes mun pa sel// bu dga' bar soms dang rnal 'byor pa// yang khyod kyi pa pha rin chen de// blo 'das gangs kyi rtse mo nas// gnyis med rten 'brel rdo rje'i gsung*// seṅge dkar mo'i sgra skad sgrog

/khams gsum zil gnon ngo mtshar che// yang khyod kyi pa pha rin chen de// nam mkha' mdzod la mnga' brnyes pas// dbul ba'i 'jigs pa gcod par byed// bu gsol ba thob dang dgos 'dod 'byung*// mi nga rang ngan te bla ma bzang*// 'jig rten mgon po rin po che// dpal phag mo gru pa'i jo sras yin// dran pa tsam gyis dga' ba skye// bsam pa tsam gyis brod pa skye// gsol ba btab pas yon tan skye// kwa re dga' re skyid nga re dga'// skye sa pham ste 'gro sa rgyal// dpal ldan thugs rje'i zhags pa yis// dbus gtsang rig pa'i gnas su drangs// shi yang 'di nas 'gro re skan// nga pho sgo zhan te dam chos bzang*// chos gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa la// sgrub la nan tan gces su byas// phyag rgya che la sbar zin byas// ri khrod gangs khrod dgon par byas// de kha pho zur po ku re lags// rdzogs so// ༈ //ji ltar padmo utpa la// 'dam gyis ma gos ji bzhin du// mi mchog dpa' bo khyod nyid ni// nyes pa'i dri mas yongs ma gos// ji ltar me tog ku mud ta// nyi ma'i zer gyis kha 'byed pa// de bzhin rigs can skyes bu yang*// bla ma dam pas smin par byed// ji ltar dpa' bo ru mtshon can// pha rol g.yul las rgyal ba ltar// khyod kyis thub pa'i bstan pa la// mi nub rgyal mtshan dam pa bzung*// ji ltar seṅge'i rang sgra yis// wa tshogs thams cad 'byer ba ltar// shākya seṅge'i dam chos kyis// mi shes log lta'i tshogs rnams skrag /'gyur med rdo rje'i gdan steng na// sems nyid rang byung bcom ldan 'das// chos brgyad spangs pa'i dad gus kyis// 'bral ba med par khyod kyis gzigs// bu gcig khyod kyi rnam thar 'di// sngon gyi byang chub sems dpa' 'dra// rang gi lus dang srog bas phangs// glang chen smyon pa'i spyod 'gros thongs// ma ga dha yi rdo rje gdan// byang chub mchog gi shing drung du// rdzogs pa'i byang chub sangs rgyas pa// go'u tam dpa' bo bcom ldan gyis// gang zhig nga la gzugs su mthong*// gang zhig nga la sgrar shes pa// log par mthong la zhugs pa ste// skye bo de dag nga mi mthong*// thugs rjes dgongs nas gsungs pa de// dad gus gdung bas ma bzod kyang*// thub pa'i de nyid chos kyi sku// mi mchog khyod kyis nyams su longs//

༈ //rgyud pa'i gdung 'tshob rgyal ba rnams kyi sras// thub pa'i bstan la bslab gsum rgyal mtshan 'dzin// mi yi seṅge rnal 'byor dbang phyug kun// nga rgyal spros pa chod la ri la song*// ༈ //dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// gsang chen bla med sems kyi gshis// spros med lhan cig skyes pa de// grub thob gong ma rnams kyis gsungs// brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyi khrid// mos gus can gyi rgyud la shar// slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis// 'od gsal don dam bden par gsungs// 'di las phul sa ma mchis par// sprang po nga la nges shes yod// ji ltar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyis// gling bzhi 'jig rten snang bar bas// rgyal ba'i 'od la phyogs ris med// rta bdun shing rtar ldan pa yang*// thub pa che la 'gran du med// nye bar zhi ba'i 'od gsal 'di// 'phags pa'i gzhi rten yin na yang*// mi gnas mya ngan 'das pa la// 'gran du yod pa ma yin te// gling bzhi gling mchog 'dzam gling 'dir// g.ya' bral rin chen gser 'chang ba'i// rten gyi gang zag mang lags kyang*// rin chen dbang gi rgyal po de// khyu mchog klu dbang glang chen gyi// spyi gtsug rgyan du gyur pa las// 'dzam gling gser phye can la min// bdag po dbang thang rigs rnams kyi// rin chen bye brag gang yin pa// shes rab can gyis rtogs par gyis// ༈ //bdag gi bsam pa rgyu las 'bras bu'i tshul// ded dpon mdza' bo'i bu mo ji bzhin du// byas pa dran pa sad nas smin snyam na// bdag gis byas pa'i las kyi 'bras bu ni// byas shing bsags pa sngon du song ba de// ri bo rdib pa'i 'og tu song ba ltar// dran bsam med par rang dbang med par byung*// las kyi tshul ni 'di ltar zab gyur na// mkhas pa ci phyir nags su gnas mi byed// dkar po dge ba rnams kyi srog gyur pa// dam pa rnams sam sems can gang la yang*// gus pa spangs pa'i lus ngag yid kyi las// che bar gyur tam yang na phra yang rung*// srog rtsa khab kyi rtse mos btsugs gyur kyang*// mi 'tsho 'chi bar gyur pa ji bzhin du// rang srog rang gis srung ba gces gyur ces// rang la snying brtse yod pa'i mi rnams kyis// rang gis rang la ci phyir 'dems mi byed//

༈ //thub pa chen po 'gro ba'i gnyen gyur pas// bar du gcod par 'gyur bar dam bcas pa// de la bar du gcod par mi 'gyur zhes// sus kyang rgol zhing rtsod par mi nus na// 'dul ba rgya mtshor ston pas gang gsungs pa'i// bar du gcod par 'gyur pa'i nyes ltung la// da rung 'dzem pa'i bsam pa ma skyes na// stobs dang mi 'jigs yon tan rgya mtsho'i tshogs// e ma bdag gis nam zhig thob par 'gyur// // 488) ༄// mi nyag rgyal po sogs la gnang ba'i gsung 'phrin dum bu gcig/ oṃ swasti/ chos kyi rgyal po 'gro ba'i mgon// rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa rnams// dngos dang 'phrin dang yi ge las// gong ma'i zhabs la phyag byas nas// gnod pa chung ngam nyam nga ba chung ngam// bskyod pa yang ngam 'tsho ba bde 'am// stobs dang bde ba la reg par gnas sam// zhes zhus pa'i rjes la/ 'dod pa'i don kun zhu don gsol// mi nyag rgyal po la sogs pa// chos kyi rgyal po rnams kyi 'phrin// thub pa rnams kyi gsung rab dang*// mthun par gyur pa ngo mtshar che// don 'di gzhan la dka' bar gnas// // 489) ༄// rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i gsang tshig 'phags pa do pa la gnang ba// sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku// rdo rje 'chang gi ngo bo nyid// dkon mchog gsum gyi rtsa ba ste// bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// lta ba'i rbad kham che chung ba// srog ltos pa med na che ba yin// rtogs pa skyes pa zhig gtsigs su che// 'gyur ba med na bden pa yin// sgom pa'i blo bcad che chung ba// srog ltos med na che ba yin// dus rgyun chad med pa zhig gtsigs su che// mnyam rjes med na bden pa yin// spyod pa'i tshan kha che chung ba// sbyang sdom spyod na che ba yin// grogs su 'gyur ba zhig gtsigs su che// gnyis su med na bden pa yin// 'bras bu'i gnas lugs mthong ma mthong*// rgyu 'bras go na mthong ba yin// rjes dpag go ba zhig gtsigs su che// mthar thug 'bras bu sku gsum yin// de gzhan la bzlas pa ma lags te// bu rnal 'byor dbang phyug brtul zhugs can// ri khrod 'grims pa'i sgrub pa po// gcig pur sdod pa'i snying stobs can// bla ma mnyes byas mos gus can// dus gsum rgyal ba'i sras gcig pu// rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i gsang tshig 'di// 'phags pa do pas zhus pa lags//

༈ //mgon po thams cad mkhyen pa la// rgyal ba'i sras kyis zhu ba zhus// sgra la 'jug pa'i rig pa gsung*// 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug dang*// nyes pa'i sgra la zhe sdang zhing*// 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug med// legs pa'i sgra la chags pa yi// 'dun pa skye bar gyur pa na// sangs rgyas chos la mi slob zhes// mgon po thams cad mkhyen pas gsungs// 'gro ba'i mgon po gnyen gcig pu// rje btsun 'jam dbyangs zhal snga nas// nyon mongs la sogs nyes pa yi// sgra rnams ji snyed yod pa dang*// nyon mongs med pa rgyal ba'i gsung*// mnyam pa nyid du bka' stsal gsung*// // 490) ༄// chos rgyal yum sras la sku rten bzhengs rgyur sbyin bdag mdzad zhu'i phrin bskul// bla ma rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po// dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo/ lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten thams cad kyi gtsug gi nor bu rin po che bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rdzu 'phrul dang cho 'phrul sna tshogs ston pas/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che dar zhing rgyas par mdzad cing*/ gzhan mu stegs can log par lta ba la zhugs pa'i rgyal po gdug pa can 'khor dang bcas pa la sogs pa/ thar pa dang mya ngan las 'das pa la 'god par mdzad pa'i bla ma dam pa de'i zhal snga nas/ khyod kyis rje btsun gyi sku gyis shig dang*/ 'gro ba la sangs rgyas 'jig rten du byung ba dang 'dra bar 'gyur bas/ gyis shig pa'i gsung byung ba dang*/ bdag kyang bla ma dam pa'i bka' drin rjes su dran pa'i sgo nas/ rdzas dang yo byad kyi dngos po yod kyang*/ rje btsun gang du bzhugs pa'i gtol med pas/ lag na ci yod kyis bla ma'i thugs kyi dgongs pa bsgrub par 'dod pa dang*/ tshangs pa brgya byin nye dbang bcas// rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras// yul 'khor skyong dang 'phags skyes po// spyan mi bzang dang phyogs skyong dang*// chos skyong srung ma thams cad dang*// lha klu la sogs sde brgyad dang*// chos rgyal rje blon yon bdag dang*// pha ma mkhan po slob dpon dag

/mtha' yas sems can don slad du// bzhengs par 'dod pa'i blo yod kyang*// pre ta pu ri'i grong khyer 'dir// mthun pa'i rkyen dang bral ba la// chos rgyal yum sras dbang 'byor pas// rje btsun spyan ras gzigs dbang gi /sprul par yongs grags bla ma yi// thugs kyi dgongs pa rdzogs mdzad cing*// rten 'di'i yon bdag mdzad par zhu// bdag gis khyed kyi zhabs tog bgyi// thugs dang 'gal bar gyur na yang*// bdag la bka' bkyon mi mdzad cing*// brtse bas nongs pa bzod par mdzod// //

491) ༄// bdag 'dzin gtong ba'i thabs kyi gdams pa dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen por gnang ba// oṃ swasti/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po'i 'bul ba dang zhabs tog thams cad phyag du thon/ thugs la yang shin tu btags/ sku khams kyi ngos de nas nyes pa thams cad kyi rtsa ba bdag 'dzin yin pas/ bdag 'dzin shin tu gtong ba gal che/ de gtong ba'i thabs la/ byang chub sems dang yi dam lha// bla ma dam pa bsgom byas nas// nad dang skyon gyi ngang la bzhag /yengs pa med par gtad la bsgom// dang por zang zing sna tshogs 'byung*// de nas chu la chu bzhag dang*// mar la mar ni bzhag pa ltar// phyag rgya chen po'i ngo bor 'char// skyon dang yon tan rab rdzogs pa// sangs rgyas 'dra ba'i bla ma yis// yang dang yang du bka' bstsal gsung*// nyams su longs dang mngon du 'gyur// rdzogs so// // 492) ༄// don dam gyi sgo nas yan lag bdun pa tshigs su bcad pa// sems nyid ngo bo nyid kyi sku// lhun gyis grub cing 'dus ma byas// smra bsam shes brjod yul las 'das// rje rin po che la phyag 'tshal lo// dngos dang dngos min 'khor 'das kun// sems nyid gcig tu 'dres pa yis// kun tu bzang por gyur ba yi// bla med mchod pas mchod par bgyi// rang gzhan thams cad rdzogs sangs rgyas// sku gsum lhun gyis grub pa la// tha mal lus ngag yid gsum du// 'khrul par gyur pa mthol lo bshags// rang gzhan gdod nas sangs rgyas shing*// bla med dkon mchog gsum po dang*// 'gro ba kun gyi dge ba la// snying nas dga' zhing yi rang ngo*// rgyal sras myur du sangs rgyas shing*// rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob pa rnams// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor gyur nas// 'gro kun byang chub thob mdzad gsol// ston pa thugs rje chen po rnams// mya ngan 'da' bar gang bzhed pa// sngon gyi dam bcas ma bsnyel bar// mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs su gsol// bdag dang 'gro ba ma lus pa// gdod nas yod pa'i dge ba dang*// dus gsum bsags pa'i dge ba 'dis// 'gro kun byang chub mchog thob shog

/rdo rje 'chang chen dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi sku// dbyer med byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin 'gyur ba med// mgon po gdod nas byang chub mchog tu sangs rgyas pa'i// bkra shis des kyang skye dgu rnams la bkra shis shog/ // 493) ༄// bla ma'i dgongs pa rdzogs byed bdag nyid rtag tu g.yog por shog ces pa// sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku// rdo rje 'chang gi ngo bo nyid// dkon mchog gsum gyi 'byung gnas mchog /dus gsum bdag nyid rin po che// dpal ldan phag mo gru pa yi// sku gsung thugs nyid mi zad cing*// lhun grub rgyun chad mi mnga' ba'i// ji srid 'khor ba ma stong tshe// 'gro ba smin par mdzad pa yi// sku gsung thugs kyi dgongs pa rnams// rdzogs par byed pa'i g.yog por shog /rtag tu mi mnyes med pa dang*// rtag tu mnyes pa nyid du shog /rab 'byams 'jig rten khams rnams su// rje btsun dus gsum sangs rgyas rnams// gang dang gang du 'byung ba yi// dang po lhums su 'jug pa dang*// bltams shing rol rtsed mdzad pa dang*// btsun mo'i 'khor du zhugs pa dang*// rab tu byung dang dka' thub mdzad// byang chub snying por gshegs nas kyang*// bdud kyi sde rnams 'joms pa dang*// byang chub mchog tu sangs rgyas shing*// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang*// thugs kyi dgongs pa rdzogs nas kyang*// bud shing zad pa'i me bzhin du// skyes chen mya ngan 'das la sogs// dus dang rnam pa thams cad du// dpal ldan phag mo gru pa dang*// skad cig tsam yang mi 'bral zhing*// sku gsung thugs kyi dgongs pa mchog /ma lus mtha' dag rdzogs byed pa'i// bdag nyid rtag tu g.yog por shog /ston pa mya ngan 'das nas kyang*// 'jig rten mgon po'i sku gdung la// rin chen rnam pa sna tshogs las// legs par bsgrubs shing yid song ba// lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyi// tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa'i mchod rten gyis// 'jig rten gang ba byed par shog

/ston pa bdag nyid chen po'i bka'// lha dang gnod sbyin mi rnams dang*// rab 'byams 'jig rten khams rnams su// 'thor bar gyur pa bsdus nas kyang*// dbang gi rgyal po rin chen gyi// glegs bam yid du 'ong ba la// de bas lhag pa'i rin po ches// bkur stis brgyan cing legs bris nas// ston pa bdag nyid chen po'i bkas// 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor thams cad du// legs par gsungs pa ston par shog /gang gis chos de thos pa dang*// bdag ni mthong dang dran pas kyang*// thams cad bde zhing skyid pa dang*// sdug bsngal kun dang bral ba dang*// byang chub dam pa thob pa yis// 'jig rten mgon po rin chen gyi// bstan pa dar zhing rgyas par shog/ // 494) ༄// 'khor 'das kun gyi srog snying byang chub sems kyi gser 'gyur rtsi// na mo ratna gu ru/ sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku// rdo rje 'chang gi ngo bo nyid// dkon mchog gsum gyi rtsa ba ste// rin po che la phyag 'tshal lo// 'dzam gling nor gyis khengs gyur kyang*// bu med kyi a pha rabs chad yin// pha kun mkhyen ye shes spyan gyis gzigs// khams gsum sems can grangs mang yang*// bu med kyi rgyal po rabs chad yin// pha mkhyen pa can gyis bka' mi bkyon// brgyud pa 'dzin pa'i bu med na// bskyangs pa don med skyon mthong bas// mtho dman gya tshom tshig smras pas// de yi thugs dgongs rdzogs par mthong*// mgon po 'jam dbyangs lta bur bsam// rje byin gyis rlobs dang rin po che// lhag bsam g.yo dang bral ba 'di// kun mkhyen mgon pos mi gzigs med// skyon dag yon tan rdzogs mdzad gsol// rje skyon dag yon tan rdzogs mdzad gsol// rje btsun dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs// sngon gyi dam bcas ma bsnyel bar// bdag cag sgrub pa byed pa rnams// byin gyis brlab cing bskyab tu gsol// rje byin gyis brlab cing bskyab tu gsol// rje byin gyis brlab cing bskyab tu gsol//

༈ //gang phyir rdo rje 'dzin pa yis// dngos grub slob dpon rjes 'brangs gsungs// ku re kyal ka'i ched du yang*// sgo gsum gyi khyad gsod ma spangs na// nyams skyon med gsum po skye bar dka'// nyams skyon med gsum dang rtogs pa dag /tha dad med cing bye brag spangs// bcom ldan gsungs pa 'di re mad// sa 'di bar mthongs ma phye ba// kye ma deng sang kha rje che// kye kye kye ma e ma 'o// gser 'gyur rtsi yi rnam pa mchog lta bu// mi gtsang lus 'di bsgyur nas rgyal ba'i sku// rin chen rin thang med par bsgyur bas na// byang chub sems zhes bya ba legs brtan bzung*// gnyen gcig mkhan pos gsungs pa 'di re mad// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro gnod sbyin dang*// srin po mi bzad gdug pa can// 'khor 'das kun gyi srog snying rnams// byang chub sems kyi gser 'gyur rtsis// bde chen phan chad rgyal ba'i skur// g.yo sgyu med par ma bsgyur na// gsang sngags gang yin gang la bshad// gang gis gsang sngags ci bsgrubs pas// 'dre phung ba bzhin phung bar 'gyur// gsang sngags yon tan 'byung 'dod na// kun mkhyen mgon po'i zhal snga nas// yon tan gyi rgya mtsho zhig bskyed bzhed na// rmi lam sgyu ma lta bu yi// tshogs rgyun chad med par gsog na yin// gtor mas bar chad sel ba yang*// bsod nams tshogs kyi mthu yin gsungs// gsang sngags grub thag nye ba yang*// tshogs gsog mkhas pa'i rten 'brel yin// de ste a 'od khu mtshan la// 'di dang 'dir yang de dag gi /gnyer ka med kyis bzhes pa gsol// yang na mthun 'jug ngo srung mdzod// 'di phyi gnyis kar mi phung re// chang gis bzi ba'i gnyid lam na// ri bo pang gis thebs thebs 'dra// shes pa 'khrul ba'i gang zag gis// rang gis rang nyid chen por mthong*// rang spyod ma shes gti mug can// phung zhes grags pa 'di re bden// 'jig rten mgon po rin po che// slob dpon rgyal po bzhugs pa'i gnas// nub phyogs u rgyan gnas mchog na// pho skyes thams cad dpa' bo la// mo skyes rang bzhin rnal 'byor ma// gnyis med sbyor ba a la la// phag mo gru yi nags tshal yin// a ho rnal 'byor dgyes par mdzod//

// 495) ༄// byed pa thams cad kun rdzob la byed med mya ngan 'da' ba zhes pa'i gdams pa// dpal phag mo gru pa'i zhabs la 'dud// dpa' bo rdo rje dril bu pas// dam chos rtsa ba byang sems kyis// 'khor 'das gnyis kyi srog bcud pas// rgyal po'i gyod las thar pa yin// dpal ldan nā ro paṇa chen gyis// zhing rnam par dag pa'i bla ma la// tshe 'dir sangs rgyas 'dod pa'i blos// lus srog phul bas 'bras bu smin// rnal 'byor dbang phyug bhu su ku// yid la mi byed phyag rgya che// rnam par mi rtog don nyid la// rgyun chad med pa'i sbyor bas grub// slob dpon na ga bho de ni// gnod sbyin pho mo'i gtam rnams kyis// 'khor la bar chad sna tshogs gtong*// dngos grub bar chad rang dbang che// rje btsun padma snying rje che// gdug pa rnams dang snang srid kun// byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor gyis// bde ba chen por bsgyur bar mdzad// ārya na gardzu na ni// lnga yi bdag nyid ming bcu po// rnam rtog 'khor ba sgrub byed rlung*// 'od gsal dbyings su gsod par mdzad// u rgyan rgyal po 'gro ba'i mgon// dug gsum 'khor ba'i bag chags rnams// bde chen lhan cig skyes par sbyor// 'khor dang bcas pa mkha' spyod khrid// slob dpon chen po lū hi pa// sa steng stan dang nam mkha'i gos// nyi zla sgron me lag ngar sngas// nya rgyu gsol bas don chen grub// 'jig rten ngam gyur padma yis// rang gi nyams su myong ba yis// snang srid thams cad he ru kaḥ /gcig tu byas pas bdud rnams btul// rnal 'byor dbang phyug birwa pa// phyi nang gsang ba'i rten 'brel gyis// 'khor 'das snang srid ma lus kun// bsgyur zhing byin gyis brlabs par mdzad// rje dpal ldan bla ma rin chen ni// dus gsum rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas pas// sems gnyis 'dres pa'i sbyor ba yis// 'gro rnams byang chub mchog la 'god// ngas ni thams cad sems su go

/byed pa thams cad kun rdzob la// byed med rtogs na mya ngan 'das// gnyis su med pas rdzogs sangs rgyas// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad ni// tshogs gnyis 'gro ba'i don du spyad// rang gzhan gnyis su med pa'i phyir// sku gsum lhun gyis grub par nges// rang la snying brtse yod gyur na// lhag pa'i bsam pa g.yo med pas// gong ma rnams kyi rjes 'brangs na// myur du 'bras bu 'byung nas mchi// mi dge rgyu las byung ba yi// nyes tshogs phung po thams cad la// de nyid skye ba med shes na// phra ba'i bag chags zad byas nas// mgon po rin chen zla ba ltar// rnam par dag pa sangs kyang rgya// de nyid stong par ma shes nas// dge sbyong byas pa'i 'bras bu yis// nor bu snying po dri med ltar// rgyal bas rjes su 'dzin par 'gyur// rgyal bas skye rga na 'chi gzigs// birwa padma badzra sogs// gtam rgyud ring po mang du gsungs// cis kyang 'chi bar nges pa dang*// shi nas 'khor ba ngan song gi /mi zad sdug bsngal dran pa rnams// blo bder sdod pa ga la srid// brtul zhugs bsgrub par bya ba'i phyir// rang la skyes pa'i nyams rtogs rnams// nyams dga' dben pa'i sa phyogs su// bsgrub cing grub pa thob pa bya// mgon po bla mas de skad gsungs// mi bzad gdug pa'i lha 'dre yang*// rang gi sems las gzhan pa med// rang sems thul ba'i rnal 'byor pa// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun dang*// rang gzhan ma lus snang srid kun// chos sku yin par thugs su chud// nyams su longs dang rnal 'byor pa// nyon mongs rtog pa'i nyes tshogs kun// de nyid chos skur shes gyur na// phra ba'i bag chags 'dag pa yin// de yi gnyen por dam pa'i chos// dpag med bsam yas byas na yang*// 'di nyid rtog pa'i rgyur 'gyur gyi// 'bras bu thob par shin tu dka'// 'khor ba'i 'jigs pas nyen pa dang*// ngan song sdug bsngal bzod dka' ba// rdzun med 'chi ba byung ba'i tshe// skyabs 'gran zla med par 'pho ba la// skyabs su mi 'gro ga la srid// 'pho ba byas pa'i rnal 'byor la// bar do'i snang ba mi 'byung zhes// 'jig rten mgon po rin chen gsung*// 'pho bas mtshams sbyor ma byas na// bar do'i gdams ngag shin tu gces//

// 496) ༄// lus sems kyi rten 'brel sgrigs stangs 'bu yang shes rab bu la gnang ba// oṃ swasti/ byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin sku// snang srid byin gyis rlob mdzad pa// bde ba chen por bsgyur mdzad pa// bla ma rdo rje 'chang la 'dud// mtho dman bzang ngan gang yang rung*// dang po skyes pa'i bsam pa yis// lus 'di byin gyis rlob pa yin// lus kyis snang ba byin gyis rlob// mkhas pa bdag nyid chen po rnams// 'di yi rten 'brel sgrig pa yin// snang srid dbang du bsgyur ba yin// khyed kyis gsungs pa'i bka' bstsal de// nyams su len par bzhed lags na// dkon mchog gsum dang byang chub sems// yi dam
