lha dang bla ma dang*// chos nyid rang bzhin rnam dag pas// dang por rang sems byin gyis rlabs// sems dang dbyer med gcig gyur cing*// nges pa'i shes pa skyes pa dang*// shes pa'i ngar dang dpa' skyes pas// thogs pa med pa'i brtul zhugs kyis// phrin las brtsam par bya ba yin// de yi bya lugs 'di ltar yin// de na gnas pa'i mi rnams dang*// ji srid mi ma yin rnams dang*// khyad par gdug pa can rnams la// tshad med thugs rje chen po bskyed// rang bas gzhan gces skyes tsam na// de dag ma lus thams cad la// gtor ma bkur stis brgyan par bya// byang chub sems kyi gdung shugs kyis// bdag cag 'gro la phan don du// sa phyogs 'di dang 'di dag tu// bya ba 'di dang 'di byed pa'i// phrin las sdong grogs gyis shig ces// gsol ba gdab cing bden pa bdar// de ltar yang yang byas pa yis// 'dod pa'i rtags dang mtshan ma ni// bzang po byung na sbyor ba brtsam// gal te mi 'dod rtags byung na// nyes pa mang po 'byung ba'i phyir// sbyor ba mi brtsam bzhag par bya// gal te mi bya thabs med na// rang nyid sku mtshams dam par gcad// rang gi dge sbyor drug 'gyur bya// lus dang sems dang snang ba gsum// gcig tu 'dres pa man ngag yin// yon bdag nye 'brel thams cad la// tshogs gsog dge sbyor mang du bcol// de ltar byas pa'i dus gcig na// gtor ma gtong ba la sogs pa'i// gong gi sbyor ba byas pa yis// rtags dang mtshan ma 'gyur nas mchi// dang po'i dus kyi sbyor ba 'o// dngos gzhi bya ba'i rim pa ni// tshul khrims ldan pa'i dge slong bzhi// yang na de bas mang yang legs// gso sbyong bshags bsdom byas pa rnams// rang dang lhan cig der phyin nas// dkon mchog mchod pa chen po bsham// byin rlabs can gyi rten rnams dkram// bla ma yi dam chos skyong dang*// de na gnas pa'i gzhi bdag la// gtor ma rgya chen byin nas ni// gsol ba gdab cing bden pa bdar// de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstod pa dang*// rgyun chags gsum dang bkra shis rnams// byas pas bkra shis dpag med 'byung*// de na gnas pa'i dge 'dun la// chos ston yon dang bcas pa dbul// de na tshogs pa thams cad kyang*// zhim dgu mngar bcu'i kha zas kyis// thams cad ngoms shing tshim par bya// de nas sngar bzhin dge sbyor bya// de yang chos rje 'gro ba'i mgon// mnyam med bla ma rin chen ni// sa phyogs de dang snang srid kun// rje btsun 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs// gang yang rung ba bsgom pa la// nan tan chen po mdzad pas na// nged kyang de ltar bsgom par bya// 'di la nan tan bka' bstsal gsung*// de nas mkhar lan bya byed rnams// ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin du bsgrub// ji ltar 'dod pa grub gyur na// rtag tu phan bde 'byung ba dang*// brtan zhing yun ring gnas bya'i phyir// rjes kyi cho ga bstan pa ni// tshul bzhin rab tu gnas par bya// ston pa byang chub chen po dang*// shes rab pha rol phyin la sogs// 'di ltar sku gsung thugs kyi rten// byin rlabs can rnams bzhugs par bya// mchod pa chen po rgyun tu bya// 'di ltar rje btsun gsang ba'i bdag

/phyag na rdo rje dbang bskur ba'i// rgyud du ston pa bcom ldan gyis// shar du shes rab pha rol phyin// lhor ni sdong po brgyan pa bklag /nub du gsang ba bsam mi khyab// byang du gser 'od dam pa rnams// rgyun chad med par klog pa la// sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang*// tshangs pa brgya byin rgyal chen dang*// lha klu gnod sbyin mthu bo che// gzi brjid can rnams 'du bar 'gyur// de rnams 'dus par gyur ba las// 'byung po gnod sbyin byer med 'gyur// bkra shis bde dga' 'byung ba rnams// ston pa thugs rje can gyis gsungs// sangs rgyas rnams dang dam pa'i chos// byin gyis rlabs pa'i thabs bstan nas// bla med ston pa'i nyan thos tshogs// dbus gtsang rig pa'i 'byung gnas su// thos bsam sgom pas rgyud sbyangs shing*// lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyi// skyabs mgon re gnas byang chub sems// smin grol gnyis kyis rgyud sbyangs pa'i// rnal 'byor dbang phyug ri khrod pa// khyed la gdams ngag bstan pa ni// nyon mongs dug gi stobs 'phel na// tshe 'di log pa'i blo gros kyis// phyin ci log gis spang gyur pa'i// 'jig rten chos brgyad bsgrub pa yi// mi chos gshin rje 'dra rnams kyi// log rtog dbang du song gyur nas// spyang khu ltogs pa 'dra ba yi// ye rngam chen po'i bsam pa yis// phyogs dang ris su chad gyur na// phung 'dre chen por 'gyur bas na// skyes bu dam pa khyed cag gis// byams dang snying rje byang sems kyis// dgra zun thams cad mnyam par gyis// snang srid thams cad yi dam lha// thams cad kun la bsgrub par bya// thams cad sems nyid phyag rgya che// rang gzhan gcig tu shes pa yis// chags sdang mtha' dag bral bar bya// de ltar mdzad na skyes chen khyed// phyogs ris gnyen 'brel a cang ste// lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyi// gtsug gi nor bu chen por 'gyur// bstan pa'i mnga' bdag dge 'dun gyis// byin gyis rlob lugs bstan pa 'o// de ltar bla ma dkon mchog gsum// skyabs dang byin rlabs chen po yis// byin gyis brlab par gyur pa yis// yon tan dpag tu med pa 'byung*// rjes kyi cho ga bstan pa ri khrod pa'i gdams pa 'bu yang shes rab dpal gdams pa'o//

497) ༄// kun rdzob don dam byang chub kyi sems ji ltar nyams su blang tshul bstan pa// oṃ swasti/ rje rin po che'i thugs kyi dgongs pa/ byang chub kyi sems rin po che rnam gnyis yin te/ de yang kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bde ba dang ldan/ sdug bsngal dang bral/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub rin po che thob par bya/ de'i ched du bdag gis spyir sangs ma rgyas kyi bar du lus ngag yid gsum dge ba la bkol/ ma shi'i bar du lus ngag yid gsum dge ba la bkol/ dus de ring nas bzung nas nyi ma sang da tsam gyi bar du lus ngag yid gsum dge ba la bkol snyam du zhe thag pa nas snying khong rus pa'i gting nas dam bca'/ khas blangs/ mna' bor bas/ rang nyid dang 'khor 'das thams cad kyis dus gsum du byas shing bsags pa dang*/ yod pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad blos gcig tu bsdus nas rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bsngo ba ni/ bdag dang 'khor 'das thams cad kyis dus gsum du bsags pa dang*/ yod pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis/ bdag dang sems can thams cad myur du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub rin po che thob par gyur cig ces dge ba'i rtsa ba bsngo bar bya zhing*/ dus rnam pa gsum po der dge ba 'ba' zhig ma gtogs par/ mi dge ba skad cig kyang mi bya ba ni kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems yin la/ don dam pa byang chub kyi sems ni/ de ltar 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pas bsdus pa'i chos thams cad/ rang la yod bzhin pa'i rig pa 'di gcig pu yin la/ rig pa de smra bsam brjod med kyi ngo bo/ yod pa dang med pa'am stong dang mi stong pa thams cad dang bral ba de nyid phyag rgya chen po yin te/ kun rdzob dang don dam pa gnyis med par/ bcom ldan 'das kyis/ 'khor ba dang ni mya ngan 'das// gnyis su yod pa ma yin te// 'khor ba'i rang bzhin shes pa la// mya ngan 'das zhes brjod pa yin// zhes pa dang*/

'gro ba'i mgon po rin po che'i zhal snga nas kyang*/ rtogs ma rtogs gnyis las ma rtogs pa// 'bras bu thob dang ma thob med// ces gsungs pas/ dus gsum sangs rgyas ngo bo nyid// de yi rang bzhin rang gi sems// rtogs par 'dod na ji bzhin zhog /goms par byas na mngon du 'gyur// zhes pas/ rgyun chad med pa'i sems nyid lhun gyis grub par nyams su blang bar bya'o// rdzogs so// // 498) ༄// chos gos ngur smrig gi kha sgyur 'di byang chub sems pa'i rgyal mtshan yin pa// dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi 'phags pa rnams kyi rgyal mtshan chos gos ngur smrig 'di ni/ gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi skyon dag pa dang*/ yon tan rdzogs par byed pa yin te/ de ltar yang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa dpal gyi dam tshig gi mdo las/ chos gos ngur smrig kha sgyur ba 'di ni/ sngon gyi sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thams cad kyis byin gyis brlabs pa lags so// byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi rgyal mtshan lags so// mya ngan las 'das par mchis pa rnams kyi lam lags so// nyon mongs pa rnams kyi ral gri lags so// mya ngan las 'das pa'i sa bon lags so// lam las rab tu nyams pa rnams kyi sgron ma lags so// phung po rnams kyi sman lags so// ma rig pa'i mun pa'i rlung lags so// ngan 'gro rnams kyi srog shing lags so// nyon mongs pa'i skyon gyis nyams par gyur pa rnams kyi skyug sman lags so// dgra rnams kyi rje lags so// dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad kyi gter lags so// sdig pas gos pa rnams kyi chab lags so// nongs par bgyis pa rnams kyi me long lags so// sems g.yengs pa rnams kyi ting nge 'dzin lags so// ting nge 'dzin rnams kyi za ma tog lags so// pha rol tu phyin pa rnams kyi sa gzhi lags so// gzungs rnams kyi nor bu lags so// bzod pa rnams kyi khyim lags so// sa rnams kyi snod lags so// phas kyi rgol ba rnams kyi mkhar lags so// nad pa rnams kyi sman pa lags so// bslab pa rnams kyi ri lags so// nyon mongs pas kun nas gdungs pa rnams kyi zla ba lags so// lta ba ngan par lhung ba rnams kyi nyi ma lags so// ye shes kyi rgya mtsho lags so// byang chub kyi phyogs pa rnams kyi phreng bar gyur pa lags so// thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi bum pa bzang po lags so// chos gos ngur smrig 'di ni yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che dang 'dra ba lags so// chos gos ngur smrig 'di ni sems can rnams la chos kyi char dbab pa'i don slad du sangs rgyas thams cad kyis byin gyis brlabs pa lags so// zhes gsungs la/

de'i rgyu mtshan yang*/ bstan pa'i bdag po 'di nyid la mtshon na/ dang po bcom ldan 'das rin chen snying po'i spyan sngar byang chub mchog tu thugs 'di ltar bskyed de/ de yang snying rje padma dkar po las/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das bdag byang chub thob pa'i chos gos ngur smrig dmar po lha dang mi rnams kyis gus par bgyis pa dang*/ ri mor bgyis pa dang*/ mchod par bgyis par 'gyur bar mthong ma thag tu/ ngur smrig mgul na thogs par 'gyur ba'i sems can rnams kyang*/ theg pa gsum po dag gis phyir mi ldog par gyur cig sems can gang dag bza' ba dang btung ba dang bral zhing*/ bkres pa dang*/ skom pa dang gnod par gyur pa rnams dang*/ tha na gnod sbyin dbul po rnams sam/ gshin rje'i 'jig rten pa'i sems can gang dag tha na chos gos ngur smrig sor bzhi tsam 'tshal bar 'gyur ba de dag thams cad kyang*/ bza' ba dang btung ba phun sum tshogs par 'gyur zhing*/ bsam pa yongs su rdzogs par gyur cig lha'am/ gnod sbyin nam/ srin po'am/ klu'am/ lha ma yin nam/ nam mkha' lding ngam/ mi'am ci'am/ lto 'phye chen po'am/ grul bum mam/ sha za'am/ mi'am/ sems can gang dag phan tshun zhe 'gras shing 'khon bcug pa mang por gyur pa rnams dang*/ phan tshun 'gyed cing g.yul ngor zhugs te/ g.yul sprod par byed pa rnams kyis kyang*/ bdag gi chos gos ngur smrig rjes su dran par gyur na/ sems can de dag snying rje'i sems dang*/ 'jam pa'i sems dang*/ mkhon med pa'i sems dang*/ las su rung ba'i sems su gyur cig sems can gang dag g.yul ngo'am/ 'gyed pa'am/ 'thab pa'am/ rtsod pa'i nang du srung ba dang*/ mchod par bgyi ba dang*/ gus pa bgyi ba'i slad du/ ngur smrig gi dum bu 'chang bar 'gyur ba'i sems can de dag kyang rtag tu rgyal bar 'gyur ba dang*/ 'khrul pa ma mchis pa dang*/ rnam par 'tshe ba ma mchis par gyur cig g.yul ngo dang*/ 'gyed pa dang*/

'thab mo dang*/ rtsod pa de dag las kyang legs par yongs su thar bar gyur cig btsun pa bcom ldan 'das gal te bdag gi chos gos ngur smrig dmar po 'phags pa'i yon tan lnga po de dag dang ldan par ma gyur na/ bdag gis phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams bslus par 'gyur pa nas/ bdag gis sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa mtha' dag yongs su rdzogs par bgyid par rngo mi thogs pa dang*/ bdag gis chos rnams bskyung par 'gyur ba dang*/ bdag gis gzhan mu stegs can rnams tshar gcod par rngo mi thogs par gyur cig ces gsungs so/ gsung 'dis mtshon cing 'di ltar gyur na ni/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyang dang por byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa yin la/ sems bskyed pa de'i gzhi rten yang skyabs su song ba 'ba' zhig ste/ skyabs su 'gro ba'i yul ni nyon mongs pa rnam pa gsum skyes pa de'i rjes su 'brangs pa'i las/ las de'i 'bras bu rnam par smin pa ngan song gsum dang khams gsum gyi 'khor ba ni yin nges/ rgyu 'bras de ma bkag par ngan song gsum du mi 'gro ba dang*/ 'khor ba las nges par thar pa ni khams gsum gyi sems can spyi dang ston pa 'di'i zhing mi mjed pa dang*/ bye brag tu nged 'dzam bu gling pa la mi srid par bka' dang bstan chos thams cad du nges shing*/ gzhan du 'gyur mi srid pas na/ 'dir bkag pa ye bkag pa yin no// de la gnang zhing bsgrub pa zhes bya ba ni/ nyon mongs pa spangs pa'i dge ba ma chags pa dang*/ zhe sdang med pa dang*/ gti mug med pa las byung ba rnam gsum gyis gnas skabs su mtho ris dang thar pa rnam pa gnyis thob la/ 'bras bu rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sangs rgyas pa ni/ rgyu lam gyi bden pa las mthar thug sku gsum thob pa 'di la ni dge ba gshis kyi dge ba zhes bya ba ming 'dogs pa yin/ de ltar ma yin par ni bstan pa'i sgor zhugs pa sus brtsad du yod de/

rtsod pa dang bral ba kho na'o// skyabs gnas de la skyabs su song ba gzhir gyur pas/ byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed de/ byang chub ni nyon mongs pa rgyu 'bras byang zhing nyon mongs pa med par chub pa la byang chub ces ming du 'dogs pa ma lags sam/ de ltar du gyur na/ dge ba dang mi dge ba gshis yin pa thams cad mkhyen pas mkhyen cing mi bya bar bcas pa dang*/ dge ba gnang zhing bsgrub bya bcas pas/ gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi yon tan mtha' dag thob pa gshis yin pa la/ mtho ba dang dma' ba'i lo rgyus 'di ji ltar du gyur pa yin ang snyam pa'i bsam pa mang po skye bar byung ste/ mdor bsdus na gnas skabs dang mthar thug thams cad kyi skyon dag cing*/ yon tan mtha' dag rdzogs pa ni tshul khrims rin po che 'ba' zhig yin pas/ dus de ring nas bzung nas rdzogs pa'i byang chub ma thob kyi bar du tshul khrims rin po che dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig tshul khrims rin po che'i rang bzhin skyabs bla na med pa'i dkon mchog rin po che gsum dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig skyabs bla na med pa des ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can ji snyed cig yod pa ma lus shing*/ lus pa med par thams cad skyabs bla na med pa'i dkon mchog rin po che gsum dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig /'das dang ma byon da ltar dang*// phyogs bcu dus gsum bzhugs pa yi// rgyal ba ma lus thams cad kyi// ston pa chos dang 'khor dang yang*// zhing dang bstan pa'i 'phel 'grib dus// nyon mongs nyes tshogs spangs pa dang*// tshul khrims ting 'dzin shes rab kyi// yon tan rdzogs par gyur pa la// 'bras bu dkon mchog 'khor lo zhes// rgyal ba rnams dang de sras gsungs// des na bla med tshul khrims kyi// rang bzhin nyid du dag gyur cig/ // 499) ༄// go cha chen po bdud kyi sgyu 'dul zhes sher 'byung la gdams pa'i skor// na mo ratna gu ru dharmā kā ya/

go cha chen po bgos shing bdud kyi sgyu 'dul zhes// thub mgon shākya'i rgyal pos bsdud par gsungs 'di dag /stong phrag brgya par sum cu rtsa drug dag tu gsungs// bskal pa bzang por de nyid rab tu phye// sdong po brgyan par rnam thar de dag re re yang*// kun tu bzang por ston pas rgya cher gsungs pa ste// kun tu bzang po'i lus ni nam mkha'i rang bzhin te// thams cad zhing la mi gnas de bzhin nyid la gnas// rim pas rtsa bshad rnam par phye bar bstan pa dag /bdag gi bu la nan tan chen por gdams pa ni// 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po bla ma'i byang chub sems// dbyer med gcig tu gyur pa 'di ni ston pa'i gsung*// bu shes rab 'byung gnas la gdams pa'o// // 500) ༄// bstan bcos gnyis med a ba dhu tī zhes sgom pa dar gzhon gyi zhu chos// oṃ swasti/ skyes chen gang zhig tshogs gnyis rab rdzogs pas// rang gzhan don grub chos rgyal rdo rje 'dzin// rgyal ba kun gyi skur gyur dkon mchog gsum// dbyer med bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la 'dud// bdag gi slob ma dam pa mos gus can// mnyes pa gsum gyis rtag tu mnyes byed cing*// tshogs gnyis rdzogs par 'dod pa'i blo can gyis// yang yang zhu ba zhus pas snying gtam bri/ spyir 'khor ba dang mya ngan 'das pa rang gzhan thams cad kyi bde ba dang skyid pa sgrub par byed pa'i thabs/ bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs rnam pa gnyis gsog pa ma gtogs pa'i gzhan mi srid par/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsung rab thams cad du gsungs shing*/ skyes bu dam pa thams cad kyis thugs nges pa yin pas/ tshogs gnyis gsog pa la 'bad par bya'o// de ji ltar bya zhe na/ zhing dang*/ bsam pa dang*/ dngos po rnam pa gsum gyi rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba/ lugs dang mthun pa thabs su gyur pa/ bsod nams kyi tshogs dang*/ 'khor gsum yongs su dag pa rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba/

lugs las ldog pa sems nyid gdod nas ma skyes pa/ mngon par rtogs pa'i shes rab yin pas de nyams su blang bar bya ba'i rim pa dang*/ de gnyis dbyer med par rtogs pa zung du 'jug pa'i rnal 'byor pas thabs zab mo phyin ci ma log pa tshogs bsag pa nyams su blangs pas/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sangs rgyas par bzhed de/ de yang spyir rgyal ba'i gsung rab thams cad du/ jo bo dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum zhing shin tu rnam par dag pa dang*/ 'phags pa dang sems can gyi zhing shin tu rnam par dag pa la/ tshogs gsog pa'i tshul dpag tu med pa gsungs kyang*/ theg pa chen po gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i lugs kyi zhing dag pa thams cad bla ma gcig pur tshang bar gsungs te/ de ltar yang*/ sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku// rdo rje 'chang gi ngo bo nyid// dkon mchog gsum gyi rtsa ba ste// bla ma la ni skyabs su mchi// zhes gsungs pa dang*/ mchod pa thams cad yongs spangs te// bla ma mchod pa brtsam par bya// de mnyes pa las dngos grub ni// kun mkhyen nyid kyang thob par 'gyur// zhes gsungs pa dang*/ bla ma rin po che'i zhal snga nas kyang*/ lam nyams su len pa rnams kyi zhing dag pa ni bla ma dam pa yin gsungs pas/ mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i bla ma dam pa la bsten par bya'o// de yang mtshan nyid dang ldan pa de ni bla ma gong ma ste/ gong ma ni mtshan nyid dang ldan pa la mtshan nyid dang ldan pa zhes bya ste/ sems can nga dang bdag tu 'khor ba rnams kyi bla ma rnams ni/ bdag med par rtogs pa nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas yin la/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi bla ma ni byang chub kyi sems gnyis dang ldan pa'i byang chub sems dpa' yin zhing*/ de dag thams cad kyi bla ma ni sems gnyis dbyer med par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sangs rgyas pa'i sangs rgyas yin la/ bdag cag snyigs ma'i dus su byung bsam pa gcig gi steng du nyon mongs pa gsum dus gcig tu skye ba/

de nyid skye ba dang*/ 'gag pa dang gnas pa med par rtogs pa'i ye shes kyis rdo rje spang bya dang*/ gnyen po rang dang gzhan/ 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa gnyis su 'dzin pa'i ri bo thams cad 'joms par byed pa ni/ bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po ste/ mtshan nyid ni de 'dra ba'i mtshan nyid 'dzin pa'i phyir na/ mtshan nyid dang ldan pa zhes bya'o// de lta bu'i bla ma dam pa de yang shin tu rnyed par dka' ste/ de'i rgyu mtshan yang*/ sngon bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs bsags pas/ tshogs ji ltar du bsags pa'i bla ma dam pa de dang*/ rang nyid gnas dus kyis ma bskal bar phrad pa la dam tshig dang ldan pa'i slob ma zhes kyang zer/ las dang skal ba dang ldan pa zhes kyang zer/ tshogs bsags pa'i rten gyi gang zag ces kyang zer bas/ de 'dra ba'i bla ma zhig rnyed na nor bu rin po che dbang gi rgyal po rnyed pa bas kyang shin tu lhag ste/ lhag pa'i rgyal mtshan yang nor bu rin po ches dgos 'dod kyi re ba thams cad 'byung yang mthar thug rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'byung bar shin tu dka' bas/ dkon mchog gsum gyi dpe rin po che nyid la byas shing de gsum dbyer med pa ni bla ma 'ba' zhig yin pas/ de yang rang gi srog la bab kyang srog ni gtang gi bla ma dam pa gtang bar mi bya ste/ de ltar yang*/ rin po che'i zhal snga nas/ de 'dra'i bla ma srog gis gzung bar bya// zhes pas so// de yang 'di'i 'brel pa ni/ rang nyid 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen po gting mtha' med par ni lhung*/ nyon mongs pa 'dod chags dang zhe sdang dang gti mug rnam pa gsum gyi rang bzhin du ni song*/ bdud dang log 'dren/ las ngan pa las skyes pa nyon mongs pa rnam pa gsum gyi rang bzhin du gyur pa rnams dang*/ rang nyid dbyer med par gnas pa las gong du smos pa'i bla ma dam pa de'i thugs rje'i 'od zer nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor nam mkha' la shar ba lta bus/

rang nyid kyi nyon mongs pa mi shes pa'i mun pa cung zad bsal nas/ yang dag pa'i shes rab rnam pa gsum rgyud la skyes pa de'i bsam pa de'i rang gzugs kyis mi'i lus thob cing*/ bla ma dam pa mthong ba'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur pas/ ji tsam du bla ma dam pa de la nye ba dang bsnyen pa dang*/ btud pa dang*/ mchod cing bsnyen bkur bas/ de dang je nyer gyur pas sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad myur du 'dag pa dang*/ yon tan gyi tshogs gong nas gong du khyad par du 'phags par gyur pa sa nas sar 'phar ba dang*/ bral ba dang rnam par smin pa'i yon tan/ nyes tshogs thams cad dang ji tsam du bral ba de tsam du bla ma dam pa la phyag gcig pu 'tshal ba yang*/ zhing bla ma dam pa de dang rang gi sems dbye ba med par gyur pas/ 'das ma byon da ltar phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la phyag 'tshal bar gyur pa/ byang chub sems dpa' nor bzang gis/ bcom ldan 'das rje btsun la btud pa lta bu dang*/ shin tu phra ba'i dngos po chab tsha sun gcig gam/ bshos rdog ma gcig phul yang dus gsum gyi dkon mchog thams cad la de dang 'dra ba'i mchod pa dpag tu med pas mchod pa rgyal ba'i yum du gsungs pa lta bu dang*/ tshul de dang 'dra bar tshul khrims rnam par dag pas dus gsum gyi rgyal ba'i 'khor shin tu rnam par dag cing*/ rnyog pa'i dri ma thams cad dang bral bar gyur nas/ rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor thams cad du mchod pa'i sprin phung kun tu bzang po'i rnam 'phrul ltar 'byung zhing*/ gtan gyi skyes bu dam par gyur nas/ rgyal ba thams cad kyi thugs kyi dgongs pa rdzogs par byed pa dang*/ yang dka' ba'i las phran tshegs nyes pa dang sdug bsngal dang bka' bkyon pa'i gsung bzod pas/ rgyal ba'i zhing khams thams cad du lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten thams cad kyis blta bas ngoms pa med par lham me lhan ne lhang nger gyur nas/

mthong ba dang*/ thos pa dang reg pa thams cad smin pa dang grol bar byed pa/ 'phags pa 'od zer bkye ba las gsungs pa lta bu dang*/ tshul de dang 'dra bar brtson 'grus dang*/ bsam gtan dang*/ shes rab dang rnam pa drug po re re la yang bcom ldan 'das rje btsun gyis go cha sum cu so drug tu gsungs pa dang*/ bskal pa bzang po brgyad khri bzhi stong du gsungs pa dang*/ de nyid sa bcu la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpas rtogs shing khong du chud pas/ chos kyi sprin sna tshogs su 'gyur bar khong du chud par bya ba ni zhing rnam par dag pa la tshogs bsags pa'i 'thad pa cung zad cig bris pa yin te/ mdor bsdus na mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i bla ma dam pa gcig dang phrad na rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sangs rgyas pa la tshegs med/ tshe thog ma med pa nas 'khor ba khrag gi rgya mtsho chen por 'khyams pa'i rgyu bla ma dam pa dang ma phrad pa'i nyes pa 'ba' zhig yin zhes yang dang yang du bka' bstsal cing*/ gser 'gyur gyi rtsi dang*/ ri rab gser gyi ngos la bya gnas pa dang*/ ri rab kyi rtse nas lhung ba'i mi dang*/ gzhan yang dpe dpag tu med pas bla ma dam pa la bsten par gsungs so// zhing rnam par dag pa bsten cing*/ bsten pa de las yon tan 'byung ba'i tshul lugs cung zad bstan nas/ da ni bsam pa shin tu rnam par dag pas/ dag pa la gnas par bya ste/ de yang ji lta bu yin zhe na/ bsam pa zhes bya ba ni rang gi sems yin la/ dag pa zhes pa ni gdod nas rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa spros pa thams cad kyi mtha' dang bral ba'i 'od gsal ba sems gdod nas rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa zhes zer/ glo bur gyi dri ma dang bral ba sems de nyid la/ nyon mongs pa gsum gnas skabs mthar thug tu shes bya'i gshis la mi gnas shing*/ gdod nas yod ma myong ba smig sgyu la chu dang*/ tho yor la mi dang*/ 'ja' tshon la dngos po dang*/ nam mkha'i btson rar chud pa dang 'dra ba'i de dang bdag nyes pa thams cad dang bral ba dang*/

rnam pa gnyis su dbyer med pa ni dag pa gnyis ldan dri ma med pa chos kyi sku zhes mkhas pa rnams kyis gsungs pa yin pas/ bsam pa rnam par dag pa 'di lta bur zhing rnam par dag pa de la blta bar bya ba ni gzhir gyur pa/ chos kyi sku rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa ye shes kyi tshogs mthar thug thob pa'i rgyu nges pa'o// yang rang nyid dam rang nyid phyogs dang ris mtha' dag yod ma myong ba la yod ma myong bar shes pas/ bdag med pa las skyes pa'i byang chub kyi sems ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can gzung ba dang 'dzin pa'i ma rig pa'i mun pas chags pa dang sdang ba'i 'khor ba'i 'khor lo sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho gting mtha' med par 'khyams pa'i sems can thams cad bde ba dang ldan/ sdug bsngal dang bral/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par byed pa'i lhag pa'i bsam pa g.yo med pas/ byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa ni rang 'khris med pas dag pa'i byang chub kyis/ gzugs kyi sku 'byung bar byed pa'i rgyu nges pa'o// bsam pa byang chub kyi sems des bla ma yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas chos kyi sku la mnyes par bya ba'i tshul lugs/ chos kyi sku thob par byed pa'i bar chad bsam pa'i dri ma sbyangs pa dang*/ gzugs kyi sku thob par byed pa'i bar chad kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems ltem rkyang du ma gyur pa dang*/ de gnyis 'grub par byed pa'i rgyu'am mthun pa'i rkyen bla ma dam pa mnyes par byed pa 'ba' zhig tu gsungs te/ de ltar yang*/ bla ma lnga bcu pa nas/ 'dir mang smos pas ci zhig bya// bla ma mnyes byed gang yin bya// mi mnyes byed kun spang bar bya// zhes pas bsam pa rnam par dag pa/ bla ma la lta ba rnam par dag pa dang*/ bsam pa la byang chub kyi sems rnam par dag pa dang*/ dngos po la mnyes par bya ba rnam pa gsum gyis bsam pa rnam par dag pa'o// de la dngos po rnam par dag pa ni/ thub pa'i gsung rab tu mthong chos 'bras bu can gyi las/

skyes nas myong 'gyur gyi las/ lan grangs gzhan la myong ba'i las dang rnam pa gsum du gsungs pa yin kyang*/ theg pa chen po gsang sngags brtson 'grus shin tu che ba dang*/ yid thung bar gyur pa'i don du mthong chos 'bras bu can 'ba' zhig gtsor gsungs pa yin te/ de yang 'grub byed kyi rgyu/ zhing dang bsam pa dang*/ dngos po rnam pa gsum gcig tu gyur pa sgrub pa gal che ste/ de ltar yang*/ zhing dang bsam pa dngos po gsum// gcig tu byas la gsol ba gdab// bar chad gsum dang bral gyur na// gang 'dod 'bras bu myur du smin// zhes pas mdor bsdus pa'i tshig smras pa'o// de la zhing ji lta ba dang*/ bsam pa ji lta ba de ltar dngos po yang de ltar bsgrub par bya ste/ 'dir theg pa chen po gsang sngags su/ rdo rje zhes pa rang nyid kyi phung po khams dang skye mched/ gzung ba dang 'dzin pas bsdus pa thams cad gnyis su med pa'i ye shes rdo rje ste/ de ltar yang badzras bsdus pa'o// 'di yang dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bor gyur pa/ 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po chos kyi rgyal po bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'chang chen po dpal ldan phag mo gru pa'i zhal snga nas/ 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pas bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rang gi sems/ sems gdod nas skye ba med pa nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor lta bu zhes gsungs pas/ zhing dang bsam pa dang dngos po rnam pa gsum dbyer med pa'i gnad kas dbyer med pa la/ dbyer med du shes pas yang dag pa'i shes pa khong du chud pa/ dbyer med pa'i rang bzhin gyi lus su grub par khong du chud par bya ste/ de ltar na zhing rnam par dag pa byang chub kyi sems gnyis dbyer med pa'i sku/ bsam pa rnam par dag pa byang chub kyi sems rin po che rnam pa gnyis dbyer med pa/ de dang dbyer med pa'i lus ngag yid rnam pa gsum mchod par bya ba'i yul dang*/

mchod par byed mkhan dang*/ dngos po thams cad chos kyi dbyings rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa/ de bzhin nyid dbye ba med pa/ dus gsum du gshegs shing bzhugs pa'i bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum lhun gyis grub cing rgyun mi 'chad la/ bdag ming rnal 'byor pa rdo rje zhes bgyi bas/ tshul de dang dbye ba med pa'i lus ngag yid gsum gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi rdo rje/ phung po rnam pa lnga rgyal ba rigs rnam pa lnga dang*/ skye mched byang chub sems dpa'/ 'byung ba yum/ gzung ba dang 'dzin pas bsdus pa thams cad rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor nyid du lhun gyis grub par gnas te/ byang chub kyi sems rin po che rnam pa gnyis dbye ba med pa'am/ thabs dang shes rab rnam pa gnyis dbyer med pa'am/ 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa gnyis dbyer med par go ba dang*/ rtags pa'i rnal 'byor pa la nges pa'i shes pa skyes pa ni/ de ltar yang*/ lung gis kyang nges te/ 'khor ba dang ni mya ngan 'das// gnyis su yod pa ma yin te// 'khor ba'i rang bzhin shes pa la// mya ngan 'das zhes brjod pa yin// zhes pa la sogs pa zung du 'jug pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ spyod pa'ang de dang gnyis su med pas 'di thams cad rab 'byams chos kyi dbyings kyis klas pa nam mkha'i mthas gtugs pa/ shes bya'i dkyil 'khor thams cad la ma khyab pa med pa sems can gyi khams thams cad smin pa dang grol bar byed pa/ dus gsum gyi 'phags pa thams cad phyi nang gsang ba de kho na nyid kyis mchod pas/ mnyes pa thams cad kyi pha rol tu phyin pas mnyes pa la/ phyogs 'di gcig pu yin zhes pa ni/ sems can gyi khams thams cad pas kyang*/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyis kyang gsungs pa'i mthar phyin pa med par rnal 'byor pa rang nyid kyis shes par byas la/ lus ngag yid gsum mam mnyes pa thams cad kyis bla ma dam pa mnyes par bya'o// de dag gi don bsdus pa'i tshigs su bcad pa/

'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa yi// chos rnams ma lus ji snyed pa// gdod nas zhi zhing ma skyes pa// rang bzhin mya ngan 'das pa'i dbyings// lhun gyis grub cing rgyun chad med// de ltar rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor pa// 'khor gsum yongs su dag pa yin// tshur rol mthong ba'i gang zag ngor// zhing dang bsam pa dngos po gsum// 'khor gsum dag tu bstan pa ste// dag dang dag rgyu gang yin pa// dbyer med gcig tu shes pa ni// mkhas pa rnams kyi zung 'jug ste// bla ma sku gsum lhun grub la// rang nyid sku gsum lhun grub kyis// dngos po sku gsum lhun grub kyi// lus ngag yid gsum sna tshogs kyi// dngos po bsam gyis mi khyab pa// shin tu phra ba'i rdul cig la// kun tu bzang po'i smon lam ltar// dus gsum shes bya ma lus pa// bsam gyis mi khyab mchod sprin gyis// mkhas pas rtag tu mchod par bya// dbyer med gcig tu gyur pa yis// tshe 'dir rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyang*// thob par dka' ba ma yin na// gzhan lta smos kyang ci zhig dgos// gzhan la bzlas pa ma lags te// shin tu zab pa'i gsang tshig 'di// rang gi lus dang srog dang yang*// dus gsum bsags pa'i dge ba la// chags shing zhen pa med pa yis// bla ma dam pa mnyes byed pa// de la de dang 'tsham pa yi// bstan bcos gnyis med rdo rje 'di// byas pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba yis// bcom ldan 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon// rdo rje 'chang chen chos kyi rje// dpal ldan phag mo gru pa yi// thugs kyi dgongs pa rin po che// nam mkha' mnyam pa'i sems can rnams// bde skyid phun sum tshogs pa dang*// sdug bsngal kun dang bral ba dang*// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das// rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid thob shog /dpal gnyis su med pa'i rdo rje a ba dhu tī zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos don gyi snying po sgom pa dar gzhon gyis zhus pa rdzogs so//

501) ༄// ma rig gti mug spong ba'i chos dam chos 'dul ba ma yin nam zhes pa// oṃ swasti/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la// gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi// bod kyi rgyal khams yongs kyi dpal// 'gro ba 'dren pa chos kyi rje// rgya sog gnyis kyi zhabs la 'dud// mkhas pas mngon pa'i rjes 'brangs nas// gzhi dang bsam sbyor mthar thug gi /yan lag brtsi ba ngo mtshar che// shin tu thugs la btags mod kyi// thub pa chen po chos kyi rjes// mi dge rnam pa bcu po yi// sems kyi mi dge rnam pa gsum// 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug la// brnab sems gnod sems log lta zhes// gsungs pa 'di yi go ba'i don// ma skyes dgra dang gtsug phud can// pha bsad ltung ba ma rdzogs zhes// kha cig zer bar gyur na yang*// ston pa'i gsung rab thams cad du// mtshams med 'byung zhes gsungs pa'i don// bsam sbyor mthar thug rdzogs par nges// de ni ci yi phyir zhe na// log lta'i sems ni sems byung phyir// sems dang mthar thug ma go bas// ston pa'i gsung la rnam rmongs shing*// thams cad mkhyen pa'i spyod yul mchog /ma rig gti mug spong ba'i chos// dam chos 'dul ba ma yin nam// dgongs dang soms dang shes rab can// ltos dang gzigs dang rgyal ba'i bka'// // 502) ༄// tshogs su gsungs pa'i chos seng ge mig byed ces bya ba'i gsung mgur// mig mkhan rgyal po 'gro ba'i mgon// mnyam med bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud// phyag rgya chen po seng ge ste// bcu chos mi shes mig med yin// rten 'brel thabs mkhas seng ge ste// gsum chos mi shes mig med yin// gsang sngags thabs mkhas seṅge ste// lnga ldan mi shes mig med yin// grub thob rtogs ldan seṅge ste// rje nga 'dra ma rnyed mig med yin// mkhyen pa'i ye shes seṅge ste// dbyer med ma shes mig med yin// mkhas btsun ldan pa seṅge ste// snyigs dus ma shes mig med yin// sde snod gsum po seṅge ste// rang gzugs ma shes mig med yin// seṅge mig 'byed bya ba yin// tshogs su'o//

// 503) ༄// 'ja' tshon mi bsgom stong ra bsgom zhes pa'i gdams phran dum bu gsum// 'ja' tshon mi bsgom stong ra bsgom// gtsub shing gtsub stan me cha yin// rtog pas rlung log na tsha bskyed// 'khor ba sdug bsngal tsha ba yin// byams dang snying rje byang chub sems// de las skyes pa'i lha la sogs// bya byed mang pos nad pa sos// ston pas sems kyi ting nge 'dzin// lus kyis mngon du byas pa yis// skyon dag yon tan rdzogs zhes gsungs// ༈ //skyabs dkon mchog bla na med pa la// nges par skyabs su song ba dang*// sgrub pa tshul bzhin byas lags na// dgos 'dod thams cad shugs las 'byung*// bla ma rin chen de skad gsungs// bdag 'bangs kyis zhu ba 'bul lags na// dgos 'dod shugs las 'byung mod kyang*// dar gzhon med na ci tsug byed// dngul rkyan med na gang nas 'dren// lar de dang 'dra ba mang po yod// bdag nyid chen pos sems can gyi// nyon mongs rnam rtog ji snyed pa// ma skyes stong par rtogs pa'i phyir// de yis de nyid grol bar byed// ma skyes dgra dang dga' byed bzhin// ༈ //nor bu mkhan gyi rin chen bzhin// sems bskyed pa ni rin chen la// phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba 'du ba dang*// dkar ba dri med ting 'dzin thob// byang chub sems dpa' blo gros rgya mtshos zhus pa'i mdor/ 'gro ba'i bla ma chos kyi rje// dga' ldan lha yi gnas mchog na// jo bo rje la gsol ba 'debs// sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa gzung snyam na// bslab pa gsum la gces spras chud// a log pa'i shes pa yi re mug /'khrul pa'i rtog pa 'dis nga re bslus// skye shis 'jigs nas 'ongs pa la// shi na mya ngan gdung ba skye// a log pa'i shes pa yi re mug /'khrul pa'i rtog pa 'dis nga re bslus// gangs kha ba ra ri mthong tsam na// gangs dkar ti se tur gyis dran// mi gzhan gyi bla ma mthong tsam na// bdag gi bla ma tur gyis dran// kwa a ma a dzi nga re 'jigs// mnyam med bla ma ma yin na// deng sang dus na ci 'dra ang*// ji ltar bsams kyang wa le gda'// mnyam med bla ma rin chen gyi// drin la 'khor thabs ma mchis na// sngon yang sku drin mi chung che// da rung byin gyis brlab tu gsol// dad pa can rnams bzhengs par zhu// mos gus can rnams bzhengs par zhu// khang pa bshu 'gebs byed pa yin// de la 'tsher rgyu ci yod ang*// dge ba'i bshes gnyen rin po che// dge bshes snya la phyag 'tshal lo// sngar bzhin thugs la 'dogs par zhu// slob dpon zer ba bden pa yin// gcig shos zer ba brdzun pa yin// bzang ngan du blta na rnal 'byor min// byed pa'i mi la smra ba de// thams cad kun gyi chos lugs yin// de la ko long byed pa na// a log pa'i shes pa yi re mug

/'khrul pa'i rtog pa 'dis nga re bslus// dpal 'bri gung pa yi sgom chen la// bla ma mnyes pa'i mos gus yod// las la 'tsher skad kyang ma thos so// nged 'di gnyis rgyal po'i sras po yin// khyi zhes la bkal yang ya yo med// mnyam par gnas pa dgod re bro// ji ltar byis pa chu mdun bzhin// nged kyi bla ma brid kha yang*// lta re lto re tshig gsum la// nyi ma phyed kyi so nam byung*// // 504) ༄// nad 'don gegs sel gyi zhal gdams dmigs rim dum bu bcu bdun// bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// yi dam lha la phyag 'tshal lo// dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// gsus po che la phyag 'tshal lo// gsus po che chen po la phyag 'tshal lo// bdag dang sems can ma lus kun// gong ma rnams kyi gnas thob shog /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bo nyid// bla ma rin chen de skad gsung*// dmigs pa'i lugs sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi gsung*/ nad kyi rgyu sa bon dang bcas pa dag par byed cing*/ nad de nyid lam du btang ba dang*/ byang chub kyi sems kyis kha bsgyur ba dang*/ chos rnam pa lnga pos dbang du byas pas tshor ba rin chen 'byung ldan zhes gsungs pa yin pas/ de'i don bla ma dam pa gong ma rnams kyis man ngag gi gnad gzhu rdung ba'am/ khab mig du skud pa 'dzud pa ltar skad cig kyang ma yengs par nan tan chen pos sems rtse gnyis med par nyams su blangs pas phan pa lags/ 'ol khar bskur ba// ༈ //sku khams khrag tu bshal ba de tshad pa'i nad du 'dug 'di la dus rgyun tu za 'thung byed pa'i chu nar ma de/ nang par skar ma ma bros pa'i dus su blangs nas grib ma la bzhag chu de rje btsun spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gang yang rung bar bsams la/ sku de la dmigs la yi ge drug pa nus tshad bzla/ sngags rgyun tu byas kyang shin tu legs/ de nas lus gos mang po gon/

dro bar byas la/ chu phor gsum dang lnga bdun dang mang du btang bas tshegs med par 'chad par 'dug dge ba'i rtsa ba bsngo bar bya/ ka tor phu ba la bskur ba// ༈ //dang po kho nar byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed/ lus yi dam gyi lhar bsgom/ bla ma dam pa lte ba'i 'og sor bzhi tsam gzhal ba'i sar bsgom/ de ma gsal nas rnam par mi rtog par song na yang de rang gi ngang la bzhag lar gsal na gsal ba'i ngang la bzhag mi gsal na mi gsal ba'i ngang la bzhag rjes la bsngo ba bya// ༈ //bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// dang por byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed/ lus yi dam gyi lhar yun ring du bsgom/ bla ma la mos gus bya/ de nas gang du na ba'i sa der yi ge hūm̐ mthing nag sor bzhi tsam pa mgo thur la mar bltas pa zhig bsam/ de la me lce khru gang tsam zhig mar la 'bar ba de'i me lce'i rtse mo la sems ma yengs par zhag bdun bsgom par zhu/ rjes la bsngo ba mdzad// ༈ //dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bo nyid// bla ma dam pa'i zhabs btud nas// zab mo gnad kyi gdams ngag bri// sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yum/ bcom ldan 'das ma rje btsun ma rdo rje rnal 'byor ma lte ba'i 'og khong pa'i nang du bsgom/ de yang byang chub kyi sems dang yi dam gyi lha dang bla ma bsgoms pa'i rjes la rje btsun ma bsgom/ rje btsun ma'i lte ba'i dbus su chos 'byung gru gsum pa/ de'i dbus su bam̐ yig la ye shes kyi bdud rtsi dkar la dmar chags pa bde ba'i rang bzhin can yun ring du bsgom/ bde stong gi ting nge 'dzin la sems ma yengs par bya/ dge ba'i rtsa ba rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bsngo'o// the tshom med pas mi bslu ba'i chos lags so// nyams su blang bar zhu/ dme 'dor na dge bshes zhig la dug nad kyi dmigs pa bskur ba// ༈ //dang por byang chub kyi sems bsgom/ lus yi dam gyi lhar bsgom/

dus gsum gyi bla ma rnams dang dbyer med pa'i sku/ bcom ldan 'das ma rje btsun ma rdo rje rnal 'byor ma che chung sor bzhi tsam zhig lte ba'i 'og tu bsgom/ de la sems rtse gcig tu nyin mtshan kha sbyar rgyun chad med par bsgom/ skabs skabs su dge ba'i rtsa ba rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bsngo'o// ma yengs pa gnad yin gal che/ gnas brtan gcig la dug nad kyi dmigs pa bskur ba// ༈ //rten 'brel gyi chos cig bskur gsung ba de la rten 'brel gyi chos gzhan med/ thugs dam dang dge sbyor la 'bad pa mdzad par zhu/ dpon chen po'i nad ngos ma zin pa de la/ dang po sngon du 'gro ba rnams byas la/ yi dam gyi lha shin tu gsal ba brtan par zhag bco lnga tshun chad bsgom/ nan tan chen por bsgoms pa'i rjes la de gzod sman pa mkhas pa la ston dang des ngos zin par 'gyur ba yin/ lar thams cad la bsod nams kyi tshogs sngon du 'gro ba can yi dam gyi lha dang nges shes thob pas thams cad legs par 'gyur ba lags/ slad kyi zhu don la/ sku khams cung zad ma bde ba thos pas/ de'i rgyu sman de cung zad ma zhu ba yin par dogs pas yungs kar tsam re re kha zas bzang po dang lhan cig tu gsol ba dang*/ de bas che ba mi gsol bar zhu/ gal che/ yum chen po'i gnas su bla ma dam pa'am/ tsaṇḍa li bsgom pa gal che/ mdor na dkar po phyogs kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad kyis phan pas thugs nyams su bzhes par zhu// ༈ //bla ma rin po ches/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen bla ma rje btsun pa la gdams pa/ khyed la ri khrod du tshul khrims rin po ches gzhi gzung*/ sbyangs pa'i yon tan la brten bca'/ sgrub pa tshul bzhin byed du re ba yin/ da rung yang de ltar mdzad par zhu/ sku khams ma bde ba de gzhan gyi skyon yang ma lags/ nad pa gsos pa'i grib tshan po che rang la 'phog pa la/ dge sbyor ma byas par phan tshun 'byams pa'i skyon yin/

da yang mtshams dam por chod la dge sbyor la nan tan snying po mdzad par zhu/ spyir nad pa'i tshan pa phan pa rnams kyang dge sbyor rgyun tu skyong rgyu ma byung na nad ldog pa yin/ nad log pa'i dus su khos nga la ma phan zer nas 'dod pa'i yon tan mi ster/ kha ngan pa sna tshogs 'bod/ 'dre'i dbang du song bas/ rang la yang gnod pa sna tshogs byed/ gsod pa'i sbyor ba la 'jug pas na nad pa ma gsos pa dga' ba yin/ ngas nad pa mang po gsos te/ de kho na bzhin du byung*/ bu slob chos byed pa rnams la bstan pa yin/ mi na ba yang dge sbyor la ma 'bad na nad par 'gyur du 'ong ba la/ dge sbyor rgyun par ma sbyangs na nad pa nad ldog pa smos kyang ci dgos pas bag dang ldan par bya'o// ༈ //khyed kyi thugs dgongs pa bzang po de// bar chad med par 'grub pa'i thabs// sa phyogs yangs shing rgya che ba// thams cad thugs rje chen por bsgom// thugs rje chen po'i thugs kar ni// rang nyid yi dam lhar bsgom ste// spyi bor bla ma dam pa bsgom// mos gus byas shing gsol ba gdab// ji ltar sgyogs dang 'khrul 'khor bzhin// the tshom med par 'grub pa yin// nyam nga bag tsha bral gyur nas// bla ma snying gi dbus su bsam// mdo smad pa lha dbang phyug zhabs drung du thon pa'i rten 'brel// ༈ //bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// byang chub sems dang yi dam lha// bla ma phyag rgya chen po rnams// ji lta ba bzhin bsgom byas nas// lte 'og sor bzhi gcal ba ru// zla ba'i dkyil 'khor mtho gang ba// dkar la zlum pa bsgom par bya// nyin mtshan ma lus thams cad du// yengs med dran pas rtse gcig bsgom// khrag tu skyugs pa'i nad rnams la// gangs chu gtang du mi rung ste// chu grang btang bas phan par 'gyur// bsngo ba'i gdams ngag gtsigs su che// 'dam pa'i yon bdag gcig khrag du skyugs pa la// ༈ //na mo gu ru/

dang po kho nar lam du btang*/ byang chub tu sems bskyed/ lus yi dam gyi lhar bsgom/ bla ma dam pa snying gi dbus su bsgom/ de nas bla ma de la me dmar la rno ba tsha la 'dom gang tsam cig mar 'dom pa bco brgyad kyi sa na mar la 'bar bar bsgom/ de'i rtse mo skad cig kyang dran pa ma yengs par bsgom par zhu 'tshal/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dang gser gyi pha bong yang bsgom par zhu 'tshal/ shin tu dben pa'i gnas nyid du// bya ba btang zhing spros pa bcad// rnam par rtog pas ma g.yengs par// nan tan chen pos bsgom mdzod dang*// don chen grub nas 'ong ba yin// jo bo chos lde la mig 'chus byung ba la// ༈ //mgul glo de la ji ltar dgongs pa bzhin du grib kyis blang ba lags mod kyi/ gdan dbu sngas cung zad mtho bar mdzad nas lus kyi 'khrul 'khor phyi gan du bzhugs shing*/ phyag gnyis brla rtsa na mar bzhag sems kyi dmigs pa gzhug gu thung gi mar rtser yi ge hūm̐ mthing nag mgo thur du bltas pa gcig la me thur la 'bar ba'i me lce'i rtse mo la sems rtse gcig tu ma yengs par gtad/ rlung gi gnad glo yar 'ong ba de rlung gis mar phul nas 'og sgo dri ma 'dor ba tsam du phul/ sku mtshams dam par bcad nas zhag gcig yan chad/ zhag bdun tshun chad thugs dam gsha' mar mdzad na tshegs med par phan nas 'ong bar gda'/ myong bas grub pa lags// dge bshes mkhon grags pa mgul glo mang pa la// ༈ //nga la sngon bla ma rin po ches/ khrag skyug na chu grang thongs gsungs pa gdams ngag du ma byas/ blo rno bas ma brjed/ gong du chos dang gdams ngag dgos snyam pa ma byung*/ phyis kyi dus su yon tan 'bar 'bur yod zer ba byung*/ de la snga ma gdams ngag du ma byas/ rin po che'i gsung gdams ngag yin mod/ de kun 'dra bas nam yang mi phan te snyam pa'i bsam pa ni byung*/ bdag rang ni mi sngon gyi ske ba lde lde bor song*/

de'i dus su sma ngan bab/ rgyu ngan lug 'di 'di gsung bya ba rdzun kha mthud mang po la gdams ngag du byed pa'i dus su/ nga'i slob ma yon bdag mi chen zhig rab tu byung*/ yun ring po ni ma bsten/ khams su rnyed pa tshol du song ba'i dus su gdams ngag med pa dang*/ bsten yun thung ba dang*/ gnyen po chung bas sdom pa shor/ 'bri gung pa yin zer thabs ma byung*/ thams cad du gsad dgos pa'i dus su/ khrag skyugs pa'i nad chen po byung*/ spyang ki bzhin ri bros byed pa'i dus su/ kha skom pa la tshugs pa ma byung*/ lto nam yang bza' rgyu ma rnyed/ chu mig cig gi sngas su bub chu nyin mtshan med par byas pas kho'i nad des phan/ khya re khyo re des bde bar byung nas/ phag mo grur nga yod pa'i drung du 'ongs/ sdug rabs bshad/ de'i lo rgyus thos pas/ 'o na rin po che'i de yang gdams ngag yin/ ngas kyang phan par 'dug snyam/ khyod kyi de yin ma byas/ de 'dra'i rigs can rnams la mang nyung dang chu ci tsam gtong ba/ mang nyung 'phel 'grib bstan pa rnams kyis mang po phan/ rdzun kha bshad mang po bas bden pa re re la mi yid ches par byung*/ phyis 'bri gung du dmar bshal gyi nad kyis mang po shi/ zhed pas gsol ba btab pas dmar bshal du gyur tshad la tshegs ma byung*/ blo thag chod/ deng sang khrag skyugs pa'i nad gang byung yang*/ 'di gshis kyis phan pa zhig yin par 'dug pas/ don go bar byas nas khong du chud par bya ste btang bar bya'o// sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi bka' jo bo thugs rje chen po mdun bskyed dang bdag bsgom gang byas bsnyen pa gang la bskyal yang tshegs med par phan pa ni sangs rgyas kyi bka'o// ༈ //nad drag po ma rungs pa yun ring du na ba la/ phyi dang nang du babs 'ong bar 'dug pas/ de'i babs de nang du glo ba la byung ba lags/ de la bcos kyi thabs/ sngon 'gro rnams gong du song bas/ lus kyi 'khrul 'khor dkyil mo krung legs par bca'/

cung zad rim gyis rim gyis lus shin tu dgye bar byas pas/ rgyab kyi sgal pa 'bur po nang du chud/ glo ba de nad yod pas de yang rang babs su song*/ de nas gar na ba'i sa der/ yi ge gang rung thig le'i rang bzhin dkar la 'tsher ba/ bde ba'i rang bzhin/ bde ba chen po rang du bsgom la/ dran pa ma yengs par bya/ de ltar yun ring du bsgoms pas je bde je bder 'ong*/ bsngo ba dang sems bskyed/ bden pa'i byin rlabs rnam pa lnga la 'bad pa gal che// ༈ //zhal gyi mdzer pa de la/ lte ba'i 'og tu bla ma bsgoms nas gser gyi rdo rje'am me de thag ring por dmigs pas sman pa lags/ yun ring du nan tan mdzad par zhu/ shangs mtshal la yang phan no// bla ma sing rgyal la// ༈ //ri lu de la za ba'i tshad dang*/ za dus dang*/ dbri skyed dang*/ rkyen gang dang sbyar ba dang bzhi yin pa las/ sman de rnams dngul chu gzhir gyur ba/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das nyid kyis gsungs pa yin pa las/ gzhan du ma yin te/ phan pa dang bde ba 'ba' zhig bskyed par byed pas/ dus rtag tu bsten par bya ba las gzhan du ma yin te/ phan pa nyid do// de la bza' ba'i tshad ni/ dang po sran ma tsam zhig ci rigs par zos pa'i dus su/ phan pa dang bde ba mi 'ong mi srid par 'dug de'i dus su brod pa skyes nas de bas che ba btang ba rnams/ sman ma zhu ba dug tu gyur nas 'chi ba la sogs pa nyes pa mang po 'ong bar 'dug pas/ phan pa de'i dus su je chung je chung la/ yungs kar gyi 'bru tsam du btang*/ des kyang kha so na ba dang*/ 'khru ba dang*/ nad gzhan dang gzhan la phog na/ yungs kar tsam yang mi btang bar/ zhag zla ci rigs par mi za bar bzhag de nas yang khad kyi ci rigs par btang*/ za ba'i tshad ni/ dro za ba'i dus lto snum pa'i dus su btang*/ rkyen gang dang sbyar ba ni/ dngul chu dang ni mu zi dang*// padma'i khrag dang sbyar ba yis// las rnams kun la bya ba yin// gsungs pas/

sman gsum po rtsa ba yin/ de la rlung mkhris bad kan nad so so gang la phan pa'i sman/ sman pa la dris pa dang sbyar la btang ba'o// tshul 'di ltar byas pas skyon ye mi 'ong*/ yon tan 'ba' zhig 'ong*/ lo gcig la dngul chu gser srang gang gi ljid/ mu zi de'i sum 'gyur bzhi 'gyur lnga 'gyur tsam du song yang skyon med/ rag ta ni shin tu nyung yang mi to// zhad tsam gyis kyang chog /sman gzhan ni tshod dang sbyar la gtang*// //

505) ༄// thag chod don go tshugs thub pa ci byed chos dang mthun pa de snyan brgyud yin zhes pa// na mo gu ru/ snyan brgyud rin po che drwa ba sdom pa zhes bya ba de 'di yin te/ dang po byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems sngon du 'gro bar gal che'o// de nas lus bcos pa'i gnad lnga tshul bzhin du chud pa yang gal che'o// 'di dang mi ldan pa la yon tan 'byung ba ga la srid de/ dper na 'khrug pa 'thab pa la so mkhar zhig pa dang 'dra'o// de nas yang byang chub kyi sems bskyed de/ 'di med na 'bras bu mi 'byung ste/ dper na shar du 'gro bar 'dod pa la nub tu phyin pa dang 'dra'o// de nas yang dmigs pa lha'i sku bsgom ste/ 'di med na 'phrin las mi 'grub/ dper na bud med skyes pa dag tu brdzus pa dang yang 'dra'o// de nas bla ma bsgom ste/ 'di med na gdung bcad pa rgyal po'i bu shi ba dang 'dra'o// de nas dmigs med bsgom par bya ste/ 'di med na las dbang du mi 'gyur te/ btsan po srid nyams pa dang 'dra'o// de nas bsngo ba bya ste/ 'di med na las chud za ba gser phye sa la bo ba dang 'dra'o// 'di rnams bsgom pa gal che'o// lar lus ngag yid gsum dran pas bzung ba gal che'o// mkhas pa gang la yang tshod yod ma byed/ rmongs pa gang la yang brnyas pa mi bya/ las 'bras gang la yang bskur ba mi gdab/ ngas byas dang drin brtsi su la yang mi bya/ rang ga'i shes pa btson du ma bzung*/ byung tshor gyi rtog pa la mtshan mar ma 'dzin/ don med pa'i kha rbad ma che/ the tshom ma shes pa don dang mi ldan/ tsab tsub mang po spyod pa ma yin/ bzang ngan du phye na 'bras bu mi 'grub/ lar tshod zin la mtha' chod pa/ don go la tshugs thub pa/ ci byed chos dang mthun pa de snyan brgyud yin no// // 506) ༄// dbye chung phug tu sku mtshams skabs rang rnam nye gnas spo spo la gsungs pa// skyabs gnas dam pa thugs rje chen po la phyag 'tshal lo// kho bos bla ma rin po che lo mang po bsten long ma byung*/

gdams pa ni mang du lon/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa yab yum la yi dam du byas/ lnga ldan du nyams su len cing lo du ma bsgrubs pas/ gang na mi 'dod pa'i skyon du ma byung ba la/ gdams ngag gis rten 'brel du shes/ the tshom ma byas par bsgrubs pas me ma mur la 'bogs pa dang*/ ltogs shing zas med pa dang*/ thams cad seng ges khengs nas khar 'bu za ba la sogs pa rmi lam dang mthong snang bshad kyis mi lang ba mang po byung*/ nad du mdze byung*/ lus sha ros gang*/ re sa mi gcig med/ nga shi ba rung*/ 'pho ba bya dgos snyam nas/ sngon 'gro bla ma'i rnal 'byor zhig bsgoms pas/ gang gis kyang ma stongs/ shi ba rung snyam pa'i dus su/ snying po che brang 'og tu bcug nas bsgoms na/ nga'i bu yin gsungs pa dran nas mos gus dang snying rje tshad med pa skyes/ gnyid cig log pa'i rmi lam na/ rje btsun thugs rje chen po dang mjal/ snying gar mu tig gi phreng ba reg reg mdzad pas sems can gyi khams dang bag la nyal thams cad gsal wal wal byung ba dang*/ rje btsun bdag la thim pa dang*/ rang rje btsun du gyur nas/ nam mkha' la dkyil krung bcas pa'i 'og tu ljongs kha ba can thams cad tshud/ 'od zer yi ge drug par dkar hram hram 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad khengs pa zhig rmis/ gnyid de sad tsam na nad thams cad kyang bde/ rten 'brel la sogs pa yang go nas bsgrubs pas zhag bdun na zhal mngon sum du mthong dbang bskur bas/ gnyis med 'od gsal chen po la/ mnyam rjes med pa'i rtogs pa 'khrungs/ bde bar gshegs pa mang po'i zhal mthong*/ po po khyod dad gus che bas bzlas pa yin/ gzhan yang rang gi slob ma re re gnyis ma gtogs pa la songs shig /lar rang gi lo rgyus rang gis bshad pa mi 'thad kyang*/ slob dpon 'phags pa la sogs pas kyang gsungs nas 'dug pas/ khyod dad pa gso ba'i ched du byas pa yin no// // 507) ༄// thugs rje chen po'i bsgom bzlas kyi dmigs rim zab yon chen la springs pa//

oṃ swasti/ bla ma rin po ches/ yon chen la springs pa/ khyed sngon bsod nams kyi tshogs rgya chen po bsags pas skye ba mi'i lus rin po che thob nas lha dang mi thams cad kyi drang zhing dkar por gyur te/ jo bo dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la mi phyed pa'i dad pa thob nas/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas dpag tu med pa'i yab dang yum du gyur pa/ sangs rgyas gaṅga'i klung drug cu'i bye ma snyed la mchod cing bsnyen bkur ba bas mtshan lan gcig thos pa bsod nams che ba sangs rgyas thams cad kyi 'phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i thog mar 'gro ba/ byang phyogs kha ba can gyi sa phyogs 'dir/ mnga' bdag mes dbon rnam pa gsum dang*/ jo bo rje lha gcig dang*/ bla ma rin po che la sogs pa skyes bu dam pa bdag nyid chen po rnams kyi yi dam gyi lhar gyur pa/ rje btsun 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po/ jo bo thugs rje chen po la yi dam gyi lhar mdzad cing*/ yi ge drug pa'i rig sngags dpag tu med pa bzlo ba la bdag kyang rjes su yid rang zhing mchis/ de yang sangs ma rgyas kyi bar du yi dam gyi lha mdzad par zhu/ dang por stan bde ba'i steng du dkyil mo krung legs par bcas la/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par bya/ de'i ched du jo bo thugs rje chen po bsgom pa dang bzlas pa bya snyam du bsams la/ rang gi lus jo bo thugs rje chen po spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug zhal gcig phyag bzhi par bsam/ spyi bor bla ma dam pa bsams nas/ jo bo'i sku la shes pa ma yengs par gtad la yi ge drug pa ci nus tshad bzla/ de nas ngam ngam shugs kyis mi dmigs par gyur na/ mi dmigs pa mtshan ma med pa de nyid phyag rgya chen po yin pas/ de'i ngang la bzhag cing yi ge drug pa ci nus tshad bzla'o// nam zhig 'chi ba'i dus la bab na/ spyi bo'i bla ma la shes pa ma yengs par gtad/

de ltar gtad pa nyid kyis dmigs pa med par 'gro ste/ mi dmigs pa phyag rgya chen po de'i ngang las ma yengs par bzhag nas dbugs song na/ gsang sngags kyi 'pho ba zab mo yin pas de ltar shes par bya'o// spyir tshe thog ma med pa nas mtha' ma da lta yan chad du byas pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba dang*/ da phyin chad sangs rgyas ma thob kyi bar du dge ba'i rtsa ba byed pa dang*/ tshe 'dir dge ba'i rtsa ba byas pa la dmigs la/ spyir rang gzhan dang 'khor 'das thams cad kyis/ dus gsum du bsags pa dang yod pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis/ bdag dang sems can thams cad myur du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub rin po che thob par gyur cig ces dge ba'i rtsa ba bsngo ba la 'bad par bya'o// // 508) ༄// smon 'jug don dam sems bskyed rnams thob pa'i sa mtshams bstan pa// byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed nas// gzhan la sbyin pa gtong ba ni// smon pa'i sems las byung ba yin// sems dang sems byung smon sems gsung*// byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed dang*// sbyin pa gtong bar byed pa gnyis// gnyis med gcig tu gyur pa ni// 'jug sems sdom pa'i bdag nyid yin// sbyin dang sems bskyed la sogs rnams// dngos po thams cad dang bral bar// rtogs shing khong du chud pa de// don dam sems bskyed tha snyad 'dogs// smon sems mthong lam man chad la// 'jug sems sa bdun man chad la// don dam sa brgyad rtogs nas thob// sa gsum dag la sbyong ba yin// sbyangs shing dag par gyur pa la// byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin sku// dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang chen zhes// bla ma rin chen bka' bstsal gsungs// // 509) ༄// rmi lam dang mtshan ma ngan pa thams cad gtsug gtor 'bar ba'i snying pos bzlog pa// sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo// rmi lam ngan pa dang mtshan ma ngan pa thams cad 'jig par byed pa ni/

rang nyid bcom ldan 'das gtsug tor 'khor los bsgyur bar bsgoms la/ de'i snying po ci rigs par bzlas la/ phyag rgya 'di bcas nas gtsug tor 'bar ba'i snying po bzlas pas myur du 'grub par gsungs so// de la phyag rgya ni/ mdzub mo gnyis kyi rtse mo btud pa gung mo la sbyar ba la/ mdzub mo'i sen mo gung mo'i tshigs gsum pa'i char sbyar ba ni/ 'khor los bsgyur ba'i phyag rgya'o// snying po ni/ na ma sarba buddha ni/ a pra ti ha ta sha sa na naṃ/ oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi hūm̐ hūm̐/ dzwa la dzwa la/ pra dzwa la pra dzwa la/ tiṣṭha tiṣṭha phaṭ phaṭ swā hā// // 510) ༄// gdan sa phag gru'i dge 'dun la gnang ba'i phrin yig rdo rje mkha' 'gro dgyes dbyangs// oṃ swasti/ dbyer med byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin rtag pa'i sku// mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo chos rje rin chen dang*// bla ma dam pa rnams dang yi dam dkon mchog la// gus pas phyag 'tshal rtag tu skyabs su nye bar mchi// dpa' bo rnal 'byor rdo rje mkha' 'gro dang*// thub chen chos kyi srung ma thams cad kyis// phan bder 'dod pa bdag gi bsam pa 'di// rdzogs shing grub par byin gyis brlab tu gsol// mgon po phag mo gru pa rdo rje 'chang*// bcom ldan de yi thugs dgongs rdzogs pa'i phyir// legs par byas shing smras tshig bsgrub pa'i phyir// gdan sar dge 'dun btang ba 'di ltar lags// dpon grags dang ngas btang ba de rnams/ bza' mi dang*/ gnyer dang*/ bya bzhag la ma btang ngo*// ba de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de rin po che'i bu slob spyis bzhag pa ma gtogs pa mi btub pa yin pas/ khyed rnams la mi zhu'o// gnya' dang*/ g.yon dang*/ bar la ma btang ngo*// ba de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de mnga' dbang chen po yod pa rnams kyis mdzad pa yin pas/ khyed rnams kyis mi 'ong la/ 'ong yang mi zhu ba lags so// kha smras dang*/ gleng gzhi dang*/ khrag khrug la ma btang ngo*// ba de ci'i phyir zhe na/

de rje lha btsan po ba sa'i bdag po thams cad dbang bskur ba'i rgyal po'i mdzad pa yin pas/ khyed 'jag mig gi srin bu dang 'dra ba'i bsam gtan pa rnams la mi zhu ba lags so// phyogs cha byed pa dang*/ srid gcod pa dang*/ lding tsho'i shom ra la ma btang ngo*// ba de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de rnams byas zin/ tshar zin/ dge ba'i rtsa ba bsngos zin pa lags so// gnyer gtod pa dang*/ len pa dang*/ mtho dman gyi bya bzhag la ma btang ngo*// ba de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de gdan sa rin po che'i bdag po stag lung thang pa khong rang gis mdzad zin pa yin pas khyed rnams kyis 'phrog tu mi btub ste/ rang nyid la sor kyis gzhal bar zhu ba lags so// sus 'di 'dra'i bya bzhag dang*/ byed pa rtsom pa byung na/ nga'i gdan sa rin po che der mi 'jog ste/ chen pos brtsom pa byung ba na mi bzhugs par nga rang gis zhu/ 'bring pos rtsom pa 'byung na lag pa la 'dzin nas phud/ ngan pas rtsom pa byung na ser mo len/ da rung byas nas/ gnas nas 'byin pa lags so// 'gro ba'i bla mas byang chub sems la gdams// sras dang bcas pas bdag la gnyer ka gtad// khur chen thogs pas kun kyang bde la bkod// rigs pa min zhes bdag la smra ba rnams// gong ma'i thugs dgongs mthong bar ma gyur snyam// nongs par gyur na thams cad bzod par gsol// ༈ //bdag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba dri med yangs shing rgya che ba// byas shing bsags pa dpag tu med pa gang dag yod pa des// ji srid 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho chen po stong par ma gyur tshe// rin chen sras bcas kun gyi g.yog po nyid du bdag gyur cig /sras kyi thu bo stag lung thang pa la// rgyal ba 'khor ba 'jig zhes bya ba byung*// de yang nga nyid yin zhes bka' bstsal gsungs// 'das pa'i rgyal ba de la phyag 'tshal lo// dbyangs 'di la rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// rab tu dgyes par gar yang byas// // 511) ༄// kha zas kyi sbyor ba ngan pa sman dang 'gred kyis srung ba'i dmigs pa'i sgom thabs//

oṃ swasti/ kha zas kyi sbyor ba ngan pa sman dang 'gred kyis srung ba'i thabs yod de/ thig le nyams pa dang*/ 'khru ba dang*/ skyugs pa dang*/ tshad pa'i nad kyis btab pa la sogs pa'i dus su bsrung bas mi thub pa lags/ rten 'brel gyi sbyor ba gzhan yang rten 'brel mi 'grigs pas srung bar dka' ba lags/ sngags 'dis nga rang yid ches pas/ gnod pa bsrung bar nus pa lags pas/ dang por byang chub kyi sems dang yi dam gyi lha bsgom/ sngags 'di la bsnyen pa stong tsho gsum yan chad ci mang du bskyal/ ngal ba'i dus su yang mang du bzlas/ de nas yid mi ches pa'i kha zas dang phrad na/ dang por byang chub kyi sems dang yi dam gyi lha bsgom/ kha zas la oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum bzlas pas ye shes kyi bdud rtsir dkar mer la gyur par bsam/ de la nyi shu rtsa gcig yan chad bzlas la/ sngags bzla zhing*/ za ba ni bza' btung gi srung ba'o// khong du song zin na/ bza' rgyu dang btung rgyu mtha' dag dang*/ chu la bzlas shing bza' btung bya ba dang*/ nad la shes pa gtad nas bzlas pa byas pas phan pa la tshegs med pa lags so// pe'i kra na/ bhi ha ni/ bha sa bha ba/ phu gang to to shi to ti bhis dza dzā/ kha gro gro/ kha gro gro/ dug se/ toka se/ sāe to/ tod ci nan// // 512) ༄// 'gro kun dug gsum gcod pa'i tshigs bcad sta re ma// oṃ swasti/ kye ho/ rang lus gdos bcas 'jog pa'i chos su gnas// rnam rtog sprin 'di yal ba nyid du 'gyur// sems kyi rgyal po skye 'gag gnas gsum bral// 'khrul pa'i byis pa rtog pa'i rjes su 'brangs// dam pa'i chos 'di nyan pas bsgrub pa gces// shes pa mang po rtog pa'i phreng ba yin// bsgrub la brtson par nyams su blangs gyur na// tshe gcig sangs rgyas 'grub par the tshom med// dam tshig ldan pas dngos grub thams cad 'byung*// dug gsum rnam par dag na sangs rgyas sku gsum thob// tshogs gnyis gsog la dga' na 'bras bu thams cad 'byung*// sa gzhi dul na lo 'bras gang yang skye// rin chen sems 'di goms na gar yang khrid du btub// snying rje rab tu ldan na kun gyis ma bzhin sems// byams pa rgyun chad med na lha mi'i tshogs rnams dga'// rang sems g.yo sgyu spangs na kun dang mthun par 'gyur// rang sems skyon dang bcas na thams cad ngan par mthong*// zhe sdang khong khro che na sdug bsngal rgyun par 'byung*// rang 'byin 'phyar phyung ches na kun bas ngan par 'gro// he he de kun ku re bgyis pa lags// min yang tshul khrims khrel dang ldan pas srungs// brtson 'grus rang la brtse bas brtsam// khe dang grags pa 'dod na phyag rgya chen por bsgom// khe dang grags pa thams cad 'di la yod par gsungs// tshigs bcad sta re ma zhes bya ba 'dis// 'gro ba kun gyi dug gsum gcod par shog/

// 513) ༄// 'dres ded kyi bsrung ba mi bya bar skya khra zan la gzhum pa'i gdams pa// 'dre ded kyi bsrung ba mi bya bar// rtse gcig sgrub pa nyams su blang*// rgya la mi bya dbang med na// rang nyid bya ba tshar ba dang*// bla ma yi dam dkon mchog dang*// chos skyong srung ma thams cad la// mchod pa phul la gsol ba gdab// gnod byed lan chags de dag la// gtor ma byin la bka' bsgo bya// de nas glang chen khri steng du// jo bo kha sar pa ni bzhugs// skya khra zan la 'jums bzhin bzhud// bsgrub bya thugs kar sba bar bya// skyon las grol bar the tshom med// //

514) ༄// lug thug rwa ya chag pa ltar khro ba mi rigs par zhu don gsol ba'i yi ge/ oṃ swasti/ skyes chen gang zhig 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal 'khur bsnams shing*// byang chub thugs gnyis 'dres pas rang gzhan don grub pa// sku gsum dbyer med bla ma dam pa rin chen gyi// zhabs kyi padmor gtsug gis gus pas 'dud// 'das dang ma 'ongs da ltar dang*// phyogs bcu dus gsum bzhugs pa yi// rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa yi// gzhung lam byang chub sems yin pas// lus ngag yid gsum bya ba rnams// byang chub sems dang bsngo ba yis// ma lus thams cad zin par bya// nyon mongs rnam rtog gang byung ba// ji ltar chu la chu bzhag dang*// ji ltar mar la mar bzhag bzhin// sems la sems nyid bzhag pa bsgom// zhu don gsol ba'i yi ge 'di// chen por gyur pa khyed rnams la// smra mchu mthon dman mi rigs kyang*// dad dang gus pa'i gdung shugs kyis// rlabs chen zhabs tog byas pa la// lug thug rwa ya chag pa ltar// khros nas sdod pa ga la rigs// zhu don gsol ba gnang bar zhu// bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi// dus gsum bsags dang yod pa yi// dge ba gang des 'gro ba rnams// bla med byang chub thob par shog/ // 515) ༄// dug rnams sman du bsgyur bar byed pa'i gdams pa rnal 'byor bzhi rim// oṃ swasti/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyis// ma gsungs gsung bar mi 'gyur ba'i// dam chos yid bzhin nor bu yis// 'gro ba smin mdzad de la 'dud// sangs rgyas kun gyis bkur gyur pa'i// bla ma rin chen mnyes byas shing*// mos gus ltem rkyang med gyur pas// dus rnams kun tu mchog gyur na// rnal 'byor bzhi yi rim pa tshang*// rtse gcig rgyud la skyes tsam na// tha mal shes pa ma bcos pa// rig pa gcer bu rting po de// nyams rnams kun dang bral ba 'byung*// mi mthun rkyen dang ma phrad cing*// bla ma dam pas ngo sprad nas// de nyid lhun grub bde chen gyi// spros dang bral ba'i rtogs pa skye// spros dang bral ba'i rnal 'byor ni// rang gi sems nyid skye ba med// gzung dang 'dzin pas ma gos shing*// skye 'gag gnas gsum mtha' dang bral// ro gcig rgyud la skyes tsam na// snang zhing srid pa'i chos rnams kun// sems dang dbye ba ma mchis shing*// sna tshogs dngos po gcig du 'gyur// bsgom du med pa'i rnal 'byor ni// skyon rnams kun gyis ma gos shing*// yon tan thams cad rab rdzogs ste// thams cad mnyam nyid yin no gsungs// 'di las byung ba'i dge ba gang*// dri med rin chen gser 'gyur rtsis// dug rnams sman du bsgyur byed cing*// yon tan ma lus rdzogs par shog/

ji ltar chu la chu bzhag dang*// ji ltar mar la mar bzhag ltar// gnyis su med par gyur pa 'di// gshis yin pas mos gus ma gtogs pa/ lus gog po gnyis gcig tu spoms nas bzhag kyang phan pa med de/ dper na dge slong legs pa'i skar mas/ ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bsten pa dang 'dra ba yin gsung*/ bdag gi bla ma brgyud pa 'di rnams la yang*/ mos gus dang gsol ba btab pa tsam gyis mngon par rtogs pa rgyud la skye ba lags/ bdag la yang de ltar du mchi bar gda'/ thag nye ring yang med de/ rje btsun chen po'i zhal snga nas kyang*/ gung thang du skyes pa'i mi la dang*// rgya gar gyi nā ro paṇa chen gnyis// sems 'od gsal gyi ngang du gcig tu 'dres// zhes gsungs pa yin pa la/ jo bo nyid tha mal pa ltar mjal bar bzhed pa'i thugs kyi dgongs pa ga la srid pa'i phyir dang ston pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de nyid kyi gdan sa chen po/ yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi thams cad kyi yang snying*/ hi ma la ya kha ba can gyi ri/ ti se'i gangs ma dros pa'i mtsho dang bcas pa 'di ni/ theg pa chen po gsang sngags rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud kyi dbang du bgyis pas/ sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor ma gtogs pa/ bcom ldan 'das nyid kyi pho brang du bzhed pa dang*/ mdo sde dang*/ 'dul ba dang*/ mngon pa rnam pa gsum ni dar/ ston pas zhabs kyis bcags shing*/ zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos mang po gsungs shing*/ gdul bya dpag tu med pa smin pa dang grol ba'i gnas su gsungs pa dang*/ bcom ldan 'das 'khor ba 'jig nas bskal pa bzang po'i sangs rgyas stong thams cad kyi gdan sar gsungs pa dang*/ dpal mkha' 'gro ma dus 'byung ba'i rgyud nas/ ti se nas u rgyan gyi bar 'di la byang phyogs sham bha la'i grong khyer zhes gsungs shing*/ 'dir rje btsun 'jam dbyangs la sogs pa gdul bya smin par mdzad pa'i rgyal po byang chub sems dpa' rgyun ma chad par 'byung zhing*/

tshe lo bcu pa'i dus su rgyal po rdo rta can zhes bya ba 'byung ba yan chad kyis/ thub pa'i bstan pa rin po che dar zhing rgyas par mdzad ces bzhugs pa la sogs pa/ mdor na/ stod mnga' ris bskor gsum gyi rgyal po 'di rnams/ chos kyi rgyal po byang chub sems dpa' 'ba' zhig tu ni nges na/ sprul pa'am rang rgyud dam sdig spyod kyi rgyal po gang du ji ltar yin na ni/ bdag cag tshu rol mthong ba'i rten gyi gang zag sgro 'dogs pa dang skur ba 'debs pa'i rang bzhin du gyur pas/ btang snyoms 'ba' zhig tu 'jog pa lags mod kyi/ rnal 'byor pa rang nyid myong ba'i tshad ma'i dbang du byas pa'am/ bcom ldan 'das kyis/ dus gsum dus med rtogs pa po// zhes gsungs pa dang*/ rtogs pa de nyid las/ sangs rgyas sras dang nyan thos rang rgyal lha rnams dang*// 'gro ba kun gyi bde skyid chos ni ji snyed pa// de kun shes rab pha rol phyin pa mchog las byung*// zhes pas/ khyed kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes gcig pu/ lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten thams cad skyob par mdzad pa'i skyabs yin pa'i phyir dang*/ bdag gi bu rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug sgrub pa gtso bor 'dod pa rnams kyang*/ jo bo lha dge ba'i bshes gnyen bla chen po nyid kyi pho brang*/ ti se dang ma pham lta bar 'dod pa rnams/ padma'i mtsho la ngang pa snyog pa ltar mchis pa rnams la skyob par byed pa'i mgon po bdag po chen po jo bo nyid kyis legs par bskyangs pas/ tshogs rnam pa gnyis rdzogs pa las gzhan pa med pa'i phyir/ byon gshegs mdzad pa shin tu yang mi rigs pa lags pas/ de nyid du bzhugs par zhu/ de nas chags 'og gi rdul bde bar bton nas/ bla'i mchod gnas su mdzad pa ldom bu ba bdag lta bu la thugs kyi gdung ba chen po mnga' na/ nyid kyi zhabs drung du mchis pas chog pa lags pas/ yar mchis par zhu/ nga pu hrengs su phyin na yang*/

nga 'bu dge 'dun gyi tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad yul de nyid kyis legs par 'tsho ba lags/ dper na 'bri gung gi sa la yang 'dom pa mang po ma mchis/ 'bul ba dang zhabs tog rgya chen po phyogs bcu thams cad nas bskyal ba dang*/ tshong dus yod pas khyogs pa lags/ pu rangs la yul gyi dge lho byang shar nub thams cad kyi zong legs par 'khrigs pas yul je bzang je bzang du 'gro ste/ nga 'bri gung du bsdad pas phyug mtshams bzang du song ba dang 'dra/ do gcig gi gnas skabs 'dir/ jo bo nyid la chag shin tu che ba cig bdog pas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi bka' rgyal ba'i yum rgyas pa dang*/ sdong po bkod pa'am/ sangs rgyas phal po che dang*/ gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po dang*/ ting nge 'dzin rgyal po dang*/ bcom ldan 'das rje btsun gyi gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang*/ khyad par du 'dus pa chen po rin po che'i tog dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i dpal gyi dam tshig ces pa'i mdo 'di rnams phal cher mdo mang na bzhugs pa lags pas/ rab tu gyur na seng ge'i khri la chos smra ba dge slong tshul khrims dang ldan zhing ting nge 'dzin gyi stobs yod pa/ de ma rnyed na yang dkon mchog gsum la yid ches shing*/ sdom pa sna re tsam bsrung ba la rgyun bya ba'am/ rgyun byed pa gal che/ mdo sde re re la yang klog mkhas pa bzhi bzhi tsam gyis rgyun ma chad par byed pa dang*/ yul ris dang rgyal khams de'i phud rnams kyis/ de rnams kyis mchod pa dang*/ gtor ma dang gsol zas su bya zhing gsol ba btab na/ bkra shis dang bde legs phun sum tshogs pa thams cad 'byung bar bcom ldan 'das kyis zhal gyis bzhes pas/ bslu ba med pa lags pas/ de la nan tan chen po mdzad par zhu/ gsung rab 'di rnams la klog 'don gyi rim pa rtag tu rgyun ma chad par mdzad pa dang*/ bla chen po rgyal 'bangs phyogs ris dang bcas pa thams cad dge sbyor dang thugs dam la 'bad pa dang*/

ti se na yod pa'i sgom chen pa rnams kyang thugs dam la 'bad pa shin tu gal che/ sdang bar byed pa'i dgra/ gnod par byed pa'i bgegs/ thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i bar du gcod par byed pa'i bgegs dang log 'dren thams cad la byams pa dang snying rje byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa gal che/ nga la skyes dang*/ 'bul ba dang*/ zhabs tog gi tshan pa mar la mi bskur bar zhu/ sprang ba ri bsdad pa mang po lhags pa la thugs ma chad pa thugs la btags/ yi ge mi 'khyams pa'i rten/ na bza' zhig bskur nas mchis pas 'di sku la gsol bar zhu/ gzhan su la yang mi gnang bar zhu/ jo bo bla chen po la dbon sgom pa rdo rje seng ges ha pu ngur dmar rab kha the'u ma nyams pa yug gcig 'bul zhing mchis// ༈ //dmigs med snying rje chen po yi// sku gsung thugs nyid mi zad pa// rgyan gyi 'khor lo mtha' yas can// spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal nas// sgrub thabs gsung bzhin bri bar bya// mtshan nyid ldan pa'i gang zag gis// phun sum tshogs pa'i gnas mchog tu// 'gal rkyen thams cad spangs nas kyang*// mthun pa'i rkyen du gang gyur bsten// tshad med bzhi dang ldan pa yis// yan lag bdun pa byas nas kyang*// byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed nas// ma bcos stong pa nyid du bzhag /de nas rdo rje rin chen gyi// pad nang nyi zla'i gdan steng du// rang sems hrīḥyi ngo bor bsam// de gyur padma hrīḥs mtshan las// 'od zer phar la 'phros pa yis// sems can sgrib pa dag byas nas// 'od tshur hrīḥl 'dus pa dang*// 'jig rten dbang phyug thub chen po// sku mdog dkar la 'od zer 'bar// zhal gcig phyag ni bzhi pa la// dang gnyis thugs kar thal mo sbyar// lhag ma phreng pad 'dzin pa'o// rgyan rnams kun gyis rnam par spras// zhabs gnyis dkyil krung mdzes par ldan// de ltar bdag nyid bsam byas la// thugs kar zla steng yi ge hrīḥ

/mtha' mar sngags kyis bskor bar bsam// sku gsung thugs nyid byin gyis brlab// ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs bstim// dbang skur rigs kyi bdag pos brgyan// byin dbab ma yengs gsal bar bsgom// thams cad rim gyis bsdus nas kyang*// ci yang bsam par mi bya 'o// oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐/ byams dang snying rjes bzlas pa bya// rang nyid nga rgyal brtan pa yis// gzugs mthong sgra dang dran pa rnams// 'jig rten mgon po'i sku gsung thugs// yin no snyam du nges shes bskyed// 'ja' tshon brag cha nam mkha' bzhin// rang bzhin dag pa'i stong pa nyid// mi rtog pa ru mnyam gnas te// bdag gzhan don ni rab sgrub phyir// tshogs gnyis gsog pa'i spyod lam bya// skyon dag yon tan rab rdzogs pa'i// mi gnas mya ngan 'das par 'gyur// 'dis mtshon 'khor 'das thams cad kyis// dus gsum bsags dang yod pa yi// dge bas ma lus sangs rgyas shog /rin chen dpal gyis sgrub thabs 'di// chos rgyal khyed kyi gsung lci nas// zab pa'i gnad kun bsdus nas bris// cis kyang thugs dgyes mdzad par zhu// rdzogs so// // 517) ༄// 'dzam gling las kyi sa bon yin pa sgom pa rong sgom la springs pa// oṃ swasti/ bla ma rin po ches/ sgom pa rong sgom la springs pa/ phyogs kyi 'grul pa la smras pas sku rin po che la bser ba'i snyun mi mnga' zhing*/ byang chub kyi dgongs spyod zab mo la bar chad kyi rkyen ma mchis par/ rang gzhan thams cad la phan pa dang bde ba sgrub cing*/ bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs rdzogs par mdzad ces khums/ de la bdag kyang blo ba dga' zhing mchis/ slad kyi don zhu ba/ khyed kyis dad pa dang gus pa'i shugs bskyed du med pas/ snga phyir 'bul ba bskur ba de rnams chad lhag med par phyag du thengs/ snga ma'i 'brel ba ji ltar yod pa dang*/ zhal mjal ba dang*/ gdams ngag cig bskur gsung ba'i ngos nas/

'brel ba la/ bla ma rin po che'i zhal snga nas/ gang la dad pa de dang tshe snga ma phan chad du 'brel pa yod pa yin gsung las kyi ngos nas 'dzam bu gling las kyi sa bon yin pas/ las dge ba bsags/ dge bas sbrel na da lta nyid du 'brel nas yong gsung bas/ bsod nams kyi tshogs bsag pa la 'bad pa gal che/ zhal mjal bar bzhed na shin tu legs te myur du 'byon par zhu/ gdams ngag stong pa nyid dang snying rje bsgom pa la nan tan che bar mdzad par zhu// ༈ //dug gsum nyon mongs g.yo med na// sgrib pa spangs pa'i kha tshon du// smon lam myur du 'grub pa mtshar// ma rig pa dang 'dres pa las// nyan thos byang chub sems dpar phye// pho re bo dang kun gyi rje// gdug dang sems dpa' dbang du 'du// 'bri gung pa yi sgom chen de// byi'u chung 'dzing nga'i spyod pa byed// a log pa'i shes pa 'di yi re mug /'khrul pa'i rtog pas nga re bslus// skyabs bla na med pa'i dkon mchog la// g.yo sgyu'i mchod pas mi mchod 'tshal// a ba re bzang a re mtshar// phyi sgyur gcig byas nas bzhag na ang*// bying na dga' bzhi rim gyis bsgom// rgod na dpa' bo'i tshems sgra bsgrig /chos khri sku yi lder so la// stag lung thang pas zangs thog phib// 'ba' lda phug pas ber chen gsol// nga 'bus gser gdugs tog can phul// bu bzangs kyi pha la dmu grog gda'// de ltar lags so rje btsun pa// //

518) ༄// rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug 'byung song la springs pa'i gdams ngag dum bu gsum// oṃ swasti/ bla ma rin po ches/ nga'i bu'i dam pa/ slob ma'i yang rab/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi spyan sngar springs pa/ rang don gzhan don gang nyams su len yang byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems kyi mthu chung na gnod pa grib 'ong bar gda' bas/ da rung yang byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems dang*/ ku sā li'i tshogs gsog dang*/ yi dam gyi lha bskyed pa'i rim pa la nan tan shin tu che bar mdzad par zhu// ༈ //'jig rten mgon po rin chen dang*// rgyal ba sras dang bcas rnams kyis// byin gyis brlabs pa'i dge ba'i bshes// 'gro ba smin mdzad chos kyi rje// dpal chen chen por rnam grags pa// khyed kyis dpag med 'gro ba rnams// smin cing grol bar mdzad pa de// bla ma rnams dang yi dam lha// dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad kyi// thugs dgongs rdzogs par mdzad pa lags// de yang rtag tu de ltar zhu// yi ge mi 'khyams pa yi rten// kha che gur gum zho yi grangs// sum cu rtsa lnga 'bul zhing mchis// rlung zhes bya bas las kun byed// 'di ni rnam shes bzhon pa ste// lnga yi bdag nyid bcu ming can// bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa de// khyed ri khrod pa yis go lags sam// gzhan dag kha sna gnyis nas rngub// nged kyi pa pha rin po ches// bu ga dgu nas rngub pa'i tshul// bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa de// khyed mkhan slob gnyis kyi go lags sam// ༈ //rnal 'byor dbang phyug 'byung seng ba// sgrub pa tshul bzhin mdzad par zhu// khyim dang 'dre ba mi mdzad par// ri khrod dgon par gcig 'dug bya// de yi ming ni seṅge yin// mi yi seṅge gangs la gnas// gangs khrod dgon dang mi 'bral zhu// ༈ //lho phyogs dpal gyi ri bo la// pha bram ze chen po sa ra ha// mi nged kyang de yi rjes su zhugs// khyed kyang de yi drung du 'dong*// 'bri gung dpal gyi nags khrod na// chos rje dpal ldan rin po che// mi nged kyang de yi rjes su zhugs// khyed kyang de yi drung du 'dong*//

// 519) ༄// bla ma'i mtshan thos pas dbus su byon lam du snyan tshig keng shu 'dab ma'i gdung 'bod// 'khor ba'i 'dam nas sgrol mdzad bla ma rin chen dang*// dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la spyi bos 'dud// gcig pu gnyis su med par dgon pa ri khrod du// g.yo med lhag pa'i bsam pas des ni sgrub pa byas// bsod nams mthu yis de yi bsgrubs pa'i 'bras bu sad// rtag tu ngu la de bzhin gshegs pas lung bstan ltar// dge ba'i bshes las bla ma rin chen mtshan thos pas// keng shu'i 'dab ltar snying ni shin tu rab tu g.yos// gdong nas mchi ma'i rgyun ni brub cing 'dzag par gyur// smyos pa'i mi ltar ngag gis bla brdol sna tshogs smra// gdung ba'i sems la tshugs pa med par 'o dod 'bod// lus dang srog la blta ba'i blo ni ma byung ste// sdug cing 'phongs pa'i dus su grogs po gnyis kyis bskyangs// bla mas bcings pa'i yid can mtshan mo'i dus kyi tshe// nub kyi phyogs su kha bltas song bar gyur pa las// zla ba'i dkyil 'khor mkha' la gsal zhing mdzes pa mthong*// zla ba 'di yis 'jig rten mgon po mthong gyur pas// re lta dga' ste bdag gis mthong bar ma gyur snyam// snying ni mya ngan gyis gdungs dud mo'i sgra skad shor// nor bzang yid 'phrog tshol ba'i rnam par thar pa dran// yang yang zla bar bltas nas gdung ba'i smre sngags kyis// khyod kyis bdag gi bla ma dam pa mthong ngam zhes// rab tu ma bzod dri ba yang dang yang du dris// zla nya rgyu skar rgyal po mtshan mo gsal mdzad kye// khyod ni snar ma'i mig tu sdug pa ded dpon bzang*// ci ga bdag gi sdug pa utpal lta bu'i mig /yid 'phrog ces bgyi khyod kyis sa steng gzigs lags sam// de skad smras nas sngon gyi dga' ba dran gyur cing*// song bas ri dwags mo zhig mthong bas des smras pa// kye ma ri dwags mo khyod rtswa chu lo ma za// khyod ni legs gyur bder spyod bdag ni rngon pa min// ri dwags mo ltar mig dkyus ring ba gzugs bzang ba// bdag gi yid 'phrog ma zhes bya ba mthong gyur tam// de nas song ste me tog mdzes pa'i snying po la// bung ba gnag par mthong nas de la 'di skad smras// kye ma'o sbrul nag shing lo lta bur lce g.yo zhing*// mig dang kha yi nang nas dud pa'i tshig 'byin pa// khyod kyi gdug pa'i me dang 'dod chags mer mi mtshungs// bdag gi yid 'phrog zhes bya khyod kyis mthong gyur tam// de nas song ste khu byug gcig gis ā 'byin thos// gdung ba'i yid kyis khu byug de la 'di skad smras// kye ma khu byug tshal mchog ljon shing la gnas pa// 'dab chags tshogs kyi bud med yid 'phrog ma// utpal sngon po lta bu dri med mdzes pa'i mig

/bdag gi yid 'phrog ma zhes bya ba mthong gyur tam// de ltar song ba las ni shing mchog mya ngan 'tshang*// me tog rgyas pa mthong nas de la 'di skad smras// ming gi rnam grangs bkra shis zhes bya ba// ljon pa rnams kyi rgyal po cher gyur pa// yid 'phrog mya ngan gyis ni slong ba dag /thal mo sbyar na khyod kyi mya ngan songs// de ni de ltar rim gyis song zhing song ba las// drang srong bsti gnas phyin nas drang srong de la smras// bzod 'phags gos su shing shun dang ni g.yang gzhi bsnams// rtsa ba myu gu skyu ru bil ba ka pid gsol// drang srong mgos btud phyag 'tshal bdag gi yid 'phrog ma// khyod kyis gzigs sam khyod ni bdag la myur du gsungs// // 520) ༄// 'bri thel du yon bdag gi bde sdug khod snyoms sogs kyi las bya zhal bkod gnang ba// oṃ swasti/ mgon po rin chen yi dam dkon mchog dang*// chos skyong dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams kyis// sgrub pa po rnams bde legs rgyas gyur cig /ri khrod pa rnams yar lam mar lam lo re// ri khrod du mos gus can rnams gtser ba'i lo re ba'i ri khrod kyis dgos pa med/ ma tha na yang*/ lo lnga lnga sdod pa'i dam bca' can rnams ri la song*/ ri khrod du rnyed pa ma 'tshol/ bsod snyoms gyis/ dad 'bul cis kyang len dgos pa byung na/ ri khrod pa kho rang gi ka cas ri khrod pa rang skyong ba dang*/ drag shos slob ma skyong ba ma gtogs pa'i ka ca drung du ma 'ong*/ thag ring gi jo bo rje sgo ba dang*/ yon bdag jo dge lta bu rnams kyis ri khrod pa lo gsum yan chad sgrub pa snying por byed pa rnams skyong ba ma gtogs pa/ nga'i drung du ka ca dang 'bul ba mi gtong ba ri khrod pa rnams kyi gdams pa'o// ༈ //dgra bcom pa zag pa zad pa ma gtogs pa/ sprang sprong kham rlung 'tshal ba rnams kyang*/ thos bsam zla ba nya ba'i bstan rtsas kyang*/
