spong bar mi nus de la ci bya ang*/ chang dang g.yag shi breng chad/ zla ba re re'i nya la las pas/ gso sbyong gi dus su/ gling gseb dang bla dbye thang legs par nyul nas/ chang dang*/ bud med dang*/ mi rgod dang*/ sdig pa byed pa thams cad bcas khrims kyi thog tu tshar gcod pa rtag tu bya/ dge 'dun la rgyags 'gyed pa la/ che ba dang chung ba dang*/ 'gyed pa dang mi 'gyed pa dang*/ 'gyed pa'i dus tshod/ bdag rang gi bla ma'i las yin pas bla ma 'ba' zhig gis bya/ 'gar ba lha bzo/ bud med/ mi rgod/ chang dang lnga'i bya ba dge 'dun dang las pas bya ra bya/ spyi'i yon bdag pa rnams kyi bde sdug dang*/ phan gnod dang*/ khod snyoms pa thams cad/ rin chen dbang phyug dang*/ dge bshes snya dang*/ dbang she gsum pos bya// // 521) ༄// gnyis med zung 'jug lhan skyes ni sna tshogs cir yang snang ba seng ge ye shes bya ba// na mo ratna gu ru/ khams gsum 'khor ba'i sems can rnams// rtog gnyis cig car mi 'jug ste// nyon mongs rnam rtog gang byung gi /rjes su 'brangs pa'i lus ngag las// 'bras bu sdug bsngal phung po ni// gcig tu nges te mang po min// bsam gtan thob pa yid kyi lus// zhi gnas de yi rjes 'brangs nas// sna tshogs rdzu 'phrul ston pa yin// bsam pa'i 'phen pa gang btang bas// de ltar 'gyur gyi gzhan du min// byang chub sems dpa' bdag nyid che// gnyis med don rtogs rnal 'byor pa// gnyis su med pa'i bdag rkyen dang*// byang chub sems kyi rten 'brel gyis// gnyis med zung 'jug lhan skyes ni// khams gsum sems can thams cad la// sna tshogs cir yang snang ba yin// gzung 'dzin gnyis snang rtog pa yi// lag rjes ngo mtshar mi che 'am// gzhan yang thub pa'i sku gsung thugs// mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo ni// byang chub sems gnyis dbyer med pa// gzung 'dzin yod med spros dang bral// byang chub sems gnyis rang sar dag

/chos sku bde ba chen po ni// 'khor 'das kun la cir yang snang*// mthar thug rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'di// e ma ngo mtshar mi che 'am// rje rin po che yi zhabs tog tu// phyar ba'i yol ba 'dzin 'dzin nas// dam chos 'dzin pa'ang ma khom mo// bla ma'i nye gnas yin pas chog /ri pa'i yang rtse yin pas chog /nam zla ji ltar byas kyang phyir// nga rang gang yin zer tsam na// dpal seṅge ye shes bya ba yin// de go 'am rtogs sam grogs po kun// // 522) ༄// tshul khrims ni stobs bcu'i spyod yul yin pas tshig bcad gnyis don bstan pa// tshul khrims kyis ni zhi ba 'dod rnams 'phags par gyur// stobs bcu'i spyod yul gnas shing tshul khrims nyams pa med// ces gsungs pa'i don/ tshul khrims kyi sdom pa des/ zhi ba 'dod pa gang yin pa dang*/ de ji ltar du 'phags par 'gyur ba/ zhi ba 'dod pa nyan thos/ rang sangs rgyas dang*/ mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa/ 'phags pa 'dod pa'i tshul lugs/ bsam pa de'i tshul khrims kyi stobs des/ gong nas gong du khyad par du 'phags par gyur cing de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sangs rgyas// // 523) ༄// chos rje rin po che'i zhal gdams dang gsung phrin dum bu gnyis// oṃ swasti/ rnal 'byor pa rnams kyi so nam gnyis ni/ yang na sgom pa yin/ yang na tshogs skyong ba yin pa la tshogs pa skyong ba'i zhu ba 'bul ba lags/ tshogs pa skyong ba la 'bul ba ni med/ gtong ba mang na grwa ba mi skyongs/ bar dpang dang mdun ma dris na grwa pa'i chos mi smar/ byas pa don med la tshig pa za nas 'gro bar 'ong*// grwa pa la byams pa nyung*/ sdang ba mang na yul du mi chags/ nyes pa'i skyon gsum po 'di med na 'das mchod kyi rting la de gzod nged kyis zhu 'bul// ༈ //de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan pa thog ma dang bar dang mtha' mar dge ba yin/ de 'dzin par byed pa theg pa chen po dge ba'i bshes gnyen rgya mtsho lta bu yin/

chos de nyams su len pa la dngos grub rnam pa gsum 'byung ba yin/ bdag gi bla ma dam pa de/ bdag la drin shin tu che ba'i ngos nas/ drin lan du thugs kyi dgongs pa 'ba' zhig bsgrub pa'i bsam pa byung ba la/ bdag nyid chen po de nyid la dbus gtsang gi bla ma rnams la su dang mi 'dra ba'i zhabs tog chen po re mdzad pa'i thugs kyis/ mi nyag gi rgyal khams su bzhud pa thugs kyi dgongs pa dang*/ rdzas yo byad kyi zhabs tog thugs tshim par mdzad pa mnga' bar gda' bas/ thugs kyi dgongs pa rdzogs pa'i ched du zhabs tog de byed par 'dod pa dang*/ nga'i bla ma'i bla ma yin no byas pa drin tu gzo ba'i ngos nas dbang zhu bgyis pa las/ bdag gis gong du dbang ma thob pa yang ma lags/ da na so rgas shi khar phyin pa'i dus su dbang bskur ba dang*/ rgyud dang gdams ngag zhu mi khom/ dben pa'i gnas su shi kha'i gdams ngag bsgom dgos pa lags pa dang*/ rnam pa gnyis su byas na rang nyid kyi bla ma gong ma la yar nyams myong gi tshig ya zung yod pa snyan du mi gsol ba'i dam bca' yod pa dang*/ yang rnam pa gsum du na/ deng sang grags pa nam mkha'i 'brug bas che yang bza' rgyu til gyi 'bru bas chung*/ tshur byung ba la gtags nas phar gtong dgos par 'dug pas/ 'bul rgyu dang zhabs tog bya rgyu ma mchis pa la bka' mi bkyon par zhu/ dge bshes sa skya ba la dbang zhu gsungs pas phyis khong gis der 'ong khyed bzhed pa'i chos kyang bya zer ba la/ yar yi ge bskur ba// // 524) ༄// nye gnas rin chen grags gdung sbyang dus gsungs pa'i mgur rten phyags steng kha ma// dpal phag mo gru pa'i zhabs la 'dud// bu nyon dang gson dang rin chen grags// kwa cis kyang mi phan 'chi bar nges// 'jig rten gyi bya bzhag kyang rdzun por gda'// chos brgyad 'ja' tshon gyi ri mo la// blo gtad 'dug gam mi 'dug soms// 'dus nas 'bral ba mthong tsam na// gnyen nye drung gi gdung sems kyang rdzun por gda'// snying gtam brag cha lta bu la// blo gtad 'dug gam mi 'dug soms// lus 'byung bzhi'i dar rgud mthong tsam na// sgyu shed dang dpa' rtsal yang rdzun por gda'// lang tsho ston ka'i me tog la// blo gtad 'dug gam mi 'dug soms// nor bsags nas 'dzad pa mthong tsam na// ser sna dang sdug gsog kyang rdzun por gda'// zas nor rtswa kha'i zil pa la// blo gtad 'dug gam mi 'dug soms// skye 'chi'i sdug bsngal mthong tsam na// lha mi'i bde skyid kyang rdzun por gda'// skyid sdug srid pa'i 'khor lo la// blo gtad 'dug gam mi 'dug soms// pha byang chub sems kyi sdong po la// gdul bya'i phyogs ris kyang rdzun por gda'// yul ngan sdig pa'i grogs po la// blo gtad 'dug gam mi 'dug soms// sems can pha mar shes tsam na// rang gces 'dzin gyi zhe 'dod kyang rdzun por gda'// sgos so thar nyan thos kyi theg pa la// blo gtad 'dug gam mi 'dug soms// las rgyu 'bras la nges shes skyes tsam na// chos byar med kyi kha lta yang rdzun por gda'// 'brug char med kyi kha lta rkyang pa la// blo gtad 'dug gam mi 'dug soms// nyams byin rlabs su ldan pa'i bla ma la// bdud bar chad dang gol sa yang rdzun por gda'// tshig rgyud ne tso'i 'don pa la// blo gtad 'dug gam mi 'dug soms// rang sems mngon du gyur tsam na// grangs med gsum yang rdzun por gda'// drang don theg pa'i mgo skor la// blo gtad 'dug gam mi 'dug soms// rdzun glu ring mo zhes bya ba// rten phyags steng khar mdzad pa rdzogs so//

// 525) ༄// deng sang dus kyi rdo rje gdan zhes spun mched bzhi la gdams pa'i gsung mgur// deng sang dus kyi rdo rje gdan// 'bri gung dpal gyi dgon pa 'dir// pha chos rje bla ma rin chen gyis// nged bu spun bzhi la 'di skad gdams// ji ltar bung ba mkhas pa yis// me tog mdangs la ma gnod par// sbrang rtsi blangs nas mkha' la 'phur// de bzhin thub pa'i sras rnams kyang*// 'gro ba'i lus ngag yid gsum gyi// nyes pa'i skyon tshogs ma mthong bar// yon tan blangs nas rnam par grol// // 526) ༄// rin po che yi gces se ang zhes pa'i zhal gdams gsung mgur dum bu gsum//

chos kyi rgyal po rin po che// rin po che yi gces se ang*// mtshan snyan bkra shis rin chen gyis// khyed kyi chab la ma gsol lam// bzang ngan 'bring gsum dus gsum mthas// legs par bsgrub pa go ched yin// bdag dang 'khor 'das chos shes pas// snying por sgrub na spyang po yin// dgos pa'i mdo don shor ba la// 'jig rten 'di na glen pa zer// ༈ //ma ga dha yi glang po che// shin tu zab pa'i dam chos de// ya ta ma ri mang pos bkab// ji ltar chu la chu bzhag dang*// ji ltar mar la mar bzhag dang*// dge 'dun khyim du spyan drongs la// thugs dam 'phel bar mdzad par zhu// ༈ //sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che'i rtsod lugs tha dad pa'i ngos nas/ bla ma rin po che'i bstan pa la sdang ba'i dgra/ gnod pa'i bgegs bde ba dang ldan/ sdug bsngal dang bral/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par byed pa de sangs rgyas rin po che'i bstan pa yin/ gnod pa las bzlog phan pa la sbyor ba de 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po'i khrims yin/ the'u rang gi nang khrims/ bdud kyi spyod pa/ dmyal bar 'gro ba'i gting rdo/ rang gi nye ris dang yul phyogs su dmag 'dren/ phung brlag byed pa de yin pas/ bla ma rin po che'i bstan pa khyod la gtad do// bdud dang the'u brang gi bstan pa ma mdzad cig/ // 527) ༄// yig nag la re na rnal 'byor 'khrul zhes pa'i zhal gdams gsung mgur// da dus bstan pa'i snyigs ma la// gtso bo shākya seṅge yi// bstan pa mar 'grib snga rtags su// bsod nams bsags pa'i gang zag nyung*// blo chos la 'gro ba'i skyes bu dkon// ngur smrig gon pa'i jag pa mang*// za 'dod mchil pa gzan la dga'// chos brgyad mdza' mo don du gnyer// tshe phyi ma yal bar dor ba des// des na phal dang gros mi bstun// sprang po rang dbang rang gis byed// byang chub sgrub par blo thag chod// lus dang longs spyod thams cad dang*// dus gsum dge rtsa ci yod pa// ltos med sems can don du bsngo// bdud rtsi lnga yi rten 'brel de// rtsa rlung gnad du ma shes na// re dogs byas na bar chad 'jug

/spros pa'i sgro 'dogs nang nas chod// sems nyid mdo 'grel chen por go /yig nag la re na rnal 'byor 'khrul// rnal 'byor pha las bu yis byed// tshe gcig lus gcig 'di nyid la// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bsgrub pa la// gsang sngags zab mo'i lam la zhugs// rje rin po che dang zhu thug byas// bar do rnam gsum 'phrang sgugs la// mchog gi sangs rgyas mi re lags// de thugs la 'dogs te shin tu legs// // 528) ༄// bu la gsungs pa'i gdams ngag ya ta ma re mang ba zhes pa dum bu gnyis// ji ltar rgya mtshor chu rnams ro gcig ltar// de bzhin chos sku sems su dbyer med de// bya byed spros pa'i tshogs rnams nye bar zhi// 'dom dgu rlung gi rkyen gyis g.yo ba ltar// phyi rol rkyen ngor lus sems rnam par shes// bla ma'i drin thob 'phags pa'i rnal 'byor pa// skyes pa de nyid skye ba med rtogs pas// stong nyid rgyu 'bras mi g.yo sa gnas dang*// rgyal ba kun gyi spyod yul snang ba'i rgyan// sku gsung thugs nyid mi zad gter gyi rgyu// kye kye 'khor nyid bla med byang chub nyid// byang chub de nyid 'khor ba yongs su 'dzin// ༈ //phyag 'tshal 'dud cing phyag 'tshal 'dud// phyag 'tshal phyag 'tshal phyag 'tshal 'dud// gnyis med bde chen he ru kaḥ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro tshogs bcas 'dud// 'das dang ma 'ongs da ltar dang*// phyogs bcu ma lus thams cad kyi// ji snyed sems can thams cad pa// phan dang bde bas smin mdzad cing*// nyes pa'i tshogs rnams bcom nas kyang*// gnas skabs mthar thug thams cad kyi// 'bras bu ma lus stsol mdzad pa// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro nyid yin zhes// rdo rje 'dzin pas gang gsungs pa// bla ma dam pa'i bka' drin gyis// brtse bas khyed la bshad par bya// 'jig rten bya byed las rnams dang*// phyi rol mu stegs byed rnams kyi// drang srong rdzu 'phrul can rnams dang*// 'phags pa nyan thos rang sangs rgyas// sa dang lam la gnas pa yi// byang chub sems dpa' bdag nyid che// skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyis// gnas skabs mthar thug thams cad kyi// yon tan ma lus ji snyed pa// dpa' chen thabs kyi sbyor bas 'grub// skyon dag yon tan rab rdzogs pa// dpa' chen thabs kyi sbyor ba 'di// e ma ngo mtshar rmad byung ba// bu gcig khyed la bstan par bya// med kyang ku re bgyis pa lags// rmongs pa'i 'jig rten phal pa rnams// sdang ba'i dgra dang 'thab pa rnams// dang po rang nyid rgyal 'dod pas// bu dang chung ma gnyen 'dun dang*// rdzas dang yo byad thams cad kyis// yul ris rgyal khams srid du bcad// srid ris dmag dang bcas pa rnams// phan tshun g.yul du 'thab pa'i tshe// gong ma bya byed thams cad kyis// bsgrub pa'i 'bras bu dus 'dir yin// dus gcig dpa' bo gcig pu yis// g.yul phur btsugs nas 'thab pa'i tshe// yab mes gong mas bzhag pa yi// khrab rnying druub zhub mig snang de// rang gi lus la ma bgos na// dpa' yang rang srog chad pa yin// gdug pa'i ral gris ma chod kyang*// dus 'dir 'byin pa'i dus tshod yin// gong du sa rdo shing gsum la// 'debs grangs mang ba'i ral gris kyang*// dus 'dir dgra bo mi sod pas// chud ma zos pa'i ral gri des// snying stobs chen po'i brtson 'grus kyis// dmag dpon chen po ske bcad nas// rang phyogs dgra la rgyal ba 'di// pha zhe sdang can gyi rnam 'gyur gyis// bu glen pa rnams la smras pa yin// a khu spyang po rang 'dod can// dang po 'thab kyang mi rtsom ste// bar du g.yul du mi 'jug cing*// zhugs kyang wa braus byed pa la// go dang ral gri'i sbyor ba yis// gzhan la 'thab pa'i gnyer ka med//

༈ //da ni mkha' 'gro dbang phyug bshad// ma dbyings phyug rdo rje'i mkha' 'gro ma// mkha' la 'gro zhing gdug pa 'dul// dam las mi 'da' rnal 'byor skyong*// ma bas byams shing sring bar gdung*// mdza' mo bzhin du yid du 'ong*// 'di ni rdo rje'i ḍā ki ma// med kyang ku re bgyis pa lags// rang sems smra bsam brjod med 'di// dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi yum// byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi ma// nyan thos rang rgyal 'byin byed cing*// bde skyid kun 'byung ma ma mchog /a phyi chen mo sham sham mo// yang phyi chen mo 'jol 'jol mo// 'di ni mkha' 'gro'i dbang phyug mchog /dngos kun sems nyid nam mkha' la// 'gro 'ong med pa'i shugs kyis 'gro// 'di ni rdo rje'i mkha' 'gro yin// de ltar dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dang*// bu skad cig tsam yang ma 'bral dang*// gsang sngags rdo rje'i theg pa yi// lde mig lag tu phyin nas mchi// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i man ngag ni// skyob pa rdo rje 'chang chen gyis// kla klo'i skad du bshad pa ltar// rang gi rigs las byung gyur cing*// bsam pa gcig tu gyur pa yi// bu la smras pa'i gdams ngag 'di// ya ta ma ri mang na yang*// mang la 'brel ba'i gdams ngag gi /gnyer ka rnal 'byor pa la med// rdzogs so// // 529) ༄// gegs sel nad bcos kyi zhal gdams bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen la springs pa// oṃ swasti/ bkra shis par gyur cig bla ma rin po ches/ bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen la spring ba/ 'grul la smras pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan pa rin po che'i zhabs 'bring dang zhabs tog rgya chen po mdzad cing*/ rang gzhan thams cad kyi nor bu rin po che dbang gi rgyal po lta bur gyur pa la bdag kyang rjes su yi rang zhing mchis/ slad kyi don zhu ba/ khyed kyi sku khams phra mo de sgom skyon phran tshegs lags te/ de skyed par byed pa'i rgyu ni/

sems kyi thugs khral en cig mang la/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i blo mang po dang*/ smin mtshams bsdus nas bla ma la mos gus kyi gdung ba tung tung ba'i shugs bskyed pa dang*/ bla ma spyi bor bsgoms pa las gyur pa lags/ rtags ni sgom chen pa la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pa'i zhal mthong ba dang*/ nyams mtho dman rnam pa sna tshogs pa skye 'ong*/ tha mal ba la klu dang rgyal bsen gyi cho 'phrul cher 'ong*/ de dag byung yang rtsa rlung gi rten 'brel ma gtogs pa/ phan dgos pa dang gnod pa skyel ba'i lha 'dre gang yang ma lags/ de la rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba'i gnad gcig pu ma shes na/ sha ri rab tsam zos/ chang rgya mtsho tsam 'thung*/ mi ro ril mid byas kyang*/ rlung ma lags pas mi phan/ mthu bo che brgya bsags/ rnga rdung stong gis bskor yang*/ 'dre nad ma lags pas mi phan/ lha rje brgya bsags/ rtsags thogs stong gis bskor yang*/ sman nad ma lags pas mi phan/ de la rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba rnam pa gsum ste/ phyi rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba sa'i 'og 'dom dgu'am/ lnga'am/ gsum mam/ gcig gi sa nas phyung ba'i rdo leb mthug srab sor bzhi yod pa'i rgya che chung rkang pa'i tshod tsam/ res 'ga' de'i dugs bya ba dang*/ mar rnying dang*/ tshil rny-ing*/ tshil chen po/ rkang rnying shin tu bcud che bas rkang pa'i thil la byugs pa nan tan shin tu che bar yang dang yang du bya ba dang*/ nang rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba lte ba'i 'og sor bzhi'i gnas na rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa bsam zhing*/ de'i sku las gser gyi rdo rje rtse dgu pa sbom phra rang gi rked pa'i tshad tsam zhig 'og sa'i gzhi mi bsam bar nam mkha' la thug pa med pa la/ dang po 'dom dgu tsam du gsal bar dmigs/ de gsal nas mthur la mar je ring je ring la/ 'og gi nam mkha' la thug pa med pa la si ri ri 'gro bar dmigs nas/

de la ma yengs par yun ring du bsgom/ de nas rnam par rtog pa ma langs kyi bar du/ de nyid la shes pa ma yengs par gsal na gsal ba'i ngang la bzhag mi gsal na mi gsal ba'i ngang la gzhag dmigs pa rang gi lus la yar ye mi bzhug dma' ba la mi yengs pa gnad yin pas gal che/ gsang ba rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba lus gnad la zer ba lags te/ 'di'i lus kyi 'khrul 'khor ni/ rkang pa dkyil mo krung lhod par bya ba dang*/ lag pa brla steng du lag mthil mar bstan nas/ bde bar bzhag pa dang*/ rked pa shin tu drang bar bya zhing ro stod dgye bar bya ba dang*/ mig btsum pa dang 'byed pa dmigs pa gnad du gang 'gro bltas la bya'o// nyin mtshan kha sbyor du skad cig kyang ma yengs par bsgom pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis/ ma nus shing shin tu dub par gyur na/ mal shin tu ring ba ro stod cung zhig mtho ba byin gyis gzhol ba'i steng du/ lus phyi gan du rkang pa brkyang*/ lus thang chod par nyal la/ lag pa gnyis brla rtsa na mar ci bder bzhag bla ma lte ba'i 'og tu bsgoms nas/ de'i sku las me rked pa tsam byung nas sgal tshigs mar zad gyi rtse mo'i thad so na mar la rim gyis je ring je ring la 'dom sum cu rtsa gsum tsam mar 'bar ba'i me'i rtse mor sems bzung*/ gong 'og gi dmigs pa thur la 'gro ba dka' bar byung na/ 'og sgo'i dri ma btsir ba bzhin du mar la phul la btang des ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin du 'ong*/ lar 'di'i rgyu mtshan dmigs pa mthos pas shes pa mthos pa/ rnam rtog mang ba gyen la 'gro ba'i nyes dmigs lags pas/ de rnams spang ba gal che/ de rnams kyi gnyen po mtha' dag gis phan/ rten 'brel tshogs pa 'di rnams kyis// myur du phan par 'gyur ba yin// rten 'brel sgrub pa'i dus tshod du// nyams dga' yid 'ong brang khang du// mthun pa'i rdzas dang yo byad bsags// skye bo zang zing rgyu 'grul bcad// nyam nga bag tsha spangs pa yi// lus sems glod pas 'grub pa yin// phan par gyur cig/

// 530) ༄// zhal gdams kyi rim pa bsod snyoms pa shes rab 'byung gnas la gnang ba// oṃ swasti/ bla ma rin po ches/ nga'i bu rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug la gdams pa/ sku khams de la dang po kho nar lam du btang ba dang*/ byang chub kyi sems dang*/ yi dam gyi lha shin tu gsal bar bsgom la/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yum shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma bzhugs pa'i gnas der/ bla ma dam pa'i sku che chung sor bzhi tsam zhig bsgom/ de la dran pa ma yengs par nan tan chen po bskyed/ skabs skabs su bsngo ba la 'bad/ tshegs med pa lags so// ༈ //'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad rang gi sems yin/ sems de ye nas skye ba med par rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa/ dus thams cad du rtag pa de la shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zer/ byang chub kyi sems dang yi dam gyi lha/ bla ma dam pa dang bcas pa bsgom pa dang*/ lus ngag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba/ bya ba dang byed pa byed tshad bsngo ba dang bcas pa de la thabs zhes zer/ de la cig car phan par 'dod pa'i bsam pas/ thabs 'ba' zhig la/ char gcig dang nyar gcig bsgrim na yang ma bde bar 'gyur/ shes rab 'ba' zhig bsgom na yang mi bde bar 'gyur bas/ thabs bsgoms pas ma bde na shes rab bsgom/ shes rab bsgoms pas ma bde na thabs bsgom/ gnyis ka ma bde na bskyur la bzhag de kho na bzhin du nyams su blangs par zhu/ thugs dam de nyid du dgyes pa lags/ dang po kho nar lus ngag yid gsum gyi bya ba dang byed pa/ bla ma dam pa rnams dang*/ dge 'dun la tshogs gsog pa thams cad/ 'jig rten gyi chos brgyad/ 'khor ba'i rgyu dang 'bras bu/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi bsam pa skad cig kyang ma skyes par/ byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems kyi rjes su 'brangs nas/ yi dam gyi lha dang*/ bla ma dam pas rgyud sbyangs nas bya byed thams cad bya/ yang dang yang du bsngo ba la 'bad/ sku khams de la dbang gi rgyal po bdag nyid chen po'i gsang gnas su bsgom pa la ma yengs pas phan pa yin/

nad drag po ma rungs pa yun ring du na ba la/ phyi dang nang du babs 'ong bar 'dug pas/ de'i babs de nang du glo ba la byung ba lags/ de la bcos kyi thabs/ sngon 'gro rnams gong du song bas/ lus kyi 'khrul 'khor dkyil mo krung legs par bca'/ cung zad rim gyis rim gyis lus shin tu dgye bar byas pas/ rgyab kyi sgal pa 'bur po nang du chud/ glo ba de nad yod pas de yang rang babs su 'ong*/ de nas gar na ba'i sa der/ yi ge hūm̐ gang rung thig le'i rang bzhin dkar la 'tsher ba/ bde ba'i rang bzhin bde ba chen po rang du bsgom la dran pa ma yengs par bya/ de ltar yun ring du bsgoms pas je bde je bder 'ong*/ bsngo ba dang sems bskyed/ bden pa'i byin rlabs rnam pa lnga la 'bad pa gal che/ dang po byang chub kyi sems dang*/ yi dam gyi lha dang*/ bla ma bsgom/ de nas phyag rgya chen po'i ngang las yi dam gyi lha gsal bar bsgoms la/ yun ring du gsal bar bsgom/ shin tu gsal ba'i dus gcig tu/ nad de'i nang du yi ge hūm̐ mthing nag me sor gcig 'bar bzhin pa dang bcas pa gcig bsgom/ de la sems ma yengs par nyin mtshan kha sbyar la bsgom/ mtshams dam par bya/ skabs skabs su bsngo ba dang sems bskyed/ ting nge 'dzin la ma yengs par bya/ nan tan chen pos nyams su blangs na myur du drag pa la tshegs med/ khyod rang gi snga ma ji ltar nyams su blangs pa de ma 'chugs pa sha stag tu gda'/ de la bde ba de yang res bde res mi bde bar 'ong*/ dge sbyor la 'bad pa chen po yun ring du byas pa'i rjes la/ res bde res mi bde ba 'ong*/ de yang dge sbyor byas pa'i dus su ma bde na cung zad glod/ glod pa'i dus su ma bde na dge sbyor bya/ de ltar yun ring du bsrings pas/ bde ba yun je ring*/ bde ba brtan pa'i dus su mtshams phye bas chog pa yin/ tshod 'dzin mkhan po kun na re/ zhag bzhi bcu lhag bde na mtshams bton pas chog pa yin zer/

kha cig na re mar 'byang ba byung na/ de phan pa'i rtags che shos yin bya bar gda'/ mdor bsdus na/ dge sbyor byed mi byed kyi rim pa rang gi byed pa yin/ bsngo ba dang sems bskyed shin tu gal che/ ji ltar bsgoms pa'i yi dam gyi lha de'i sku lus la me 'bar bas/ bshang lam gyi thad so na mar me 'dom bdun gy-i bar du 'bar ba'i rtse mo la sems gtad/ gsal na gsal ba'i ngang la bzhag mi gsal na mi gsal ba'i ngang la bzhag ma yengs pa gal che/ des kha gdong la sogs pa'i skyon thams cad dag nas mchi/ sku khams la phan pa'i dmigs pa/ snga ma'i dge sbyor de kho na la 'bad/ lag pa gnyis brla rtsa na mar bzhag nad dang gnod pa sdug bsngal dang*// snang srid 'khor 'das thams cad kun// rang gi sems su go gyur cing*// de nyid skye med chos kyi sku// mthar thug phyag rgya chen po yin// de nyid rtag tu nyams su blang*// sems bskyed bsngo ba shin tu gces// yul phyogs de na nad thams cad dug tu ngos bzung nas nyes par 'gyur ba shin tu mang bar 'dug ste/ khyed kyi de de ma lags/ thugs dam la brtson par mdzad pa gcig pus chog de'i thugs dam gyi bya thabs ni/ pho ba'i nang du bla ma bsgom pa la nan tan shin tu che bar bya/ des nad gang yin yang bshal ba'am skyug pa 'ong*/ skyugs pa mi dga' bshal ba dgyes pa yin/ bshal 'don pa'i thabs la/ yar skyugs la khad pa'i dus su/ mar mnan nas/ srin po'i zhal la sems gtad pas 'byang nas 'ong*/ de'i don grub pa dang bla ma lte ba'i 'og tu yun ring du bsgoms nas/ phyag rgya chen po'i ngang la gtad/ de gcig pus chog grib tshan che rab kyis phog pa yin pas/ grib sel gyi gzungs chog dang*/ ku sā li'i tshogs gsog dang*/ tsha tsha 'debs pa la sogs pa thams cad kyis phan/ nang gi ting nge 'dzin gyi mdzad pa/ jo bo thugs rje chen po bsgom pa shin tu yang phan/ lam du gtong ba dang*/

sems bskyed pa la nan tan che bar mdzad/ lar nad tshabs che ba'i dus su/ phyi'i dge sbyor gyi stobs la gnas pa/ nang phyag rgya chen po'i rtsol ba glod pa gal che bar gda'/ ngas kyang 'di nas sku'i rim gro dang gsol ba gdab par bgyi/ spyir nad kyi tshan pa gang yin yang*/ nang gi rdo rje lus kyi gnas lugs 'chugs pa las 'byung bas/ rtsi sman gang gis kyang phan par dka' ba yin/ de la dang por lam du gtong*/ sems bskyed/ lus yi dam gyi lhar bsgom/ bla ma lte ba'i 'og tu yun ring du bsgom/ de'i rjes la 'og sgo 'byed 'dzum lan bdun byas la/ mar phul la bshang lam gyi khar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor che chung mtho gang tsam/ dmar la zlum pa las me lce'am/ 'od shin tu tsha la rtsub pa 'dom gang tsam thur la 'bar ba'i rtse mo la sems gtad/ bshang lam nas me 'bar ba gnad yin/ snying kha yan chod du dmigs pa bsgom pa dang*/ rtag tu dkyil krung dang tsog pu byed pa mi mthun pa'i phyogs yin/ de ltar yun ring du bsgoms pas lus po brtas/ dang kha bde/ nad dang bral nas/ 'di la yon tan dpag tu med pa 'byung*/ res 'ga' lte ba'i 'og tu bla ma'i sku las ye shes kyi bdud rtsi 'bri mar gyi mar khu khol ba lta bu bab pas/ de thams cad gang bar yang bsam/ sems ting nge 'dzin la ma yengs par bya/ dge ba'i rtsa ba bsngo ba yang yang bya/ bslu ba med pa yin no// bden pa'i byin rlabs rnam pa lnga la gnas te/ sgal tshigs mar ded kyi rtse mo gser gyi rdo rje mtho gang ba gcig gi rtse mor/ yi ge hūm̐ dmar nag mtho gang ba mgo mthur la bltas pa gcig la/ me lce khru gang 'bar ba la sems gtad/ mtshams dam par bya/ nyin mtshan kha sbyar la bsgom/ bsngo ba dang sems bskyed gal che/ gsha' mar nyams su blangs pa'i dus su gegs 'byung*/ gegs sel na bogs thon bya ba yin pas/ shes pa la ltem rkyang med par/ zhe thag pa snying khong rus pa'i gting nas/

lam du gtang*/ sems bskyed/ lus yi dam gyi lhar bsgom/ nad kyi dngos po gang yin pa de/ bla ma dam par bsgom zhing*/ de nyid spang blang med par nyams su blang*/ rnam rtog skad cig kyang med par byas la nyin mtshan kha sbyar la de 'ba' zhig bsgom/ skabs skabs su bsngo ba la 'bad/ sku khams de la byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems bsgom/ de nas yi dam gyi lha shin tu gsal bar bsgoms la/ dbang gi rgyal po bdag nyid chen po'i gsang gnas su yun ring du bsgom/ bsngo ba bya/ bu rnal 'byor dbang phyug ri khrod pa// dus gsum rgyal ba'i gdung rgyud 'dzin// brgyud pa gong ma mnyes par byas// grub thob brgyud pa ma chad pa// thugs nas thugs su brgyud pa de// ri khrod dgon par nyams su longs// sgrub pa snying por mdzad pa zhu// dus gsum sangs rgyas chos kyi sku// chos rje bla ma rin po che// mi 'bral khyed kyi sems la bzhugs// rgyun chad med par nyams su blang*// dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad kyi// dgongs pa tshul khrims rin po che// ngo lkog med par nyams su blang*// dge ba byang chub chen por bsngo// ban dhe shes rab 'byung gnas kyis phyogs gcig tu bsdebs pa'o// ༈ //na mo ratna gu ru/ 'di ltar rab tu gnas pa gshegs su gsol ba dang*/ bkra mi shis pa bkra shis par byed pa dang*/ bdud chen po zhugs pa mi gnas par byed pa dang gsum las dang por gshegs su gsol ba ni/ bkra mi shis pa dang bgegs chen po zhugs pa gshegs su gsol ba ma yin te/ sku gsung thugs kyi rten/ 'o brgyal ba 'chos pa gshegs su gsol ba yin te/ de yang byang chub kyi sems dang*/ mchod pa 'bul ba la sogs pa sngon du 'gro bas ji ltar mi la bsgo ba bzhin du gsol ba gdab ste/ rten 'di shin tu legs par byas nas/ de nas grub pa dang byon nas bzhugs par zhu ba 'bul/ gsol ba gdab/ de'i bar du rten 'di bkra shis dang bde legs 'byung ba dang*/

bar chad mi 'byung bar byin gyis rlabs par gsol ba gdab/ gang bzhugs pa rang bzhin gyi gnas der kho rang gi tshul dang mthun pa'i gzhal yas khang gi nang du/ mchod pa'i tshogs dang bcas pa bzhugs su gsol/ rten nam tshar ba dang*/ spyan drangs nas rten la bstims pas/ rang gi gza' mi dang 'dra bar gyur ba yin/ bkra ma shis pa shis par byed pa ni/ bkra shis dang bde legs sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bzhugs pa las byung ba yin zhing*/ bkra shis pa'i sangs rgyas gshegs su gsol bas gzhan du 'ong ste/ phyi'i bkra shis sgrub pa dang*/ nang gi bkra shis dang*/ gsang ba'i bkra shis dang*/ de kho na nyid kyi bkra shis bsgrub par bya'o// de la phyi'i bkra shis ni/ gza' dang*/ tshes grangs dang*/ rgyu skar dang*/ dus kyi bkra shis pa sgrig par bya'o// nang gi bkra shis ni/ zhing dang bsam pa dang dngos po gsum gyi rten 'brel tshogs rgya chen po bsag pa'o// gsang ba'i bkra shis ni/ theg pa chen po gsang sngags kyi rtsa dang rlung dang thig le/ yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro'am/ zhing khams rnam pa lnga rgyal ba rigs lnga dang bcas par bsgrub pa'o// de kho na nyid kyi bkra shis ni/ yum chen mo shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las/ sras dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas skye ba ste/ de rnams gzhi nas bsgrub par bya ba'o// mi ma yin pa zhugs pa la rnam pa gsum ste/ dang po kho nar mi ma yin pa de la/ byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems bsgom/ rang nyid lhag pa'i lha'i nga rgyal brtan par bya/ kho rang dang mthun pa'i gtor ma byin gyis brlabs pa rnam pa lngas legs par byin gyis brlabs la 'bul/ 'dir ma bzhugs la gzhan du bzhud par bka' bsgo/ khong gi 'gro sa dang brten bca' ba/ bcom ldan 'das la shing gi lhas zhu ba 'phul ba/ 'brog gnas la shing bslangs nas/ der bzhag pa dang 'dra ba yang khong du chud par bya/ des ma nyan na mgo bskor ba ni/

slob dpon bsgom pa dang*/ slob dpon padmas lha 'dre yongs kyi glu mo che blangs pa dang 'dra bar bya ste/ 'on kyang cung zad cung zad snying rje bas/ kho'i 'dug sa rang gis bsgrub par bya ba ni gces sam snyam/ gnyis po gang gis kyang ni ma chun/ rang nyid la gdeng chen po yod na/ bcom ldan 'das khams gsum rnam par rgyal ba ltar drag pos byang chub la dgod par bya ste/ de la gsum/ bsad pa dang*/ mnan pa dang*/ gzir ba dang*/ gsum las/ bsad pa yang phun sum tshogs pa lnga/ mnan pa yang phun sum tshogs pa rnam pa lnga/ gzir ba ni tshar gcad pa ste/ 'di thams cad rjes su gzung bas bsgrub par bya'o// sku gsung thugs kyi rten la grib byung na/ rang la gnod pas/ de bsal bar bya ba'i thabs ni/ cho ga gang yang rung ba'i rjes su 'brangs pa'i sku khrus gsol te/ gsol ba'i khrus chab de sa gtsang ma'i phyogs su dbo bar bya'o gsungs/ bsod snyoms pa shes rab 'byung gnas kyis legs par zhus pa/ rdzogs so// //

531)༄// shes rab 'byung gnas kyis brnag pa bya bar gdams pa// oṃ swasti/ srid zhi nyes pa'i dgra las rnam rgyal ba// dag pa'i phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab pas// bdud dang bar chad skyon las skyob mdzad pa// dbugs 'byin mdzad pa'i mgon la spyis phyag 'tshal// dus gsum rgyal ba'i gdung rgyud 'dzin pa'i sras// sbyangs sdom brtul zhugs spyod pa'i ri khrod pa// gcig pur sgrub pa snying por byed pa'i tshe// bar chad bdud dang mi mthun nyes pa'i tshogs// phyi nang rgya mtsho'i rlabs ltar 'khrugs gyur na// sman dang sngags dang gdams ngag be'u bum dang*// lus dang srog la ltos pa spangs nas kyang*// rang byung byang chub sems kyi mthu stobs la// snying rus chen pos lceb pa'i sbyor ba yis// ma yengs brtson pas nyams su blangs gyur na// nyes tshogs las rgyal yon tan thob par nges// nan tan 'bad pa gyis shig rnal 'byor pa// nyon mongs rnam rtog 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho 'di// sems nyid spros bral chos kyi dbyings nyid du// ji bzhin gnas pa'i babs la gnas gyur na// blta dang nyan dang 'gro 'ong ma mchis par// bla ma yi dam bla med dkon mchog dang*// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs// phan dang bde ba sgrub par byed pa rnams// lus dang grib ma bzhin du bungs kyis 'ong*// phyi rol yul la ma 'tshol rnal 'byor pa// lung dang rigs pa man ngag rdo rje'i tshig /nyams rtogs gnyis med shes pa gdeng thob pa// tshad ldan bla mas nges shes bskyed pa'i tshe// shes pa'i ngar thung spobs pa thogs med pas// glang chen myos pas dgra dpung 'joms pa bzhin// nyam nga med cing thogs pa med par 'gro// de tshe ci bsam ci mno grub nas mchi// nges shes bskyed la bsgom dang rnal 'byor pa// myong ba'i brtul zhugs skyes na gzhan don 'byung*// mi chos mdun ma bya byed sna tshogs kyis// nyams rtogs ngar dang bral na srog chad de// bsnyen bkur spun bzhin rang la ma byung bas// mi chos mdun mas sbyar ba'i dogs yod do// nyams rtogs gnyis med skyongs shig rnal 'byor pa// sems kyi tha ba nyes pa'i gzhi bcom zhing*// rgyal ba'i yon tan rgya mtsho bskyed mdzad pa// bdag gi bla ma rdo rje 'chang zhabs la// gus pas phyag 'tshal rtag tu skyabs su mchi'o// rnal 'byor pa shes rab 'byung gnas kyis brnag pa bya bar gdams pa//

// 532)༄// a las g.yo ba med pa 'di gsung gi rten du mdzad par zhu zhes pa// oṃ swasti/ bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten 'di// thos dang bsam dang sgom pa rnams// byang chub sems kyis dbang mdzad nas// smin cing grol bar mdzad pa yi// dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po khyod// mos gus mdzad pa rten zhu ba// snang srid 'khor 'das ma lus kun// lhun grub chos sku 'ba' zhig tu// skyes bu chen po khyod kyis rtogs// sku 'di'i rten dang mi 'bral zhu// 'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa'i chos// a li ka li'i rten 'brel yin// a las g.yo ba med pa 'di// bdag nyid chen po khyed nyid kyis// gsung gi rten du mdzad par zhu// dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad kyis// yod dang med pa'i mtha' spangs pa// lhun grub ye shes chen po dang*// dus gsum shes bya'i dkyil 'khor rnams// gnyis med gcig tu thugs su chud// 'gyur med sems nyid rdo rje 'di// rtag tu khyod kyi thugs la bzhugs// mos gus byed pa'i rten mchog cig /da res khyed la bskur snyam pa// 'di gsum khyod kyis snoms nas gda'// da res bskur rgyu ma rnyed lags// bka' bkyon zhe bkyon mi mdzad zhu// khyed kyi bla mar mdzad pa yi// 'bri khung skyu ra smra bcad de// gsum po 'di dang mi 'bral bas// skye rga na 'chi'i sdug bsngal spangs// 'khor 'das shes bya'i dkyil 'khor dang*// dbyer med gcig tu 'dug gam snyam// khyed kyi bla ma rin chen gyi// drung du byon nas mjal ba de// khyed rang nyid dang dbyer med la// gang du phyin nas gang du btsal// de nyid gnas dang mi 'bral zhu// min kyang ku re bgyis pa lags// // 533)༄// mi ma yin gyi gnod par byang chub thugs kyi bdud rtsi'i dkar gtor 'byin pa// oṃ swasti/ grags pa'i dbang phyug dpal ldan 'gro ba'i mgon// yon tan 'byung gnas nor bu rin po che// 'khor ba'i tshad pa sel ba'i ma ghi ta/ gla rtsi ghi wang gi ming*// bla ma khyed kyi zhabs la gtsug gis 'dud// slob dpon pa'i sku khams de rgyu phrag dog dang zhe sdang lags pas/

de bshags shing sdom la/ byang chub kyi thugs rin po ches 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal sel zhing*/ byang chub rin po che la 'god pa'i dam bca' byed pa dang*/ nad rang gis sems can thams cad kyi nad dag pa'i smon lam bsam pa dang 'dres par gdab pa dang*/ nad de rang gdod nas skye ba med par go zhing nad de rang gi ngang la sems gzhan du ma yengs par/ nyin phril phril mtshan yal yal bzhag pas/ nad rang sar dag pa kho rang gshis yin pas/ thugs skad cig tsam yang ma yengs pa gal che/ ji ltar gtsub shing rten 'brel la// me ni 'byung bar nges pa las// yengs shing 'phro ni bcad gyur na// 'bras bu med par 'gyur ba ltar// bzlas brjod dka' thub de 'drar gsung*// de na skad cig tsam yang khyed// nad kyi ngang la ma yengs zhu// rkyen shing phung dmar po gcig bskyur ba las sam/ btsan gcig gi gnod pa yod pas/ de la byang chub kyi thugs kyi bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs pa'i dkar gtor byin la/ kho'i gnod pa zhi ba'i bden pa bdar/ kho la gnod pas rang la gnod pa yin/ kho bde na rang yang bde nas 'ong bas zhe thag pa nas dge ba'i rtsa ba ci byed khos gtso bo byas pa'i sems can thams cad kyi ched du bya'o// // 534) ༄// lus ngag gi dka' thub spyad pa la mkhas pa dga' ba bskyed pa ma yin zhes pa// oṃ swasti/ bla ma rin po ches/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen ri khrod pa la springs pa/ khyed kyi gong ma'i bka' phrin de rnams legs par go ste/ cung zad shes pa thon pa'i gsung sha stag tu 'dug pas/ yi ge skur ngo ma shes/ do gal che na slob ma bla ma'i drung du 'ong ba kun gyi chos nyid du 'dug yi ge tshig gcig bskur bas kyang khyed kyis kyang nyams su len pa'am/ nyams su lon pa'am/ nyams su blangs pas phan nam snyam pa yang ma byung*/ spyir nang pa sangs rgyas pa sems 'dul ba gtso bor gyur pa yin/ phyi rol mu stegs byed lus ngag gi gdung ba dang dka' thub byas pas grol bar 'dod pa yin te/

de gnyis sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mkhas pa yin/ khyod kyi byed lugs de kun yang mkhas pa dga' ba skyed pa ma yin/ rmongs pa ngo mtshar skye ba'i spyod pa yin/ khams dang mtha' 'khob ni de la brtsi/ sngon ngas de kho na bzhin du byas/ grub thob kyi kha skad kyang byung ste/ phag mo grur ma phyin gyi bar du chos sam/ bon nam/ nyams su len lugs sam/ go ba rdul tsam yang ma skyes par 'dug khyed kyi byas pa yin te/ 'bad pa yin/ slob dpon chen po tog tse ba'i zhal snga nas/ byas pa thams cad don med sdug bsngal rgyu// gsung*/ slob dpon chen po birwa pa'i zhal snga nas/ byas pa thams cad don med bye ma'i ri// gsung*/ bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa'i chos thams cad mi byed rnam par mi byed/ mngon par 'du mi byed do zhes gsungs/ ngas brtson 'grus chen po byas snyam na yang*/ de kho nas ma btub pa yin te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis/ gang la'ang mi brtson de ni byang chub sems dpas brtson// zhes gsungs pa yin pas/ ma shes pa'i skyon/ mu stegs kyi dka' thub/ nga bdag gi byas lo// bdag 'dzin rdo rje'i brag ma shigs pa'i skyon yin/ dbang po rab yin na/ rang gi nyams myong dang nga'i chos 'di 'phrod nas/ lus ngag yid gsum thams cad rang grol chen por song nas 'ong ba yin te/ yul mtha' 'khob kyi grol po gcer rgyugs dang a ka za ba la zer/ da yon bdag pa dang bka' gros su mdzod la/ nga'i drung du gcig mang la ci thon gyis/ sgom pa la thugs 'gro na/ dang po kho nar nad lam du gtang*/ de nas sems bskyed/ lus yi dam gyi lha gang yin pa der bsgrims la mi bsgom/ glod la mi bsgom/ de'i bar nas yi dam lha'i ngang la bzhag yi dam gyi lha rang gi lus de'i gdan gang yin pa de la dran pa rgyun chad med par bskyang*/ de yang gsal na gsal ba'i ngang la bzhag mi gsal na mi gsal ba de nyid kyi ngang la bzhag

zhe 'dod kyi rnam rtog skad cig kyang mi bsam/ 'di kho na bzhin du nyams su blangs na/ myur du khams bde ba la tshegs med pa yin te/ khyed thugs dam mdzad mi khom ste 'ong*/ chos 'di kun dma' ba yin pas thugs kyang mi khengs te mchi/ a ngo re tsha/ ngo re tsha/ ngo re tsha/ yig rten nang dar ser po sham gcig bskur nas mchis// // 535) ༄// dngul chu dug 'don gyi bya thabs dang gtong thabs skor gyi man ngag/ na mo ratna gu ru/ dang por dngul chu dug gdon pa yin/ chang bzang po'am/ sran ma dkar nag gang yang rung ba'i nang du/ sngo nur gyis chu 'gro ba lags te/ lan bdun gyi bar du chu pho zhing yang yang mnye/ dngul chu gser srang gcig gi ljid kyis lo gcig bza' zhes grags te dpyad la bya/ dngul chu bshig pa grang shas che na bu ram/ tshad pa shas che na sbrang rtsi'am ka ras ci 'os tsam gyi nang du/ shing gi phor pa'i nang du shing gi rte'u mig gis/ yun ring du dkrugs pas dngul chu dngos med du sngon por 'gro/ de gnyis ka'i tshad tsam ghan dha bzang po gser gyi mdog 'dra ba/ legs par sbyangs pa dar tshags la btsags pa de dang ljid mnyam pa'am mang yang rung ba la/ tsan dan dmar po dang*/ rang nyid rlung dang mkhris pa dang bad kan shas gang che ba'i sman dang lhan cig tu legs par sbyar nas/ ril bu dang por sran chung tsam/ nam tho rangs kyi dus su bza'/ de legs par 'phrod cing*/ zhu bar gyur na/ sran ma 'bring po tsam re re bza'/ de ma 'phrod na kha so na ba dang*/ bshal ba dang sngon gyi nad rnying pa thams cad bslang drags na/ rang gro'am tsha ba zos pa'i rting drang po la/ ril bu snga ma tsam re re btang*/ de yang cung zad ma 'phrod na yungs kar tsam re re bza'/ ji ltar khams bzang ba dang*/ lus shed che ba dang*/ yon tan ci tsam dpag tu med pa byung yang*/ ril bu sran ma tsam yan chad mi bskyed/ zas bcud can sha stag 'di'i grogs yin/ tsha bcad mi dgos//

// 536) ༄// yum chen mo shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa'i sgom thabs kyi gdams zab// dag pa gnyis ldan dri ma med pa'i chos kyi sku// gzhi lam 'bras bu skye ba med pa gdod nas rnam par dag /rnam dag sa la gnas pa'i skyes bu mkhas pa de// 'khor 'das sems can khams rnams snying rje chen pos bsam pa bzhin du ston/ 'di ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa'i thabs mkhas pa ni/ pha rol tu phyin pa re re drug drug rdzogs par nyams su len pa/ de sems can thams cad kyi don du gnyis su med pa ni thabs mkhas pa'o// rgyal ba'i yum rgyas pa'i le'u lnga bcu rtsa gsum pa nas/ thabs mkhas pa de lta bu dang ldan pa'i byang chub sems dpa'/ yun ring po ji srid cig nas zhugs pa dang*/ sangs rgyas ji snyed cig la bsnyen bkur ba dang*/ dge ba'i rtsa ba bskrun pa rnams rgya cher gsungs nas/ bcom ldan 'das ji ltar na shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa chos gang yang yongs su 'dzin pa'am gtong ba ma mchis sam/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' bstsal pa/ rab 'byor de ni ma yin te/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni chos gang yongs su 'dzin pa'am gtong ba med do// de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor de ni 'di ltar chos thams cad yongs su bzung ba med pa dang*/ btang ba med pa'i phyir ro// gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das ji ltar na shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa chos thams cad mi 'dzin mi gtong ba lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' bstsal pa/ rab 'byor shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni gzugs yongs su mi 'dzin mi gtong ba nas/ rab 'byor shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su mi 'dzin mi gtong ngo*// gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das ji ltar na gzugs yongs su ma bzung ma btang ba lags pa nas/ ji ltar na rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid yongs su ma bzung ma btang ba lags/

bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' bstsal pa/ rab 'byor gzugs yid la mi byed pas gzugs yongs su ma bzung ma btang ba yin no// de bzhin du rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid yid la mi byed pas rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid yongs su ma bzung ma btang ba yin no// rab 'byor de ltar na gzugs yongs su ma bzung ma btang ba yin no// de bzhin du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi bar du ma bzung ma btang ba yin no// gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das ji ltar na gzugs yid la mi bgyi/ de bzhin du rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi bar du yid la mi bgyi na/ 'o na bcom ldan 'das gzugs yid la mi bgyis pa nas/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid yid la mi bgyis par/ dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams ji ltar rnam par 'phel bar 'gyur/ dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams rnam par ma 'phel na yang*/ ji ltar pha rol tu phyin pa drug yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug yongs su ma rdzogs na yang*/ ji ltar rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob par 'gyur/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' bstsal pa/ rab 'byor nam gzugs yid la mi byed pa nas/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub yid la mi byed pa de'i tshe/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams rnam par 'phel bar 'gyur te/ dge ba'i rtsa ba rnam par 'phel bas pha rol tu phyin pa drug yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro// pha rol tu phyin pa drug yongs su rdzogs pas rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob par 'gyur ro// de ci'i phyir zhe na/ gzugs yid la ma byas pa nas/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bco brgyad kyi bar dang*/ rang byang chub kyi bar du yid la ma byas pas/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya'o// gsol pa/ de ci'i slad du zhe na/ de ltar gzugs yid la ma bgyis pa nas/

de ltar bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub yid la ma bgyis pas/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob par 'gyur// bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' bstsal pa/ yid la byed pas ni/ gal te 'dod pa'i khams sam/ gal te gzugs kyi khams sam/ gal te gzugs med pa'i khams su 'dre bar 'gyur te/ yid la mi byed pas ni gang du yang 'dre bar mi 'gyur ro// rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ chos gang dang yang 'dre bar mi bgyi'o// gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la de ltar spyod pa de/ gang la gnas par 'gyur/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' bstsal pa/ rab 'byor de ltar spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni/ gzugs nas rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi bar la gnas par mi 'gyur ro// ༈ //ma lus yon tan kun gyi gzhi// shes rab pha rol phyin pa ni// mi 'dzin mi gtong nyid yin gsungs// 'dzin dang gtong ba med pa ni// yid la mi byed yin par gsungs// de ni gang la'ang mi gnas zhes// ston pa thugs rje can gyis gsungs// mi 'dzin pa dang mi gtong dang*// yid la mi byed mi gnas pas// yid la mi byed go bar bya// 'gro ba'i mgon po chos kyi rje// thams cad mkhyen pa bcom ldan dang*// de yis thugs su chud pa'i chos// brtul zhugs grub pa'i dge 'dun la// gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi// dpal ldan bram ze chen po la'o// thub mgon rgyal ba bcom ldan dang*// brgyud pa gong ma thams cad las// legs par brgyud pa'i gdams ngag 'di// rang sems shes rab pha rol phyin// ston pa'i gsung 'di nges gyur pa// zab mo man chung ma yin kyang*// zab cing rgya cher 'di nges pas// bu gcig gdams ngag thugs la zhog /yum gyi don to//

537) ༄// thabs sna tshogs kyis khas blangs shing dam bcas pa nyams 'og tu chud par byed pa// sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku// rdo rje 'chang gi ngo bo nyid// dkon mchog gsum gyi rtsa ba ste// bla ma mchog gi zhabs la 'dud// grangs med bskal pa bsam yas su// tshad med thugs rjes 'gro don du// dbu dang sku lus rab btang nas// bdag cag smin mdzad rje la 'dud// kwa a ma bla ma dam pa rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa thams cad kyi spyan sngar/ sems can ma lus pa thams cad bde ba dang ldan/ sdug bsngal dang bral/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub rin po che thob par byed par dam bcas pa'i skyes bu chen po/ mi'i seṅge/ tshogs kyi dpon po/ bla ma rin po che khyod/ dus deng sang bdag tu 'dzin pa log par lta ba'i sa gzhi chen po la/ chags pa dang sdang ba mi bzad pa'i dug ha la ha la me'i phung po rab tu 'bar bas rang nyid bsregs cing*/ gzhan thams cad kyang sreg par byed pa/ rang nyid dang rang nyid kyi gnyen dang 'brel bar 'gyur pa slob mar khas len pa rnams dang bcas pa rang nyid la rang nyid cung zad kyang snying mi rje'am/ kye rje btsun nag rang rdzab rgod/ ming bzang po/ sngon sgrub pa byed pa'i dus su/ 'gro ba'i don dran/ 'gro don dus la bab pa'i dus su sgom dran/ nyon mongs lnga'i zhags pa'i bcing ba dam pos rang nyid bcings shing*/ gzhan 'ching bar byed pa/ rang gzhan gnyis ka la yi chad chen po byed pa/ rang gi bsam pa dang dam bca' la mi blta bar/ gzhan gyi spyod pa bzang ngan gyi rjes su 'brang ba ni/ rin po che nyid kyi zhal snga nas/ sems can rnams 'di 'dra bas nga dogs pa yin mod snyam du bsam gsung ba dang*/ rang chags pa drag po'i rjes su 'brangs nas/ gces par byas pa tsam zhig nyes pa bsgrub pa'i dgra la byas na ci yong*/ thams cad de dang 'dra bar ci yong*/ lnga tsag tsam dran/ 'gro ba smin par byed pa'i thabs mkhas pa rtsol sgrub med par de rang na 'ong bar 'dug pa thugs la dgongs 'tshal/

yang rang nyid kyi sku lus nor bu rin po che phyi bdar legs par byas pa dang 'dra ba/ zas dang*/ gos dang*/ nor dang*/ phun sum tshogs pa rgya mtsho lta bus klubs pa 'di yang*/ phun sum tshogs pa'i dge 'dun dang*/ gzhan la phan pa dang bde ba'i rgyun bcad na 'byung ba yang ye dka' ba ma lags sam/ rang gi lus rul pa mi gtsang ba'i rdzas sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis gang ba/ blun po rnams chags pa/ mkhas pa rnams kyis smad pa 'di'i kha 'dzin dang zhe 'dzin/ ku ku dang re re/ mtho gcig dang dma' gcig byas kyang*/ dgra ni gsos nas dur khrod 'jug gsung na/ thabs sna tshogs kyis khas blangs shing dam bcas pa nyams 'og tu chud par byed pa rgyal po chen po spyan bzang lta bu zhig rang la ci ste mi 'bab/ de ltar byed na/ byed pa'i thabs mkhas pa bcom ldan 'das kyis sde snod rin po che rnam pa gsum/ rgyud sde rin po che rnam pa bzhi/ slob dpon chen po 'phags pa la sogs pa/ rang nyid kyi phar gyur pa rnams kyi gsung gi rjes su 'brangs nas/ prad prad 'bad par byas na/ byang chub sems dpa' legs par pha rol tu phyin pa dang 'dra ba la tshegs med pas/ de sgrub par byed pa'i thabs ston pa'i gsung gi rjes su 'brang bar bya ste/ slob dpon chen po shanta de ba'i byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa/ bslab pa kun las btus pa dang*/ sa'i snying po 'khor lo bcu pa'i rjes su 'brangs nas nyams su blang bar bya'o// 'di mtho gcig dma' gcig sgang ma sgang thog gi man ngag bya ba/ mdzad 'phro yin no// // 538) ༄// phag mo gru pa'i gdung rten bkra shis sgo mang gi dkar chag/ oṃ swasti/ dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bo rdo rje 'chang gi sku// brjod med mtha' bral don ston lta ba'i mun 'joms rdo rje'i gsung*// mi 'gyur 'dus ma byas pa tshad med snying rje chen po'i thugs// 'jig rten mgon po rin po che dpal bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud// sku lnga ye shes lnga rdzogs gar gyi nyams dgur ldan// nyon mongs rnam dag sems can kun sgrol dug lnga sel ba'i gsung*// byang chub sems gnyis dbyer med rtag chad 'gro 'ong bral ba'i thugs// rdo rje 'chang chen rigs kyi bdag po drug pa'i zhabs la 'dud// dus gsum gshegs pa thugs rjer ldan pa rgyal ba'i sku// brjod med mtshon pa 'dod chags bral ba dam pa'i chos// des gsung sgrub cing dbyer med rtogs pa tshogs kyi mchog

/rgyal ba sras bcas skyabs gnas rnams la gus pas 'dud// skyabs chen bla ma mchog dang dus gsum dkon mchog gi /phyi nang gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor rgyal ba sras bcas kyi// mtshan tsam thos pas sdig dang sgrib pa zad pa dang*// dpag med yon tan bskyed phyir cung zad 'dir brjod bya// de la dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi chos kyi sku spros pa thams cad kyi mtha' dang bral ba'i rang bzhin/ 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa'i yon tan rin po che ma lus shing lus pa med pa'i gter du gyur cing*/ ji srid 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho chen po ma stong gi bar du/ lhun gyis grub pa dang rgyun chad pa med pa'i phrin las kyis 'gro ba ma lus pa smin cing grol bar mdzad pa bla ma rin po che'i gdung rten/ lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten thams cad kyi mgon dang*/ skyabs dang*/ gnas dang*/ dpung gnyen du gyur cing*/ gtsug gi nor bu rin po cher bzhugs pa de'i/ zhabs 'bring dang zhabs tog de nyid las mi gzhan pa'i bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po rnams dang*/ yi dam gyi lha dang*/ jo bo bla na med pa'i dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum/ rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo sgo dang sgo khyud dang*/ rtsig pa dang*/ pañtsa ra ga dang*/ chos kyi 'khor lo gdugs kyis phub pa dang*/ ri dwags dar dpyangs kyis mdzes par byas pa dang*/ dar dpyangs chen po 'phan ring gis legs par brgyan pa dang*/ rigs kyi phyag mtshan tha dad pas rnam par phye ba dang*/ chos skyong ba'i srung ma chen po phrin las rnam bzhis 'gro ba thams cad smin pa dang grol bar mdzad pa'i rten khyad par can zhig bla ma gong ma'i sku gsung thugs kyi dgongs pa yongs su rdzogs par bya ba'i ched du/ bdag gi bla ma dam pas bzhengs par mdzad pa'i thugs kyi dgongs pa de rdzogs par mdzad pa'i ched du/ dge 'dun gyi tshogs rgya mtsho chen po lta bu rnams kyis/

'bad pa dang*/ rtsol ba dang*/ rgyu rkyen dang*/ mos gus kyi gzhi bzung*/ dpon chen po tshul rin gyis bdag mdzad/ lho bal gyi lha bzo mkhas shing bzo rig pa'i yon tan phul du phyin pa/ bzo'i sprul par grags pa/ dpon chen po ma ṇi bha dra zhes bya ba spyan drangs nas/ bdag cag bla ma dam pa'i nye gnas sku gsung thugs kyi sras su gyur pa rnams kyis/ 'bad pa dang*/ rtsol bas legs par bsgrubs pa'i bkra shis sgo mang zhes yongs su grags pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams dang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo bzhugs pa ni/ rgyu rin po che rnam pa sna tshogs las grub pa/ rgyar mtho lnga bcu rtsa gsum yod pa/ mtho dman gyi dpangs su mtho sum cu rtsa gsum yod pa/ nang gi khog pa rgyu rin po che rnam pa sna tshogs las grub pa/ bar gyi ling tshe mnyam zhing 'tsham pa/ tshad phun sum tshogs pa/ phyi gzhal yas khang gi nang na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs rnams dang de'i phyi rol mchod pa'i lha mo dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs rnams dang*/ padma dang bum pa bzang po dpag bsam gyi shing rigs rnam pa lnga'i phyag rgyas btab pa'i ka ba rnams dang*/ de'i phyi rol tu khro bo'i rgyal po rnam par 'khrugs shing rngam pa dang*/ sgo srung ba dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' chen po kun tu bzang po mchod pa'i sprin phung gi bkod pas mchod pa/ lha phrug nam mkha' lding zhes grags pa dang*/ rim pa lnga'i rang bzhin du gnas pa de la/ rdo rje'i sa gzhi chen po'i steng du/ rdo rje rin po che'i padma'i sdong po chen po la/ lha tshogs bzhugs pa'i bang rim drug de'i steng du utpal dang*/ mu tig gi phreng ba dang*/ padma'i gdan la gong du smos pa'i dpal ldan phag mo gru pa'i gdung rten chen po de nyid bzhugs so// de la lha bzhugs pa'i bang rim gong ma'i shar phyogs kyi dbus su bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje 'chang bzhugs/

de'i g.yas g.yon du chaus rje phag mo gru pa rigs rnam pa lnga rdo rje 'chang dang bcas pa'am/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug dbye ba med pas bsdus pa'i sku drug bzhugs/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yum du gyur pa rje btsun ma rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku gsum bzhugs so// de nas lho phyogs kyi dbus su bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'chang bzhugs/ de'i g.yas su rje btsun chen po tilli pa bzhugs/ g.yon ngos na dpal ldan nā ro pa bzhugs/ de gsum gyi g.yas ngos su rje btsun mar pa lho brag pa bzhugs/ g.yon ngos su rje btsun mi la rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po bzhugs/ de rnams kyi g.yas ngos su jo bo chen po rje lha gcig bzhugs/ g.yon gyi ngos su rje rin po che sgam po pa bzhugs/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yum du gyur pa rje btsun ma rnal 'byor ma'i sku gsum bzhugs so// de nas nub kyi ngos na dbus su bcom ldan 'das dpal lhan cig skyes pa bzhugs/ de'i g.yas ngos su slob dpon rgyal po ind+ra bo dhi lha lcam legs smin dang gnyis su med par bzhugs/ de'i g.yas ngos na slob dpon ḍoṃ bhi he ru ka bzhugs/ de'i g.yas na slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub la/ slob dpon ārya de ba dang slob dpon klu'i byang chub gnyis kyis bskor ba bzhugs/ dpal lhan cig skyes pa'i g.yon ngos na/ slob dpon chen po bram ze sa ra ha la/ yum kha ṇa ḍho dang ro he gnyis kyis mtha' brten pa bzhugs/ de'i g.yon du slob dpon ku ku ri pa bzhugs/ de'i g.yon du slob dpon lū hi pa bzhugs/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yum du gyur pa rje btsun ma rdo rje rnal 'byor ma gsum bzhugs/ de nas byang phyogs kyi dbus su bcom ldan 'das dpal lhan gcig skyes pa bzhugs/ de'i g.yas su slob dpon chen po birwa pa la mkha' 'gro ma gnyis kyis mtha' brten pa bzhugs/

de'i g.yas na slob dpon rdo rje dril bu pa bzhugs/ de'i g.yas na slob dpon padma 'byung gnas bzhugs/ bcom ldan 'das lhan cig skyes pa'i g.yon na slob dpon dza landha ra pa yum dang gnyis su med pa bzhugs/ de'i g.yon na slob dpon mtsho skyes rdo rje yum padma ni dang gnyis su med pa bzhugs/ de'i g.yon na mkhan po bo dhi sa twa bzhugs/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi yum du gyur pa rje btsun ma rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku gsum bzhugs/ spyir bang rim gong ma la lha lnga bcu rtsa gsum bzhugs so// de'i 'og gi bang rim gnyis pa la/ shar gyi ngos la dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs la/ dbus kyi ling tshe la bcom ldan 'das zhe sdang rdo rje zhal gsum phyag drug pa yum reg bya rdo rje ma dang gnyis su med par bzhugs/ de'i g.yas su bcom ldan 'das dpal rnam par snang mdzad zhal gsum phyag drug pa bzhugs/ de'i g.yas na bcom ldan 'das dpal rin chen 'byung ldan zhal gsum phyag drug pa bzhugs/ gtso bo'i g.yon na bcom ldan 'das dpal 'od dpag tu med pa zhal gsum phyag drug pa bzhugs/ de'i g.yon na bcom ldan 'das dpal don yod grub pa zhal gsum phyag drug pa bzhugs pa dang lnga la/ sangs rgyas spyan ma la sogs pa'i yum rnams dang*/ gzugs rdo rje ma la sogs pa mchod pa'i lha mo rnams dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' phyag na rdo rje la sogs pa sems dpa' rnams dang*/ gshin rje gshed po la sogs pa khro bo rnams dang*/ bcom ldan 'das mi bskyod pa la sogs pa rigs kyi bdag po rnams dang*/ spyir lha bdun cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo dang*/ jo bo thugs rje chen po yi ge drug pa gtso 'khor gsum dang*/ ka ba bzhir byang chub sems dpa' rgyal ba las rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ phyag dang po gnyis na rdo rje dang ril ba bing ka ra bsnams pa/

'og ma gnyis kyis rin po che'i padma chen po rnam par 'degs pa zhal phyir gzigs pa'i byang chub sems ma bzhi dang*/ nang du gzigs pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo bzhi dang*/ zur thung bzhi la phyi nang gi mchod pa'i lha mo brgyad dang*/ shar ngos la dgu bcu go gnyis bzhugs so// lho phyogs kyi ngos la/ dbus kyi ling tshe la/ bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje gzhon nu yum 'khor lo rgyas 'debs ma dang gnyis su med pa la/ khro bo chen po hūm̐ ka ra la sogs pa ye shes kyi khro bo bcu dang*/ rdo rje sgra 'byin ma la sogs pa yum bcu/ sras mchog badzra kī la ya la sogs pa dang bcas pa nyi shu rtsa gsum gyi dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo bzhugs/ de'i g.yas kyi ngos na bcom ldan 'das dpal dus kyi dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa/ yum sna tshogs rdo rje ma dang gnyis su med pa la/ de bzhin gshegs pa don yod grub pa la sogs pa rigs bzhi dang*/ sangs rgyas spyan ma la sogs pa yum bzhi dang brgyad kyis bskor ba lha bcu'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo bzhugs/ de'i g.yas na bcom ldan 'das gsang bdag 'khor lo chen po zhal gsum phyag drug pa'i yum lha mo mdzes ldan ma dang gnyis su med pa la/ yab khro bo bdud las rgyal byed dang*/ yum lha mo 'od zer can dang*/ lha mo lcags kyu ma la sogs pas bskor ba lha bcu bzhi'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo bzhugs/ de nas g.yon ngos nas bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ yum ro langs khro mo dang gnyis su med pa la/ zhe sdang gshin rje gshed dang*/ nga rgyal dang*/ 'dod chags dang*/ phrag dog gshin rje gshed yum dang bcas pa/ lha bcu'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo bzhugs/ de'i g.yon na bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'jigs byed zhal dgu phyag sum cu rtsa bzhi pa rigs kyi bdag po dang bcas pa bzhugs/ jo bo thugs rje chen po yid bzhin gyi 'khor lo gtso 'khor lnga bzhugs/

zur thung bzhi la phyi nang gi mchod pa'i lha mo brgyad bzhugs/ ka ba bzhi la zhal phyir gzigs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' bzhi/ nang du gzigs pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo bzhi dang brgyad bzhugs/ spyir lho ngos na lha brgya bcu rtsa gcig bzhugs so// ༈ //nub kyi ngos kyi dbus kyi ling tshe la/ bcom ldan 'das dpal dgyes pa'i rdo rje zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa/ yum bdag med ma rnal 'byor ma dang gnyis su med pa la/ gau ri ma la sogs pa lha mo brgyad kyis bskor ba dang*/ phyag mtshan gyi lha mo brgyad dang bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo bzhugs/ de'i g.yas kyi ngos na bcom ldan 'das ma hā ma ya zhal bzhi phyag bzhi pa rigs kyi bdag po dang bcas pa yum sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma dang gnyis su med pa la/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pa mkha' 'gro ma bzhis bskor ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo bzhugs/ de'i g.yas na rje btsun ma rdo rje rnal 'byor ma lha bdun ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo bzhugs/ de nas g.yon ngos na bcom ldan 'das dpal lha mo gdan bzhi zhal gsum phyag drug ma la rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma dang seṅge'i gdong la sogs pa mkha' 'gro ma bcu gnyis kyis bskor ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo bzhugs/ de'i g.yon na rje btsun ma rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pa bzhis bskor ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo bzhugs/ jo bo thugs rje chen po a mo gha pā sha don yod zhags pa lha lnga bzhugs/ zur thung bzhi la phyi nang gi mchod pa'i lha mo brgyad bzhugs/ ka ba bzhi la byang chub sems ma rgyal ba las rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba/ zhal phyir gzigs pa'i byang chub sems ma bzhi/ nang du gzigs pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo bzhi dang brgyad bzhugs/ spyir nub kyi ngos na lha bdun cu rtsa gcig bzhugs so// ༈ //de nas byang phyogs kyi ngos kyi ling tshe dbus ma la/

bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo bde mchog zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa/ yum rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dang gnyis su med pa la/ mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pa bzhi/ gri gug gi 'phreng bas yongs su bskor ba bde ba chen po'i pho brang bzhugs so// de nas g.yas g.yon gyi ling tshe rnams la/ dpa' bo thod pa'i dum bu dang*/ rnal 'byor ma rab tu gtum ma la sogs pa thugs kyi 'khor lo rdo rje phreng bas yongs su bskor ba bzhugs/ dpa' bo myu gu can dang dpa' mo sa srungs ma la sogs pa gsung gi 'khor lo padma'i phreng bas yongs su bskor ba bzhugs/ dpa' bo stobs po che dang dpa' mo 'khor lo can ma la sogs pa sku'i 'khor lo/ 'khor lo'i phreng bas yongs su bskor ba bzhugs/ de nas kha gdong ma la sogs pa sgo ma bzhi dang*/ gshin rje sreg ma la sogs pa mtshams ma bzhi dang*/ dam tshig gi 'khor lo dang*/ lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo bzhugs/ de nas dur khrod chen po brgyad na slob dpon rgyal po ind+ra bo dhi la sogs pa grub pa thob pa'i rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po brgyad dang*/ lha'i dbang po brgya byin la sogs pa phyogs skyong ba chen po brgyad dang*/ glang po'i gdong la sogs pa zhing skyong chen po brgyad dang*/ nor rgyas la sogs pa klu'i rgyal po chen po brgyad dang bcas pa bzhugs so// zur thung bzhi la mchod pa'i lha mo brgyad dang*/ ka ba bzhi la zhal phyir gzigs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' ma rgyal ba las rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba bzhi dang*/ nang du zhal gzigs pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo bzhi dang brgyad/ jo bo thugs rje chen po zhal bcu gcig pa gtso 'khor gsum dang*/ spyir bang rim gnyis pa'i byang ngos su lha brgya dang bcu bzhi bzhugs so// lha'i bu nam mkha' lding kun tu bzang po mchod pa'i sprin phung gi char chen po rab tu 'bebs par byed pa bzhi dang*/ spyir bang rim gnyis pa la lha sum brgya dang lnga bcu rtsa dgu bzhugs so//

༈ //de nas bang rim gsum pa'i shar phyogs kyi ngos la/ dbus kyi ling tshe la/ bcom ldan 'das dpal rnam par snang mdzad kun tu zhal byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya can bzhugs/ de'i g.yas na bcom ldan 'das mi bskyod pa bzhugs/ de'i g.yas na bcom ldan 'das rin chen 'byung ldan bzhugs/ g.yon ngos na bcom ldan 'das snang ba mtha' yas bzhugs/ de'i g.yon na bcom ldan 'das don yod grub pa dang lnga la/ byang chub sems dpa' chen po rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs pa'i sems dpa' rnams dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' byams pa la sogs pa'i bskal pa bzang po'i byang chub sems dpa' bcu drug dang*/ lha mo sgeg ma la sogs pa nang gi mchod pa'i lha mo rnams dang*/ lha mo rdo rje bdug spos ma la sogs pa phyi'i mchod pa'i lha mo rnams dang*/ rigs kyi yum bzhi sbas pa'i tshul du bzhugs pa dang*/ spyir rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo la lha bzhi bcu rtsa bdun la sogs pa bzhugs/ bcom ldan 'das khro bo'i rgyal po mi g.yo ba pus btsugs dang*/ zur thung bzhi la phyi nang gi mchod pa'i lha mo brgya dang*/ ka ba bzhi la zhal phyir gzigs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' ma bzhi/ nang du gzigs pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo bzhi dang*/ lha'i bu nam mkha'i lding mchod pa'i sprin phung gi char chen po rab tu 'bebs pa dang*/ spyir shar ngos la lha drug cu rtsa dgu bzhugs so// ༈ //yang lho'i ngos kyi ling tshe la dbus su/ sangs rgyas thod pa zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ yum sna tshogs sde ma dang gnyis su med pa la/ rdo rje mche ba ma la sogs pas bskor ba spyir lha bco brgyad kyi dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo bzhugs/ de'i g.yas na bcom ldan 'das dam tshig gsum bkod pa'i rgyal po rgyal ba sprul pa'i sku la 'khor rdo rje 'dzin pa la sogs pa bzhi dang lha lnga bzhugs/ de'i g.yas na sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad dag par byed pa'i bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpa' lha mo puṣpe ma la sogs pa'i lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo bzhugs/

yang g.yon gyi ngos na/ 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal thams cad sel bar byed pa'i sangs rgyas sman pa'i rgyal po la/ de bzhin gshegs pa mya ngan med mchog dpal la sogs pa drug gis bskor ba'i lha bdun gyi dkyil 'khor bzhugs/ de'i g.yon na rje btsun 'jam dpal smra ba'i seṅge bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed la sogs pa lha bdun gyi dkyil 'khor bzhugs/ yang bcom ldan 'das khro bo mi g.yo ba pus btsugs dang*/ zur thung bzhi la phyi nang gi mchod pa'i lha mo brgyad dang*/ ka ba bzhi la zhal phyir gzigs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' ma bzhi dang*/ nang du gzigs pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo bzhi dang*/ lha'i bu nam mkha' lding kun tu bzang po mchod pa'i sprin phung gi char chen po 'bebs par byed pa dang*/ spyir lho phyogs na lha drug cu rtsa bzhi bzhugs so// ༈ //de nas nub phyogs kyi ngos na dbus kyi ling tshe la/ yum chen mo shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma'i dkyil 'khor la/ dbus su yum chen mo shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma la/ shar phyogs su rigs sngags kyi rgyal mo so sor 'brang ba chen mo dang*/ bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje mi pham ma dang*/ sdig pa thams cad spong ba dang*/ gdul dka' ba dang*/ bdud thams cad 'joms ma dang*/ sgo mtha' yas pa dang*/ dkon mchog 'byung gnas dang*/ skul byed ma dang byang chub sems dpa' chen po brgyad kyi phyag mtshan dang bcas pa lha bcu bdun gyi dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo bzhugs so// ༈ //de'i g.yas na bcom ldan 'das khro bo'i rgyal po mi g.yo ba la khro bo pus btsugs gnyis sprul pa'i khro chung brgyad dang bcus bskor ba lha bcu gcig gi dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo bzhugs/ de'i g.yas na bcom ldan 'das gtsug gtor 'khor los bsgyur ba la/ dam pa sbyin pa'i rdo rje la sogs pas bskor ba lha bcu bdun gyi dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo bzhugs so// de nas yang g.yon ngos na mgon po tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa la/

bcom ldan 'das rdo rje mi bskyod pa la sogs pa bzhis bskor ba dang*/ lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo bzhugs/ de'i g.yon na jo bo thugs rje chen po rje btsun spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la/ yig drug rig ma la sogs pa mchod pa'i lha mo rnams dang bcas pa lha bcu gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo bzhugs so// yang khro bo'i rgyal po pus btsugs dang*/ zur thung bzhi la mchod pa'i lha mo brgyad dang*/ ka ba bzhi la zhal phyir gzigs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' bzhi dang*/ nang du gzigs pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo bzhi dang*/ lha'i bu nam mkha' lding kun tu bzang po mchod pa'i sprin phung gi char chen po 'bebs par byed pa dang*/ spyir nub kyi ngos na lha bdun cu tham pa bzhugs so// de nas byang phyogs kyi ngos na dbus kyi ling tshe la/ bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo bde mchog gtsug gi nor bu zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa/ yum rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dang gnyis su med pa la/ mkha' 'gro ma ma tang gi la sogs pa bcu gnyis kyis bskor ba dang*/ lha bcu bzhi'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo bzhugs so// de'i g.yas na bcom ldan 'das yang dag he ru ka zhal gsum phyag drug pa yum kro ti sho ri dang gnyis su med pa la ke'u ri ma la sogs pa ma mo brgyad kyis bskor ba dang*/ lha bcu'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo bzhugs so// de'i g.yas na bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje la mgon po mi bskyod pa la sogs pa bzhis bskor ba dang thugs kyi dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo lha lnga bzhugs so// de nas g.yon phyogs kyi ngos na dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yum du gyur pa rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma phyag brgyad sgrol ma la/ 'phags ma me'i 'jigs pa skyob pa la sogs pa rje btsun ma brgyad kyis bskor ba dang lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo bzhugs so// de'i g.yon na bcom ldan 'das dpal rta mgrin zhal gsum phyag drug pa'i rnam pa la badzra sho na ma la sogs pa'i sho na ma bzhis bskor ba dang*/

lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo bzhugs so// yang khro bo'i rgyal po pus btsugs dang*/ zur thung bzhi la mchod pa'i lha mo brgyad dang*/ ka ba bzhi la zhal phyir gzigs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' bzhi dang*/ nang du gzigs pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo bzhi dang*/ lha'i bu nam mkha' lding kun tu bzang po mchod pa'i sprin phung gi char chen po 'bebs par byed pa dang*/ spyir byang gi phyogs na lha drug cu rtsa gcig bzhugs so// spyir bang rim gsum pa la/ lha tshogs nyis brgya dang drug bcu tham pa bzhugs so// ༈ //de nas bang rim bzhi pa la/ byang phyogs kyi ngos nas/ dbus kyi ling tshe la/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa mtshan dang dpe byad thams cad kyis rab tu brgyan pa dag bzhugs so// de'i g.yas kyi ngos na byang chub sems dpa' byams pa rin po che'i ril ba spyi blugs bsnams pa dang*/ khro bo chen po gzhan gyis mi thub pa'i 'khor lo rdo rje bsnams pa dang*/ g.yon gyi ngos nas byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang pos rin po che'i khang bu bsnams pa dang*/ khro bo khams gsum las rnam par rgyal bas mda' gzhu bsnams pa dang*/ gtso 'khor lnga bzhugs so// de'i g.yas g.yon gyi ling tshe rnams la/ bskal ba bzang po'i sangs rgyas mi bskyod pa'i rigs sa gnon gyi phyag rgya can thugs phyag mtshan gyis kha bskangs te/ nyis brgya lnga bcu tham pa bzhugs so// yang zur thung bzhi la mchod pa'i lha mo brgyad dang*/ ka ba bzhi la zhal phyir gzigs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' bzhi dang*/ nang du gzigs pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo bzhi dang*/ shar phyogs kyi sgo ba rdo rje lcags kyu dang*/ lha'i bu nam mkha' lding mchod pa'i sprin phung gi char chen po 'bebs pa dang*/ shar phyogs na lha nyis brgya bdun cu rtsa gsum bzhugs so// de nas lho phyogs kyi dbus kyi ling tshe la/ bstan pa'i bdag po bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa bzhugs/

de'i g.yas na byang chub sems dpa' phyag na rdo rje utpal shin tu rgyas pa'i steng na rdo rje bsnams pa dang*/ khro bo chen po mi g.yo ba ral gri bsnams pa'o// g.yon ngos na byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha'i snying po ral gri bsnams pa dang*/ khro bo chen po bdud rtsi 'khyil ba rdo rje rgya gram bsnams pa dang*/ gtso 'khor lnga bzhugs so// de'i g.yas g.yon gyi ling tshe rnams la bskal pa bzang po'i sangs rgyas rin chen 'byung ldan gyi rigs mchod sbyin gyi phyag rgya can thugs phyag mtshan gyis bskangs pa dang*/ nyis brgya lnga bcu tham pa bzhugs so// yang zur thung bzhi la mchod pa'i lha mo brgyad dang*/ ka ba bzhi la zhal phyir gzigs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' bzhi dang*/ nang du gzigs pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo bzhi dang*/ lho phyogs kyi sgo ba rdo rje zhags pa dang*/ lha'i bu nam mkha' lding kun tu bzang po mchod pa'i sprin phung gi char chen po 'bebs pa dang*/ lho phyogs na lha nyis brgya bdun bcu rtsa gsum bzhugs so// de nas nub phyogs kyi ngos na/ dbus kyi ling tshe la/ bcom ldan 'das rgyal ba shākya thub pa bzhugs/ de'i g.yas na byang chub sems dpa' 'jam dpal utpal shin tu rgyas pa'i steng na rdo rje bsnams pa dang*/ khro bo chen po gshin rje gshed rdo rje tho ba bsnams pa dang*/ g.yon ngos na byang chub sems dpa' 'jig rten dbang phyug phyag na padma bzang po bsnams pa dang*/ khro bo chen po dpal rta mgrin phyag na dbyug tho bsnams pa dang*/ gtso 'khor lnga bzhugs so// de'i g.yas g.yon gyi ling tshe rnams la/ bskal pa bzang po'i sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas kyi rigs mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya can thugs phyag mtshan gyis bskangs pa dang*/ nyis brgya lnga bcu tham pa bzhugs so// yang zur thung bzhi la phyi nang gi mchod pa'i lha mo brgyad dang*/ ka ba bzhi la zhal phyir gzigs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' bzhi dang*/

nang du gzigs pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo bzhi dang*/ nub phyogs kyi sgo ba rdo rje lcags sgrog dang*/ lha'i bu nam mkha' lding kun tu bzang po mchod pa'i sprin phung gi char chen po rab tu 'bebs pa dang*/ spyir nub phyogs na lha nyis brgya bdun cu rtsa gsum bzhugs so// de nas byang gi phyogs na dbus kyi ling tshe la/ bstan pa'i bdag po bcom ldan 'das rgyal ba shākya thub pa bzhugs/ de'i g.yas na byang chub sems dpa' sa'i snying po rin po che'i myu gu bsnams pa dang*/ khro bo chen po dbyug pa sngon po can phyag na rdo rje dbyug pa bsnams pa dang*/ g.yon ngos na byang chub sems dpa' sgrib pa rnam par sel ba phyag na po ti bsnams pa dang*/ khro bo chen po 'dod pa'i rgyal po phyag na lcags kyu bsnams pa dang*/ gtso 'khor lnga bzhugs so// de'i g.yas g.yon gyi ling tshe rnams la bskal pa bzang po'i sangs rgyas don yod grub pa'i rigs skyabs sbyin gyi phyag rgya can thugs phyag mtshan gyis bskangs pa dang*/ spyir nyis brgya lnga bcu tham pa bzhugs so// yang zur thung bzhi la mchod pa'i lha mo brgyad dang*/ ka ba bzhi la zhal phyir gzigs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' bzhi dang*/ nang du gzigs pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo bzhi dang*/ byang phyogs kyi sgo ba rdo rje dril bu 'khrol ba dang*/ lha'i bu nam mkha' lding kun tu bzang po mchod pa'i sprin phung gi char chen po rab tu 'bebs par byed pa dang*/ spyir byang phyogs na lha nyis brgya bdun cu rtsa gsum bzhugs so// spyir bang rim bzhi pa la gtso bo bstan pa'i bdag po bcom ldan 'das rgyal ba shākya thub pa bzhi/ de'i g.yas g.yon na byang chub sems dpa' chen po brgyad ni rje btsun gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje dang*/ rje btsun sems bskyed ma thag tu chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul ma 'debs pa la sogs pa'o// bcom ldan 'das khro bo'i rgyal po chen po brgyad ni bum pa bsrung ba'i tshul du bzhugs pa'o// spyir bang rim bzhi pa la lha stong dang dgu bcu rtsa gsum bzhugs so// de nas bang rim lnga pa la/

shar phyogs kyi ngos na dbus kyi ling tshe la/ bcom ldan 'das ma dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yum gtsor gyur pa/ 'gro ba'i nad dang gnod pa sel bar byed pa'i rje btsun ma parṇa sha wa ri ri khrod lo ma can zhal gsum phyag drug ma bzhugs so// de'i g.yas na 'jigs pa dang nyam nga ba thams cad las skyob par byed pa gtsor gyur pa'i rje btsun ma lha mo 'od zer can zhal gsum phyag drug ma la rigs kyi bdag po rgyal ba rigs lngas dbu la brgyan pa bzhugs so// g.yon ngos na nyon mongs pa'i dug thams cad sel bar byed pa gtsor gyur pa'i rje btsun ma lha mo dug sel ma zhal gsum phyag drug ma rigs kyi bdag pos dbu brgyan pa bzhugs so// de nas g.yas kyi ngos na mchod pa'i lha mo pi wang ma dang*/ gling bu ma dang*/ rdza rnga ma dang*/ rnga chen ma dang bzhi bzhugs so// de'i g.yas na gzugs rdo rje ma dang*/ ro rdo rje ma dang*/ reg bya rdo rje ma dang*/ chos rdo rje ma dang bzhi bzhugs so// g.yon ngos na lha mo rdo rje bzhad ma dang*/ lha mo rdo rje sgeg ma dang*/ lha mo rdo rje glu ma dang*/ lha mo rdo rje gar ma dang bzhi bzhugs so// de'i g.yon mchod pa'i ngos na lha mo rdo rje me tog ma dang*/ lha mo rdo rje bdug spos ma dang*/ lha mo rdo rje snang gsal ma dang*/ lha mo rdo rje dri chab ma dang bzhi bzhugs so// ka ba bzhi la zhal phyir gzigs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' bzhi dang*/ nang du gzigs pa'i lha mo bzhi dang brgyad bzhugs so// phyogs bcu dus bzhi'i thub pa drang srong chen po bzhi las/ drang srong chen po phyag na me tog utpal shin tu rgyas pa bsnams pa bzhugs so// zur thung bzhi la mchod pa'i lha mo thugs phyag mtshan gyi ngo bor gyur pa brgyad bzhugs so// spyir shar phyogs na lha bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis bzhugs so// de nas lho phyogs kyi ngos na dbus kyi ling tshe la/

dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yum du gyur pa/ 'gro ba sems can thams cad 'jigs pa chen po brgyad las skyob par byed pa gtsor gyur pa rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma zhal bzhi phyag brgyad ma bzhugs so// de'i g.yas na gzhan gyi rigs sngags dang byad stems thams cad phyir bzlog par byed pa gtsor gyur pa'i rje btsun ma lha mo gtsug gtor gdugs dkar mo can zhal gsum phyag drug ma bzhugs so// g.yon ngos na dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs bskul bar byed pa gtsor gyur pa'i rje btsun ma lha mo bskul byed ma zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma bzhugs so// de'i g.yas g.yon gyi ling tshe rnams la lha mo pi wang ma la sogs pa bzhi dang*/ gzugs rdo rje ma la sogs pa bzhugs so// g.yon ngos na rdo rje bzhad ma la sogs pa bzhi dang*/ rdo rje me tog ma la sogs pa bzhi dang bcu drug bzhugs so// ka ba bzhi la zhal phyir gzigs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' bzhi dang*/ nang du gzigs pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo bzhi dang*/ phyogs bcu dus bzhi'i thub pa drang srong chen po bzhi la/ drang srong chen po phyag na shing thog bsnams pa dang*/ zur thung bzhi la mchod pa'i lha mo brgyad thugs phyag mtshan gyi ngo bor gyur pa brgyad bzhugs so// spyir lho phyogs na lha sum bcu rtsa drug bzhugs so// ༈ //de nas nub phyogs kyi ngos kyi dbus kyi ling tshe la/ dgra dang chom rkun dang tsher ma dang*/ pha rol gyi dpung thams cad rab tu 'joms par byed pa gtsor gyur pa'i rje btsun ma lha mo rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i dpung rgyan can zhal bzhi phyag brgyad ma bzhugs so// de'i g.yas na srid pa gsum gyi 'jig rten la mnga' brnyes shing*/ ma rungs pa'i bgegs dang log 'dren tshar gcod par byed cing bkra shis dang bde legs thams cad 'byung ba gtsor gyur pa'i rje btsun ma lha mo e ka dza ti zhal gcig phyag brgyad ma bzhugs/

g.yon ngos na gdon chen po bco lnga la sogs pa bgegs dang log 'dren thams cad zhi bar mdzad pa gtsor gyur pa'i rje btsun ma stong chen mo rab tu 'joms ma zhal bzhi phyag brgyad ma bzhugs/ de'i g.yas g.yon gyi ling tshe la lha mo pi wang ma la sogs pa bzhi dang*/ gzugs rdo rje ma la sogs pa bzhi dang*/ rdo rje bzhad ma la sogs pa bzhi dang*/ rdo rje me tog ma la sogs pa bzhi dang bcu drug bzhugs so// ka ba bzhi la zhal phyir gzigs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' bzhi dang*/ nang du gzigs pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo bzhi dang*/ me lha'i drang srong chen po me sgron zhes bya ba phyag na me tog bsnams pa dang*/ zur thung bzhi la mchod pa'i lha mo brgyad thugs phyag mtshan gyi ngo bor gyur pa bzhugs so// spyir nub ngos na lha sum cu rtsa drug bzhugs so// de nas byang phyogs kyi ngos na dbus kyi ling tshe la/ 'gro ba'i dbul ba dang 'phongs pa thams cad sel bar byed pa'i gtsor gyur pa'i rje btsun ma 'phags ma nor rgyun ma zhal gcig phyag drug ma bzhugs so// de'i g.yas na sems can dmyal ba dang ngan song dang ngan 'gro log par ltung ba'i 'jigs pa dang*/ bgegs dang log 'dren thams cad zhi bar mdzad pa gtsor gyur pa'i rje btsun ma so sor 'brang ma chen mo zhal gcig phyag brgyad ma bzhugs so// g.yon ngos na padma'i mda' stangs kyis 'gro ba thams cad dbang du byed pa gtsor gyur pa'i rje btsun ma lha mo ku ru ku le zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma bzhugs so// de'i g.yas g.yon gyi ling tshe rnams la lha mo pi wang ma la sogs pa bzhi dang*/ gzugs rdo rje ma la sogs pa bzhi dang*/ rdo rje bzhad ma la sogs pa bzhi dang*/ rdo rje me tog ma la sogs pa bzhi dang bcu drug bzhugs so// ka ba bzhi la zhal phyir gzigs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' bzhi dang*/ nang du gzigs pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo bzhi dang*/ phyogs bcu dus bzhi'i thub pa drang srong chen po bzhi las drang srong chen po phyag na ril pa spyi blug bsnams pa dang*/

zur thung bzhi la mchod pa'i lha mo brgyad thugs phyag mtshan gyi ngo bor bzhugs so// spyir byang ngos na lha sum cu rtsa drug bzhugs so// de la mchod pa'i lha mo gtso mo bcu gnyis po de dag ni/ zhal gsum phyag drug ma la sogs pa ci rigs par bzhugs so// 'khor drug cu rtsa bzhi po de dag ni zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma'i rnam par bzhugs so// zur thung gi mchod pa'i lha mo rnams ni zhal gcig phyag gnyis mar bzhugs so// spyir bang rim lnga pa la lha brgya dang lnga bcu tham pa bzhugs so// ༈ //de nas bang rim drug pa'i padma chen po'i 'og chos skyong ba'i srung ma chen po rnams bzhugs so// ldum rdzings kyi padma yal ga phyogs bcur gyes pa rnams la/ phyogs bcu dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi dgongs pa yongs su rdzogs par mdzad pa/ dam pa chos skyong ba'i srung ma 'khor ba ma stong gi bar du/ phrin las rnam pa bzhis sems can thams cad smin pa dang grol bar mdzad pa'i byang chub sems dpa' bdag nyid chen po chos skyong ba'i srung ma chen po sha stag 'di lta ste/ phyogs re re na dpal lha mo dang mgon po gnyis/ gnod sbyin gyi rgyal po chen po gnyis/ klu'i rgyal po chen po gnyis gnyis dang*/ gtso bo drug drug bzhugs so// de la klu'i rgyal po chen po brgyad de dag ni/ rin po che padma la rnam par brtse bas gyad kyi tshul du 'degs shing kha nang du bltas pa/ gdong cung zad thad zhal du gzigs shing rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa la/ 'jig rten mgon po rin po che'i bkas/ mgo bo dgu pa zhi ba'i rnam par dbu gtsug nor bus brgyan pa/ sprin chen po them nyer du 'khrigs pa/ 'brug gi mgo bo skad chen po sgrogs pa'i gdengs ka can/ kha nang glog gi phreng bas brgyan pa/ rin po che rnam pa sna tshogs kyi char 'bebs shing bar du gcod pa thams cad sel bar byed pa'o// 'khor brgyad brgyad kyis bskor ba ste bdun cu rtsa gnyis/

de la shar phyogs kyi ngos na/ padma'i sdong po'i g.yas phyogs kyi ldum rdzings kyi 'khyil la/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan pa mnyan po srung bar byed pa'i dpal nag po chen po bya rog ma zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa bzhugs pa la/ lha'i dbang po brgya byin la sogs pa 'phags pa phyogs skyong ba bcus bskor ba dang*/ gtso 'khor bcu gcig bzhugs/ de'i g.yas na rin po che'i bang mdzod la mnga' brnyes pas dgos 'dod phun sum tshogs pa thams cad 'byung ba'i gnod sbyin gyi rgyal po rnam thos sras zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa la/ gnod sbyin gang ba bzang po la sogs pa brgyad dang*/ rgyal ba khyu mchog dang dgus bskor ba dang bcu bzhugs/ de'i g.yas na klu'i rgyal po chen po mtha' yas la klu chen po brgyad kyis bskor ba dang gtso 'khor dgu bzhugs so// padma'i sdong po'i g.yon gyi ldum rdzings kyi 'khyil la/ dpal ldan ma lha mo srog grub ma zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma la 'khor lha mo gri thod can brgyad/ klu mo chu srin gdong dang dgus bskor ba gtso 'khor bcu bzhugs so// de'i g.yon gyi phyogs na rin po che'i gter thams cad kyi mnga' bdag tu gyur pa sa'i lha mo brtan ma zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma la bum pa dang bum pa chen po la sogs pa brgyad/ jo mo lha sman bkra shis tshe ring ma dpon g.yog lnga dang gtso 'khor bcu bzhi bzhugs so// de'i g.yon na klu'i rgyal po chen po padma chen po la klu chen po brgyad kyis bskor ba dang gtso 'khor dgu bzhugs/ spyir ldum rdzings kyi shar na lha drug bcu rtsa bzhi bzhugs so// de nas lho phyogs kyi ngos kyi padma'i sdong po'i g.yas kyi ldum rdzings kyi 'khyil la/ dam pa chos skyong ba'i srung ma chen po dpal mgon po gtsug gtor rten zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa la klu'i rgyal po chen po rgya mtsho la sogs pa lha ma srin sde brgyad kyis bskor ba dang gtso 'khor dgu bzhugs/
