de rnams da lta'i rgyu 'di la gnas pa yin/ de yang*/ sang phyis gser phun sum tshogs pa 'byung ba de rnams/ da lta'i rgyu 'di la gnas pa yin/ de yang*/ sang phyis gser phun sum tshogs pa 'byung ba rnams/ de dang gser 'di nyid la gnas pa yin/ sang phyis gos phun sum tshogs pa rnams la longs spyod rgyu 'byung ba de/ de ltar 'dul ba'i gos de rnams la gnas pa lags/ de ring mang skol gzab nas drangs pa'i 'bras bu/ ja phun sum tshogs pa la longs spyod par yod pa yin/ des na/ rgyu ni de ltar song ba'i 'bras bu 'byung ba lags/ de ltar yang*/ ci 'dra ba yi las byas pas// de 'dra ba yi 'bras bu 'byung*// bgyi ba gsung*/ de la rgyus 'bras bu dpogs pa dang*/ 'bras bus rgyu dpogs pa rnam pa gnyis yin/ da lta rgyu dge ba bsags pa la/ 'bras bu bde ba 'byung bar shes pa de/ rgyus 'bras bu dpogs pa yin/ da lta bde skyid phun sum tshogs pa longs spyod pa de rnams/ rgyu dge bar song ba'i 'bras bu shes pa de/ 'bras bus rgyu dpogs pa yin pa lags/ de dang 'dra bar mi dge ba'i las sna tshogs gang yin par song yang*/ rgyu 'bras gnyis po de ma gtogs pa gzhan med pas/ gang yin yang de kho na bzhin shes 'tshal ba lags/ des na/ bsam pa mi dge ba chags sdang rmongs gsum gyi rjes su 'brangs pa'i las spyad par song na/ dmyal ba yi dwags la sogs pa'i gnas ngan pa rnams su skye bar yong ba yin/ de yang*/ zhe sdang gi las spyad par song na/ dmyal ba'i gnas su skye/ 'dod chags kyi rjes su 'brangs pa'i las spyad par song na/ yi dwags kyi gnas su skye/ gti mug gi rjes su 'brangs pa'i las spyad par song na/ dud 'gro'i gnas su skye bar byed pa lags/ de ltar nyon mongs pa chags sdang rmongs gsum gyi rjes su 'brangs pa'i las che chung gang byas kyang*/ skye ba 'di la yang sdug bsngal mi 'dod pa sna tshogs 'byung ba dang*/

phyi ma yang gnas ngan pa rnams su skye ba yin/ des na/ rgyu mi dge ba bgyi ba de ji lta ba spong dgos pa lags/ rgyu'i dus su ma bkag par bab col du spyad nas/ 'bras bu 'byung ba'i dus su/ nga la 'di 'dra ba yong mi thang ba byas pas bag mchis pa yin/ rgyu sngon du song zin nas sangs rgyas byon yang mi phan pa lags/ des na rgyu mi dge ba thams cad ma skyes pa mi bskyed/ skyes pa rnams kyang ngo shes par byas nas spong dgos pa lags/ las 'dres ma bgyi ba/ las dge mi dge thams cad 'dres mar spyad pas/ 'bras bu ma 'dres la rdzogs par 'dres mar 'byung ba lags/ des na las rnams 'bu srin rgyab 'dra gsung bas/ rgyu dge mi dge gang spyad pa'i 'bras bu 'phral du 'byung ba yin/ des na/ rgyu mi dge ba bgyi ba de nan tan chen pos bkag nas/ bsam pa byang chub kyi sems rin po che'i rjes su 'brangs pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa drug la sogs pa'i rtsa ba nus tshad la 'bungs dgos pa yin/ de ltar byang chub kyi sems kyi dbang du byas pa'i dus su/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug gi gang rung re re la yang drug ka tshang nas/ byed pa la sogs pa re re'i gzhan rnams 'khor gyi tshul du byung ba lags/ des na/ rgyu ji ltar song ba de la/ da lta 'phral du mthong chos su 'byung ba lags/ rgyu gang song ba rnams sangs rgyas kyi sar yang spu ris mi 'dor bar zad de/ smin par bshad de/ ma 'dres pa so sor 'byung ba lags/ de ltar yang*/ lus can rnams kyi las rnams ni// bskal pa brgyar yang chud mi za// tshogs shing dus pa bab pa na// 'bras bu nyid du smin par 'gyur// bgyi ba gsung*/ des na/ khyed bsod snyoms dang*/ khams 'gro la sogs g.yas g.yon gshegs bzhud mdzad pa rnams kyang chos dang mthun pa/ rje rin po che yab sras kyi zhabs 'dren du ma song ba re gyis/ khyed tshan re re 'di nas song ba dang chos dang mi mthun pa'i spyod pa sna tshogs re byas pas/

yon bdag pho mo rnams kyi dad pa bzlog sgom chen pa ri phug na yod pa dge sbyor mdzad pa rnams kyi snyan gtses/ de'i dus su 'dir khong rnams kyis 'dir yi ge bskur nas/ khyed kyis kha ta gyis pa 'di tsug byed du ma 'jug zer du byung*/ de lta bu'i rtsa bar song na zhabs 'dren de bas che ba e yod/ des na da phyin chad de lta bu'i spyod pa ma byed/ chang ma 'thung*/ 'thungs par song na 'di bas nyes pa che ba med pa yin/ de ltar yang*/ dam pa'i chos 'dul ba nas/ chang ni nyes pa kun gyi rtsa ba ste// rtswa mchog gis kyang blangs te mi 'thung ngo*// bgyi ba gsung*/ de la sngon spyan snga kun nas/ chang 'thungs zer ba'i kha skad gsan pa'i dus su/ shin tu mi mnyes nas/ de lta bu gang gis 'thungs par song na yang phyin chad nga dang 'brel pa med pa yin no// gsungs nas dbu bsnyung bzhes par gda'o// de ltar/ rje rin po che dang 'brel ba med pa'i dus su/ gzhan dang 'brel ba yong ba de dka' bar yong ba lags/ de ltar rje rin po che yab sras dang 'brel pa med par thug pa'i thal ba'i khu ba de 'thungs pa la dgos ched ci yod/ de la tshan gcig gis rang re 'thung 'dod pa'i rdzun gyi khungs/ bcom ldan 'das la byed nas/ nged rnal 'byor pa yin/ nged sgom chen pa yin pas/ gsang sngags su gnang ba yin zer nas/ rnal 'byor pa dang*/ sgom chen pa yin pa kha nas bkag pa yin mod/ de ni snyad mu ge dang snam bu bor tshong byed pa ma gtogs pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyis/ chang gnang ba'i skabs mi srid pa lags/ ma gnang ba'i pha rol tu bag tsam 'thung bar song yang nyes pa dpag tu med par gsungs/ de ltar yang*/ sdom pa 'byung ba'i rgyud las/ ha gsum la sogs dang bral bar// ci ste dam tshig can gyis 'thung*// de la dug 'gyur the tshom med// sngags pa chang gis myos gyur pa// 'dod la dga' zhing 'khrig la sred// rgod cing de bzhin glu yang len// rnal 'byor ma rnams khros nas ni// gdon dang rims dang dug sogs kyis// rmongs chen de dag bsad nas kyang*// ngu 'bod dmyal bar 'tshod par byed// bgyi ba gsung*/

de ma gtogs pa khyed rnams kyis chang btung bar bya gsung ba med pas/ des na kha dog dang*/ dri ro dang nus pa bsgyur nus par song na/ gsang sngags su yang gnang la/ 'dul bar yang bkag pa med pa yin no// de ltar yang*/ ha ho hrī hūm̐ bya ba sngags kyis bsang ba dang*/ sbar ba dang*/ rtog bya ste/ has ni kha dog bsgyur bar byed// hos ni nus pa 'joms par byed/ hrīs ro ni bsgyur bar byed/ hūm̐ gis dri ni 'phrog par byed// bgyi ba gsung bas/ de ltar kha dog dri ro dang nus pa bsgyur nus pa de la bdud rtsir gsung ba ma gtogs pa/ chang du yong ba ma lags/ de lta bu'i bdud rtsi de ni/ gsang sngags su yang gnang la/ 'dul bar yang bkag pa med pa yin no// de yang de lta bu'i nyes pa de/ khyed khams su bzhud pa kun la 'byung nye bar gda' bas/ khyed la dbus dang gzhan ni med pa'i khams lugs bgyi ba'i bla lhag cig yod par 'dug pas/ na ning gong kun tu yang*/ tshan re khams su bzhud nas/ yar byon pa'i dus su/ mchod 'di kun na yar la/ khams lugs byas pas mthol lo bshags zer zhing bshags pa byed pa 'byung ba lags par gda'/ de ltar bshags pa byed dgos pa'i dus su/ bzang po min te yong bas/ khyed rnams kyis ma byed/ yang tshan res rlung skyes pa skad zer ba kun yang*/ sa ser 'dir bsdad pa'i ring la rlung ma skyes/ khams sa bzang la khyed rang rnams mi la 'jigs 'jigs byed tsa na yang*/ nged khams bzang ba skad zer ba'i sa bzang der phyin pa'i dus su/ rlung skye ba'i don med pa yin/ de skyes pa bden na yang sha bzang po dang*/ thud mar bzang po zos pas chog pa la/ nyes pa dpag tu med pa yod pa de 'thungs nas lhag po ci yod/ de la/ nged rang sgom chen pa ni/ nad gang la yang bsgoms pas chog pa yin na/ mi dges ni bsgoms na rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sangs rgya ba la yang chags med pa yin/ nad de lta bu re la ni/

rje rin po che'i gdams ngag thun mong ma yin pa 'di 'dra ba rnams yod pa'i dus su/ snga dro phyi dro re tsam bsgoms kyang des chog pa yin pas/ drod can dgos pa'i nad de 'dra ba byung ba'i dus su yang*/ gtum mo sum khrid kyis nyams su blangs pa'i dus su/ phan pa la tshegs med pa lags/ de ltar mdzad pa ma gtogs pa/ bcos tshod tshod kyang mi mdzad par zhu/ khyad par chang ni dus nam yang btung du mi rung bas/ srog la bab kyang snying rus chen po gyis la ma 'thung*/ rje rin po che yab sras gzhan gang dang yang mi 'dra bas/ mi che ba yin/ de'i dus su rang la yang khur zhig khur rgyu yod pas/ des na chos dang mi mthun pa'i spyod pa ma byas na/ rje rin po che yab sras kyi rnam par thar pa 'di bzung bar song na/ khyed rang rnams kyang mi mnyam pa dang mnyam/ mnyam nyid thams cad 'og tu tshud nas yul phyogs logs gar phyin yang*/ gzhan thams cad kyi gong du 'byung ba lags/ des na gzhi byes lam gsum gar phyin yang*/ chos dang mthun pa bla ma dang*/ grogs po'i thugs kyis ma khrel ba/ dus nam yin yang tshul khrims rin po che la rang snying dpang du btsugs nas mig gi 'bras bu bzhin du bsrung ba dang*/ 'di dang phyi ma thams cad du don chen po 'grub pa yin pas de ltar du mdzad par zhu 'tshal// //āoṃ ye dharmā he tu pra bha wā he tunte ṣānta thā ga to hya ba da ta/ te ṣāñtsa yo ni ro dha e waṃ bā dī ma hā shra ma ṇaḥswa hā// //
